meta.title: Optimization Theory for Context Engineering Documents
meta.description: DDD documentation framework for Optimization Theory projects in Context Engineering — the layer that turns 'make the context better' into an explicit optimization problem (typed decision variables, an objective with direction and measurement class, hard constraints enforced outside the weighted score, an evaluation function with provenance and noise awareness, a search space characterization), selects the search method from problem characteristics (exhaustive / grid / random → greedy → knapsack / ILP / CP-SAT → gradient → evolutionary / Pareto → Bayesian → adaptive re-optimization), runs experiments under a master run contract with a per-candidate event log, validates on holdout, deploys a versioned configuration with rollback and hands calibrated values back to the context-formalization layer. AI reads this file and generates .md files in the correct order with proper cross-references.
meta.applicable_when: Choosing among possible ways to assemble or configure context — which items to include under a token budget, which top_k, thresholds, retrieval strategy or component weights to use — when the choice must be defensible: an explicit objective with declared measurement classes, hard constraints that no score can compensate, an evaluation whose noise and cost are known, an algorithm chosen from variable types, search-space size, evaluation cost and objective count, and a run that is logged, holdout-validated, versioned and reversible. Distinct from the context-formalization template (which fixes what the components are and hands over configurable fields as null with owner_module — this template is the layer that fills the decision_formulation, measurement_evaluation and optimization_selection ones), from the ai-workflow and ai-chatbot templates (whose evaluation metrics enter here as evaluators, not as objectives by default) and from Information Theory (which supplies value signals) and Bayesian Inference (which owns belief updating — Bayesian Optimization is a search method, not that module). Use this template when the question is 'which configuration is best under this objective and these constraints, and how do we know' — not 'what does the model see' and not 'how much information does this item carry'.

agent_instructions.role: You are an optimization-engineering documentation generator for Context Engineering systems. Read this file and produce each document listed in phases[], in dependency order.
agent_instructions.generation_order_strategy: Topological sort by depends_on graph. Phase 1 fixes the vocabulary, the project constraints, the contract governance rules and the problem formulation; Phase 2 writes one contract per optimization concept (decision space, objective, feasibility, evaluation, multi-objective, algorithm selection), then the three method-family contracts, the master run contract and the experiment log; Phase 3 turns contracts into deployment governance, agent rules, code, prompts, handoff and operations. Each document is the canonical source for its concerns — downstream docs reference upstream docs by document ID. Enum values are defined once in their owner document and only indexed in GLOSSARY.md.
agent_instructions.content_language: Write document content in Thai for narrative sections; use English for all identifiers, code, contract names, schema_version strings, enum values, field names, mathematical symbols and technical terms. Preserve jargon (decision variable, objective, constraint, feasible region, search space, candidate, evaluator, proxy, Pareto, dominance, scalarization, greedy, knapsack, ILP, CP-SAT, gradient, surrogate, acquisition function, evolutionary, population, holdout, drift, rollback, canary, seed, baseline, best-found, near-optimal) as English even in Thai sentences.
agent_instructions.quality_gate: Each document must cover all sections[] listed. Validate that cross-references (refs[]) resolve to real document IDs before finishing. Every contract, enum, lifecycle stage, method and governance rule must be documented exactly once in its canonical doc and referenced elsewhere — no duplicate definitions. Never hardcode real company or product names — use placeholders or the fictional organization so the template stays reusable. Never invent a weight, threshold, learning rate, population size or evaluation budget as a default: any value that needs calibration is declared as null with its calibration source (validation data or business policy) and is never presented as a standard.
domain_specific_notes: Optimization is the search for the best trade-off under constraints, not the maximization of every metric at once. OPTIMIZATION_DOMAIN.md fixes the Team Rule: no algorithm is chosen before Decision, Objective, Constraints and Evaluation are written down.

Contract Governance Rules (CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md) apply to every contract: value: null means calibrate, never guess a middle value; every objective signal declares a measurement_class; a proxy is named as a proxy and never called true task value without validation; hard constraints are enforced outside the weighted score; every experiment records candidate configuration, raw sub-scores, feasibility, evaluator version, evaluation cost and random seed; tests are generated from acceptance_criteria; the contract is an implementation specification, not the source of truth for weights or thresholds.

Contract Syntax Rule: fields the team must validate use explicit type, allowed_values, nullable and required keys — never pseudo-types e.g. 'A | B' or 'array[string]'. Workshop-fixed schema_version strings are kept verbatim; a template extension bumps the minor version and states what it adds; template-invented enum values are labelled application-defined.

Declare the variable type before choosing an optimizer (DECISION_SPACE.md). A value stored as float is not differentiable by that fact; binary include/exclude, categorical strategies and integers are discrete decisions and must not be silently treated as continuous.

Objective says what is better; constraints say what is unusable from the start (FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md). Pre-execution constraints are checked before a run, post-execution constraints after the generated result exists, deployment gates before release; a repaired candidate is re-evaluated before comparison.

Optimization quality is bounded by evaluation quality (EVALUATION_SPEC.md). Ū(x) = U(x) + ε: keep raw sub-scores, repeat stochastic evaluations, aggregate with a declared method, never rank two candidates whose difference lies inside evaluator noise, and keep a holdout set the optimizer never sees.

Multiple objectives are kept as vectors with direction-aware Pareto dominance (MULTI_OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md); collapsing to a weighted sum is a business choice recorded as final_choice_rule, never presented as a mathematical universal optimum.

Algorithm = a way to search, not the definition of optimization (ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md). Start with the simplest transparent baseline the search space allows; escalate to greedy, exact combinatorial, gradient, evolutionary, Bayesian or adaptive methods only when a problem characteristic demands it, and record rejected algorithms with reasons.

Wording discipline: greedy is a heuristic unless a provable property is stated; exact optimality is claimed only for the stated formulation and solver scope; gradient ascent finds local optima; Bayesian Optimization with a limited budget yields best-found, not global optimum; 'optimal under the model' is never 'best in reality'.

Production optimization is governed (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md): candidate → constraint check → holdout validation → risk review → versioned deployment → canary → monitor → rollback. Thresholds come from validation or policy; the optimizer never decides governance rules; a single noisy score drop never triggers re-optimization unless policy explicitly allows it.

The running example is BriefDesk — the executive-brief assistant at Harborline used by the context-formalization template. Its handoff package (candidate knowledge ids, configurable_fields top_k / dedupe_threshold / component_weights / strategy_selection as null with owner_module, hard constraints on citations) is the input; two problems are formulated: briefdesk_brief_selection (binary subset under 8,000 tokens) and briefdesk_retrieval_tuning (mixed variables with expensive evaluation). Selected values flow back as downstream configuration provenance, never as edits to the formalization contracts.

description.th: กำหนดขอบเขต optimization, ข้อจำกัดของโปรเจกต์, คำศัพท์กลาง, กติกา contract และ problem formulation — ก่อนเลือก algorithm ใด ๆ
description.en: Fixes the optimization boundary, project constraints, shared vocabulary, contract governance rules and the problem formulation — before any algorithm is chosen.

description.th: ขอบเขตของ optimization ในระบบ — optimization คือการหา best trade-off ภายใต้ constraints ไม่ใช่การดันทุก metric ให้สูงสุด, workflow สิบขั้นก่อนลงสูตร, Team Rule ห้ามเลือก algorithm ก่อน define Decision + Objective + Constraints + Evaluation, ความสัมพันธ์กับ Context Formalization และการแนะนำตัวอย่าง BriefDesk
description.en: The optimization boundary of the system — optimization as the best trade-off under constraints rather than maximizing every metric, the ten-step workflow before any formula, the Team Rule that no algorithm is chosen before Decision + Objective + Constraints + Evaluation, the relation to Context Formalization and the introduction of the BriefDesk example.

suggested_headings: What Optimization Is and Is Not

agent_hints.instruction: Generate an OPTIMIZATION_DOMAIN.md that answers Step 1 of the methodology — Define the Task — for the project's optimization layer. Explain that optimization is the search for the best trade-off under constraints (show the trade-off table: relevance vs retrieval cost, completeness vs tokens, accuracy vs latency/cost, brevity vs evidence, diversity vs contradiction) and that 'best' depends on task, user, risk, token budget, latency and cost. Present the ten-step workflow and the Team Rule (no algorithm before Decision + Objective + Constraints + Evaluation). Position the layer relative to Context Formalization: C = A(c1..c6) is given; this layer chooses A and its parameters via A* = arg max_A Utility(A; task, user, state) subject to constraints, and A* is best only under the stated formulation. Introduce the running example BriefDesk with what arrives from its handoff package and the two problems that will be formulated. Close with the failure modes of unformulated optimization and the document that prevents each. Keep it at mental-model level — contracts come later.
agent_hints.input_context: This is the root document. The handoff package fields (candidate ids, configurable_fields null with owner_module, hard constraints) come from the context-formalization template's HANDOFF.md; do not redefine them here — describe them as inputs. Keep the Teaching Fast Path (four sessions) as the reading order of this document set.
agent_hints.validation: The trade-off table, the ten-step workflow and the Team Rule must all appear. The A* formulation must carry the 'best under this formulation only' caveat. Both BriefDesk problems must be named with their variable kinds (discrete vs mixed). No algorithm may be recommended in this document.

sections.heading: What Optimization Is and Is Not

description.th: Optimization = เลือกสิ่งที่คุ้มที่สุดสำหรับโจทย์นี้ภายใต้ข้อจำกัด ไม่ใช่ทำให้ทุกอย่างสูงสุด
description.en: Optimization = choosing what pays off most for this task under its limits, not pushing everything to the maximum.

items.text_th: Trade-off Reality — แสดงว่า metric แต่ละตัวมีราคา: relevance สูงขึ้นต้องเพิ่ม retrieval/reranking, completeness สูงขึ้นใช้ token มากขึ้น, accuracy สูงขึ้นเพิ่ม latency/cost, context สั้นลงเสียหลักฐาน, diversity สูงขึ้นเพิ่ม contradiction
items.text_en: Trade-off Reality — show that every metric has a price: higher relevance needs more retrieval/reranking, higher completeness spends more tokens, higher accuracy raises latency/cost, shorter context loses evidence, higher diversity adds contradiction

items.text_th: Definition — optimization คือการหา best trade-off under constraints; 'ดีที่สุด' ขึ้นกับ task, user, risk, token budget, latency และ cost ไม่ใช่ค่าตายตัว
items.text_en: Definition — optimization is the search for the best trade-off under constraints; 'best' depends on task, user, risk, token budget, latency and cost and is never a fixed value

items.text_th: Not a Magic Formula — ระบุว่า template นี้เป็น discipline ที่ทำให้การเลือก context และ strategy กลายเป็น decision problem ที่วัดได้ ทดลองได้ เปรียบเทียบได้ — ไม่ใช่สูตรที่สร้าง context ที่ดีที่สุดเสมอ
items.text_en: Not a Magic Formula — state that this template is a discipline that turns context and strategy choices into a measurable, testable, comparable decision problem — not a formula that always yields the best context

description.th: ลำดับสิบขั้นจาก business goal ถึง iterate — และ Team Rule ที่ห้ามเลือก algorithm ก่อน
description.en: The ten-step order from business goal to iterate — and the Team Rule that forbids choosing an algorithm first.

items.text_th: Goal plus Ten Steps — Business/Task Goal → Define Decision (เลือกหรือปรับอะไร) → Define Objective (อะไรคือดีกว่า) → Define Constraints (อะไรห้ามเกิน/ห้ามผิด) → Define Search Space → Choose Evaluation Method → Choose Optimization Algorithm → Evaluate/Experiment → Select/Deploy → Observe Outcome → Iterate/Learn
items.text_en: Goal plus Ten Steps — Business/Task Goal → Define Decision (what is chosen or tuned) → Define Objective (what 'better' means) → Define Constraints (what must not exceed or fail) → Define Search Space → Choose Evaluation Method → Choose Optimization Algorithm → Evaluate/Experiment → Select/Deploy → Observe Outcome → Iterate/Learn

items.text_th: Team Rule — ห้ามเลือก Algorithm ก่อน define Decision + Objective + Constraints + Evaluation; ถ้ายังตอบสี่อย่างนี้ไม่ได้ ประโยค 'ใช้ Bayesian Optimization' หรือ 'ใช้ Gradient Descent' ยังเร็วเกินไป
items.text_en: Team Rule — never choose an algorithm before Decision + Objective + Constraints + Evaluation are defined; until those four are answered, 'use Bayesian Optimization' or 'use Gradient Descent' is premature

items.text_th: Teaching Fast Path — สี่ session: Mental Model (Problem → Decision → Objective → Constraints → Evaluation), Context Selection (Simple Search → Greedy → Exact/Combinatorial), Continuous & Complex Search (Gradient → Evolutionary/Pareto → Bayesian), Production (Adaptive → Holdout → Logging → Versioning → Rollback) — เอกสารใน PROBLEM_FORMULATION.md และ ARCHITECTURE.md เดินตามลำดับนี้
items.text_en: Teaching Fast Path — four sessions: Mental Model (Problem → Decision → Objective → Constraints → Evaluation), Context Selection (Simple Search → Greedy → Exact/Combinatorial), Continuous & Complex Search (Gradient → Evolutionary/Pareto → Bayesian), Production (Adaptive → Holdout → Logging → Versioning → Rollback) — PROBLEM_FORMULATION.md and ARCHITECTURE.md follow this order

description.th: Context Formalization ตอบว่า context ประกอบด้วยอะไร; Optimization Theory ตอบว่าควรเลือกวิธีประกอบแบบไหน
description.en: Context Formalization answers what the context consists of; Optimization Theory answers which way of assembling it should be chosen.

items.text_th: Two Questions — Context Formalization: 'Context ของระบบประกอบด้วยอะไรและประกอบอย่างไร?' (C = A(c1..c6)); Optimization Theory: 'ในบรรดาวิธีประกอบที่เป็นไปได้ ควรเลือกแบบไหนจึงเหมาะกับ objective และ constraints ของ task นี้ที่สุด?'
items.text_en: Two Questions — Context Formalization: 'what does the system's context consist of and how is it assembled?' (C = A(c1..c6)); Optimization Theory: 'among the possible ways to assemble it, which best fits this task's objective and constraints?'

items.text_th: A* Under a Formulation — A* = arg max_A Utility(A; task, user, state) subject to Constraints(A) satisfied; A* ไม่ได้หมายถึง assembly function เดียวที่ดีที่สุดสำหรับทุก application แต่ดีที่สุดภายใต้ problem formulation ที่กำหนด
items.text_en: A* Under a Formulation — A* = arg max_A Utility(A; task, user, state) subject to Constraints(A) satisfied; A* is not one assembly function best for every application but the best under the stated problem formulation

items.text_th: Input Package — สิ่งที่ layer นี้รับจาก formalization: candidate item ids, configurable_fields ที่เป็น null พร้อม owner_module, hard constraints (policy invariants) และ manifest/validation refs — รายละเอียดใน HANDOFF.md; สิ่งที่อยู่นอก scope (information value signals, belief update) อยู่ใน CONSTRAINTS.md
items.text_en: Input Package — what this layer receives from formalization: candidate item ids, configurable_fields as null with owner_module, hard constraints (policy invariants) and manifest/validation refs — detailed in HANDOFF.md; out-of-scope items (information value signals, belief update) live in CONSTRAINTS.md

description.th: BriefDesk รับ handoff package จาก context-formalization แล้วมีสองโจทย์ optimization
description.en: BriefDesk receives the handoff package from context-formalization and has two optimization problems.

items.text_th: BriefDesk Recap — executive-brief assistant ของ Harborline (บริษัท logistics สมมติ) ที่ผลิต brief ห้าข่าวต่อวันให้ COO office และตอบคำถาม compliance; context bundle ของมันถูก formalize แล้ว (ctx_briefdesk_2026_09_04_001, manifest mf_briefdesk_2026_09_04_001, validation report vr_briefdesk_2026_09_04_001 PASS_WITH_WARNINGS)
items.text_en: BriefDesk Recap — the executive-brief assistant at Harborline (a fictional logistics company) producing a five-item daily brief for the COO office and answering compliance questions; its context bundle is already formalized (ctx_briefdesk_2026_09_04_001, manifest mf_briefdesk_2026_09_04_001, validation report vr_briefdesk_2026_09_04_001 PASS_WITH_WARNINGS)

items.text_th: What Arrives — 12 candidate knowledge ids (เช่น kn_ctrl_nist_ac_2, kn_news_2026_09_04_017, kn_ops_report_2026_w35), configurable_fields ห้าตัว top_k / dedupe_threshold / component_weights / strategy_selection / information_value_metrics ที่เป็น null พร้อม owner_module (ตัวสุดท้ายเป็นของ information_theory ไม่ใช่ decision variable ของ layer นี้) และ hard constraints citation_source_required → instr_citation_required_003, no_fabricated_citation → instr_no_fabricated_citation_004 ภายใต้ token budget 8,000
items.text_en: What Arrives — 12 candidate knowledge ids (e.g. kn_ctrl_nist_ac_2, kn_news_2026_09_04_017, kn_ops_report_2026_w35), five configurable_fields top_k / dedupe_threshold / component_weights / strategy_selection / information_value_metrics as null with owner_module (the last owned by information_theory, not a decision variable of this layer), and hard constraints citation_source_required → instr_citation_required_003, no_fabricated_citation → instr_no_fabricated_citation_004 under a 8,000-token budget

items.text_th: Two Problems — briefdesk_brief_selection (เลือก subset ของ candidate ให้ได้ brief ห้าข่าวภายใต้ 8,000 tokens — discrete) และ briefdesk_retrieval_tuning (ปรับ top_k, dedupe_threshold, retrieval_strategy, component_weights — mixed, evaluation แพง); ทั้งสองถูก formalize ใน PROBLEM_FORMULATION.md
items.text_en: Two Problems — briefdesk_brief_selection (choose the candidate subset for a five-item brief under 8,000 tokens — discrete) and briefdesk_retrieval_tuning (tune top_k, dedupe_threshold, retrieval_strategy, component_weights — mixed, expensive evaluation); both are formalized in PROBLEM_FORMULATION.md

items.text_th: Why One System, Two Patterns — selection ครอบ pattern 'subset under budget' (grid → greedy → knapsack) ส่วน tuning ครอบ pattern 'expensive black-box, multi-objective' (grid baseline → Bayesian → Pareto) ทำให้ตัวอย่างเดียวเดินครบทุก method-family
items.text_en: Why One System, Two Patterns — selection covers the 'subset under budget' pattern (grid → greedy → knapsack) while tuning covers the 'expensive black-box, multi-objective' pattern (grid baseline → Bayesian → Pareto), so one example walks through every method family

description.th: สิ่งที่พังเมื่อ optimize โดยไม่ formulate — และเอกสารที่ป้องกันแต่ละอย่าง
description.en: What breaks when optimizing without formulation — and which document prevents each.

items.text_th: Algorithm First — ทีมพูดว่า 'ใช้ Bayesian Optimization เลย' โดยยังไม่รู้ว่า optimize อะไรและ evaluation แพงแค่ไหน → ป้องกันด้วย Team Rule และ ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md
items.text_en: Algorithm First — the team says 'just use Bayesian Optimization' without knowing what is optimized or how expensive evaluation is → prevented by the Team Rule and ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md

items.text_th: Everything in a Weighted Sum — fabricated citation ถูก 'หักคะแนนนิดหน่อย' แทนการ reject → ป้องกันด้วย FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md ที่แยก hard constraint ออกจาก score
items.text_en: Everything in a Weighted Sum — a fabricated citation gets 'a small penalty' instead of rejection → prevented by FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md separating hard constraints from the score

items.text_th: Proxy Equals Product — semantic similarity ดีขึ้นถูกอ่านว่า usefulness ดีขึ้น → ป้องกันด้วย measurement_class และ proxy validation ใน EVALUATION_SPEC.md
items.text_en: Proxy Equals Product — better semantic similarity is read as better usefulness → prevented by measurement_class and proxy validation in EVALUATION_SPEC.md

items.text_th: Optimal Under Model = Best in Reality — คำตอบเป็น optimum ของ formalized problem เท่านั้น; ถ้า formulation ละเลย risk, hidden cost หรือ stakeholder objective คำตอบไม่ใช่ดีที่สุดในโลกจริง → ทุกเอกสารใช้คำว่า best-found / near-optimal ตาม CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md
items.text_en: Optimal Under Model = Best in Reality — the answer is the optimum of the formalized problem only; if the formulation ignores risk, hidden cost or a stakeholder objective it is not the best in reality → every document uses best-found / near-optimal wording per CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md

description.th: ข้อจำกัดระดับโปรเจกต์ที่ทุก contract ต้องเคารพ — budget มิติต่าง ๆ (token, evaluation count, cost, time, human review), governance สำหรับ high-risk domain (optimizer ไม่ตัดสิน governance rule เอง, threshold มาจาก validation/policy, human review เป็น first-class), reproducibility และสิ่งที่อยู่นอก scope (information value signals, belief update)
description.en: Project-level constraints every contract must respect — budget dimensions (tokens, evaluation count, cost, time, human review), governance for high-risk domains (the optimizer never decides governance rules, thresholds come from validation/policy, human review is first-class), reproducibility and what lies out of scope (information value signals, belief update).

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a CONSTRAINTS.md listing the project-level constraints every optimization contract must respect. Cover budget dimensions (context tokens as a hard constraint; evaluation budget dimensions max_evaluations / max_total_tokens / max_api_cost / max_wall_clock_time / max_human_reviews; latency and cost ceilings), governance constraints for high-risk domains (optimizer never decides governance rules; hard constraints enforced outside soft scoring; thresholds from validation or policy hence value: null; human review as a first-class protocol), reproducibility constraints (mandatory records, determinism where possible, versioned everything) and the out-of-scope boundary (Context Formalization owns structure, Information Theory owns value signals, Bayesian Inference owns belief update, no universal weights). Use BriefDesk values where a concrete number is given by upstream policy (8,000 tokens) and null everywhere a value would need calibration.
agent_hints.input_context: Budget values other than the upstream 8,000-token context budget are declared in EVALUATION_SPEC.md — this document names the dimensions only. The governance stance mirrors the workshop's Production Optimization Governance appendix: legal / security / privacy domains, optimizer is not the governance decider.
agent_hints.validation: All five evaluation budget dimensions must be named. The 'optimizer never decides governance' rule, the 'thresholds from validation or policy' rule and the human-review-first-class rule must appear. The three out-of-scope owners (formalization, information_theory, probabilistic_learning) must be named. No numeric weight or threshold may appear except the upstream token budget.

description.th: Budget ไม่ใช่แค่ token — ทุกมิติที่จำกัดการทดลองต้องประกาศ
description.en: Budget is not only tokens — every dimension that limits experimentation must be declared.

items.text_th: Context Budget — total context ต่อ request ≤ 8,000 tokens สำหรับ BriefDesk (ค่าจาก policy_scope ของ formalization layer) — เป็น hard constraint ของทุก candidate ไม่ใช่ objective
items.text_en: Context Budget — total context per request ≤ 8,000 tokens for BriefDesk (value from the formalization layer's policy_scope) — a hard constraint on every candidate, not an objective

items.text_th: Evaluation Budget — มิติที่ต้องประกาศก่อน run: max_evaluations, max_total_tokens, max_api_cost, max_wall_clock_time, max_human_reviews; practical optimization คือ maximize best_found_quality subject to evaluation_cost ≤ budget — ค่าจริงประกาศใน EVALUATION_SPEC.md
items.text_en: Evaluation Budget — dimensions to declare before a run: max_evaluations, max_total_tokens, max_api_cost, max_wall_clock_time, max_human_reviews; practical optimization is maximize best_found_quality subject to evaluation_cost ≤ budget — actual values are declared in EVALUATION_SPEC.md

items.text_th: Latency and Cost Ceilings — SLA และ unit economics ของ production เป็น constraint (hard เมื่อ policy กำหนด, soft เมื่อเป็น preference) — ห้ามซ่อนเป็น term ใน weighted sum ถ้าเกินแล้วใช้ไม่ได้
items.text_en: Latency and Cost Ceilings — production SLA and unit economics are constraints (hard when policy says so, soft when a preference) — never hidden as a weighted-sum term if exceeding them makes the result unusable

description.th: กติกาที่ optimizer ห้ามละเมิดเมื่อ domain มี risk (legal, security, privacy, compliance)
description.en: Rules the optimizer may never break when the domain carries risk (legal, security, privacy, compliance).

items.text_th: Optimizer Never Decides Governance — governance rule (citation required, authority precedence, human review policy) เป็น input ของ optimization ไม่ใช่ output; optimizer เลือกได้เฉพาะภายใน feasible region ที่ rule กำหนด
items.text_en: Optimizer Never Decides Governance — governance rules (citation required, authority precedence, human review policy) are inputs to optimization, never outputs; the optimizer chooses only inside the feasible region those rules define

items.text_th: Hard Constraints Outside Soft Scoring — hard constraints ถูก enforce แยกจาก weighted score เสมอ เพื่อไม่ให้ objective อื่นชดเชย violation ที่ยอมรับไม่ได้ (รายละเอียด FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md)
items.text_en: Hard Constraints Outside Soft Scoring — hard constraints are always enforced separately from the weighted score so no other objective can compensate an unacceptable violation (details in FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md)

items.text_th: Thresholds From Validation or Policy — ทุก threshold, weight, trigger มาจาก task-specific validation หรือ business policy ไม่ใช่ model guess; ใน contract จึงเป็น value: null จนกว่าจะ calibrate
items.text_en: Thresholds From Validation or Policy — every threshold, weight and trigger comes from task-specific validation or business policy, not a model guess; in contracts it is value: null until calibrated

items.text_th: Human Review Is First-Class — human review policy เป็น constraint/protocol ไม่ใช่ metric; ใน BriefDesk คำถาม compliance ที่ high-risk ต้องผ่าน review path ที่ optimizer เปลี่ยนไม่ได้ (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md)
items.text_en: Human Review Is First-Class — the human review policy is a constraint/protocol, not a metric; in BriefDesk high-risk compliance questions follow a review path the optimizer cannot change (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md)

description.th: สิ่งที่ต้องบันทึกเพื่อให้ตอบได้ว่าทำไม configuration นี้ถูกเลือกและ reproduce ได้หรือไม่
description.en: What must be recorded so the team can say why this configuration was chosen and whether it can be reproduced.

items.text_th: Mandatory Records — ทุก experiment เก็บ candidate configuration, raw sub-scores, feasibility, evaluator version, evaluation cost และ random seed เมื่อเกี่ยวข้อง (Contract Governance Rule 5 ใน CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md, schema ใน EXPERIMENT_LOG.md)
items.text_en: Mandatory Records — every experiment records candidate configuration, raw sub-scores, feasibility, evaluator version, evaluation cost and random seed where applicable (Contract Governance Rule 5 in CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md, schema in EXPERIMENT_LOG.md)

items.text_th: Determinism Where Possible — same seed → same random-search / mutation / initial-design sequence; deterministic evaluations cache ตาม candidate_id; stochastic evaluations เก็บเป็น versioned batch ไม่ซ่อนด้วย single sample
items.text_en: Determinism Where Possible — same seed → same random-search / mutation / initial-design sequence; deterministic evaluations are cached by candidate_id; stochastic evaluations are stored as versioned batches, never hidden behind a single sample

items.text_th: Versioned Everything — dataset_version, evaluator_version, config version (<name>_config/vX.Y), algorithm hyperparameters และ deployment record มี version; last known-good ไม่ถูกเขียนทับ
items.text_en: Versioned Everything — dataset_version, evaluator_version, config version (<name>_config/vX.Y), algorithm hyperparameters and the deployment record are versioned; the last known-good is never overwritten

description.th: สิ่งที่ template นี้ไม่เป็นเจ้าของ — เพื่อไม่ให้ optimization ล้นไปกินหน้าที่ของ module อื่น
description.en: What this template does not own — so optimization does not swallow other modules' responsibilities.

items.text_th: Context Formalization Owns Structure — component boundaries, provenance, presence policy, assembly contract และ manifest เป็นของ formalization layer; layer นี้ไม่แก้ contract เหล่านั้น แต่ส่งค่าที่ calibrate กลับเป็น downstream config provenance (HANDOFF.md)
items.text_en: Context Formalization Owns Structure — component boundaries, provenance, presence policy, assembly contract and manifest belong to the formalization layer; this layer never edits those contracts but returns calibrated values as downstream config provenance (HANDOFF.md)

items.text_th: Information Theory Owns Value Signals — entropy, mutual information, redundancy และ information_value_metrics เป็นของ owner_module information_theory; layer นี้บริโภค signal เหล่านั้นเป็น objective component หรือ marginal value input ได้แต่ไม่นิยาม — ส่งมาโดย `ddd-information-theory-v1.3.0.json` HANDOFF.md เป็น information_value_metrics package แยกต่างหาก (layer นี้ยังไม่เติม field นั้น)
items.text_en: Information Theory Owns Value Signals — entropy, mutual information, redundancy and information_value_metrics belong to owner_module information_theory; this layer may consume those signals as objective components or marginal-value inputs but never defines them — supplied by `ddd-information-theory-v1.3.0.json` HANDOFF.md as a separate information_value_metrics package (this layer still does not fill it)

items.text_th: Bayesian Inference Owns Belief Update — priors, likelihoods, posterior updates เป็นของ probabilistic_learning; Bayesian Optimization ในเอกสารนี้เป็น search method ที่ surrogate จัดการ uncertainty ของ objective — ไม่ใช่ module Bayesian Inference
items.text_en: Bayesian Inference Owns Belief Update — priors, likelihoods and posterior updates belong to probabilistic_learning; Bayesian Optimization in this document set is a search method whose surrogate handles objective uncertainty — not the Bayesian Inference module

items.text_th: No Universal Weights — template ไม่มี weight, threshold, learning rate, population size หรือ acquisition parameter เป็นค่า default; ทุกตัวเป็น null พร้อม calibration source ตาม GLOSSARY.md convention
items.text_en: No Universal Weights — the template ships no default weight, threshold, learning rate, population size or acquisition parameter; each is null with a calibration source per the GLOSSARY.md convention

description.th: คำศัพท์กลาง สัญลักษณ์คณิตศาสตร์ id convention และ enumeration registry ที่ index ทุก enum ไปยัง owner document — GLOSSARY ไม่นิยาม enum ซ้ำ
description.en: Shared vocabulary, mathematical symbols, id conventions and an enumeration registry indexing every enum to its owner document — GLOSSARY never redefines an enum.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a GLOSSARY.md that fixes vocabulary for the whole document set: core terms (decision variable, search space, objective, constraint, feasible region, candidate, baseline, best-found, evaluator, proxy, measurement class, Pareto dominance/frontier, heuristic vs exact, adaptive vs online vs algorithm selection vs meta-optimization), the mathematical symbols used everywhere (standard form, utility and estimator Ū = U + ε, selection symbols, method update rules), identifier conventions (exp_/run_/evt_/cand_, bench_ and evaluator id/version pairs, <system>_<purpose>_config/vX.Y, upstream refs cited verbatim, contract version string forms) and the enumeration registry mapping every enum to its owner document. The registry indexes only — never list enum values here.
agent_hints.input_context: Owner documents for enums are fixed: measurement_class in CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md; variable_type in DECISION_SPACE.md; direction in OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md; constraint_kind / lifecycle_stage / on_violation in FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md; aggregation_method in EVALUATION_SPEC.md; final_choice_rule / scalarization_method in MULTI_OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md; evaluation_cost / evaluation_noise / method_id in ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md; objective_structure / solver_family / optimization_class in DISCRETE_SEARCH_METHODS.md; acquisition_function / trigger_type in SAMPLE_EFFICIENT_ADAPTIVE_METHODS.md; deployment_status in DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md; owner_module in HANDOFF.md.
agent_hints.validation: The registry must map every enum listed in input_context to exactly one owner and contain no enum values. Best-found / near-optimal must be defined as the default wording instead of global optimum. The estimator Ū(x) = U(x) + ε must appear. Id conventions must include the config version form and the rule that upstream ids are cited verbatim.

description.th: คำหลักที่ทุกเอกสารใช้ตรงกัน
description.en: Core words every document uses identically.

items.text_th: Decision Variable / Search Space — ค่าที่ optimizer มีสิทธิ์เปลี่ยน / ชุด configuration ทั้งหมดที่อนุญาตให้ลอง (X); optimization ไม่ optimize 'ระบบทั้งหมด' แต่ optimize ตัวแปรที่อนุญาตให้เปลี่ยน
items.text_en: Decision Variable / Search Space — the value the optimizer is allowed to change / the set of all configurations allowed to be tried (X); optimization never optimizes 'the whole system' but the variables allowed to change

items.text_th: Objective Function / Utility — กติกาที่เปลี่ยน candidate เป็นค่าที่เปรียบเทียบได้ (f(x), U(x)); Constraint / Feasible Region — สิ่งที่บอกว่า candidate ใดใช้ไม่ได้ตั้งแต่แรก (X_feasible)
items.text_en: Objective Function / Utility — the rule turning a candidate into a comparable value (f(x), U(x)); Constraint / Feasible Region — what says which candidates are unusable from the start (X_feasible)

items.text_th: Candidate / Baseline / Best-Found — configuration หนึ่งที่ถูก evaluate / configuration อ้างอิงที่ง่ายที่สุด (เช่น top-relevance-only) / candidate ที่ดีที่สุดที่พบภายใต้ budget — ไม่เรียก global optimum
items.text_en: Candidate / Baseline / Best-Found — one evaluated configuration / the simplest reference configuration (e.g. top-relevance-only) / the best candidate found under the budget — never called global optimum

items.text_th: Evaluator / Proxy / Measurement Class — กลไกสร้าง evidence ของ task value / signal ที่แทน task value โดยอ้อม / label ห้าค่าที่นิยามใน CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md เท่านั้น
items.text_en: Evaluator / Proxy / Measurement Class — the mechanism producing evidence of task value / a signal standing in for task value indirectly / the five-value label defined only in CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md

items.text_th: Pareto Dominance / Frontier — x1 dominates x2 เมื่อไม่แย่กว่าในทุก objective และดีกว่าอย่างน้อยหนึ่ง / ชุด candidate ที่ไม่มีตัวไหนชนะทุกด้าน (MULTI_OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md); Heuristic vs Exact — greedy เป็น heuristic; exact อ้างได้เฉพาะ formulation ที่ระบุ (DISCRETE_SEARCH_METHODS.md)
items.text_en: Pareto Dominance / Frontier — x1 dominates x2 when it is no worse on every objective and better on at least one / the set of candidates none of which wins on every axis (MULTI_OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md); Heuristic vs Exact — greedy is a heuristic; exact is claimed only for the stated formulation (DISCRETE_SEARCH_METHODS.md)

items.text_th: Adaptive ≠ Online ≠ Algorithm Selection ≠ Meta-Optimization — ปรับ strategy เมื่อ environment เปลี่ยน / update decision ระหว่าง operation / เลือก optimizer จาก problem characteristics / optimize ตัว optimizer เอง (SAMPLE_EFFICIENT_ADAPTIVE_METHODS.md)
items.text_en: Adaptive ≠ Online ≠ Algorithm Selection ≠ Meta-Optimization — adjust strategy when the environment changes / update decisions during operation / choose the optimizer from problem characteristics / optimize the optimizer itself (SAMPLE_EFFICIENT_ADAPTIVE_METHODS.md)

description.th: สัญลักษณ์ที่ใช้ตรงกันทุกเอกสาร
description.en: Symbols used identically across documents.

items.text_th: Standard Form — maximize f(x) subject to g_i(x) ≤ 0, h_j(x) = 0, x ∈ X; X_feasible = {x ∈ X : all hard constraints satisfied}; x* = arg max_{x ∈ X_feasible} f(x)
items.text_en: Standard Form — maximize f(x) subject to g_i(x) ≤ 0, h_j(x) = 0, x ∈ X; X_feasible = {x ∈ X : all hard constraints satisfied}; x* = arg max_{x ∈ X_feasible} f(x)

items.text_th: Utility and Estimator — U(x) = Σ_j w_j · q_j(x) − λ · Cost(x) (normalize ก่อนรวม); Ū(x) = U(x) + ε โดย ε คือ measurement noise / evaluator disagreement / sampling variation
items.text_en: Utility and Estimator — U(x) = Σ_j w_j · q_j(x) − λ · Cost(x) (normalize before combining); Ū(x) = U(x) + ε where ε is measurement noise / evaluator disagreement / sampling variation

items.text_th: Selection Symbols — x_i ∈ {0,1} include/exclude; MarginalUtility(i | S) = Relevance(i) + Authority(i) + Novelty(i | S) − Redundancy(i, S); score(i | S) = MarginalUtility(i | S) / TokenCost(i); knapsack maximize Σ v_i x_i subject to Σ c_i x_i ≤ B
items.text_en: Selection Symbols — x_i ∈ {0,1} include/exclude; MarginalUtility(i | S) = Relevance(i) + Authority(i) + Novelty(i | S) − Redundancy(i, S); score(i | S) = MarginalUtility(i | S) / TokenCost(i); knapsack maximize Σ v_i x_i subject to Σ c_i x_i ≤ B

items.text_th: Method Symbols — gradient θ_{t+1} = θ_t + η ∇f(θ_t) (projection Proj_X เมื่อมี bounds); evolutionary P_{t+1} = Variation(Selection(Evaluate(P_t))); Bayesian x_next = arg max_x Acquisition(x | D) บน surrogate p(f | D); adaptive Strategy_{t+1} = Update(Strategy_t, Evidence_t)
items.text_en: Method Symbols — gradient θ_{t+1} = θ_t + η ∇f(θ_t) (projection Proj_X when bounded); evolutionary P_{t+1} = Variation(Selection(Evaluate(P_t))); Bayesian x_next = arg max_x Acquisition(x | D) on surrogate p(f | D); adaptive Strategy_{t+1} = Update(Strategy_t, Evidence_t)

description.th: รูปแบบ id ที่ทุก contract, log และ example ใช้
description.en: Id formats used by every contract, log and example.

items.text_th: Experiment and Run Ids — exp_<system>_<yyyy_mm_dd>_<seq> (เช่น exp_briefdesk_2026_09_04_003), run_<system>_<yyyy_mm_dd>_<seq>, evt_<seq> ต่อ candidate event; candidate_id = cand_<seq> หรือ hash ของ deterministic serialization
items.text_en: Experiment and Run Ids — exp_<system>_<yyyy_mm_dd>_<seq> (e.g. exp_briefdesk_2026_09_04_003), run_<system>_<yyyy_mm_dd>_<seq>, evt_<seq> per candidate event; candidate_id = cand_<seq> or the hash of the deterministic serialization

items.text_th: Dataset and Evaluator Ids — bench_<system>_v<N> และ bench_<system>_v<N>_holdout; evaluator เป็นคู่ id/version เช่น briefdesk_judge/v2 พร้อม model_name เมื่อเป็น MODEL_JUDGMENT
items.text_en: Dataset and Evaluator Ids — bench_<system>_v<N> and bench_<system>_v<N>_holdout; an evaluator is an id/version pair e.g. briefdesk_judge/v2 with model_name when it is MODEL_JUDGMENT

items.text_th: Configuration Versions — <system>_<purpose>_config/vX.Y (เช่น briefdesk_retrieval_config/v1.1); deploy ใหม่ = version ใหม่ ไม่เขียนทับ; rollback target อ้าง version ก่อนหน้า
items.text_en: Configuration Versions — <system>_<purpose>_config/vX.Y (e.g. briefdesk_retrieval_config/v1.1); a new deployment is a new version, never an overwrite; the rollback target names the previous version

items.text_th: Upstream Refs — context_id, manifest id (mf_…), validation report id (vr_…) และ knowledge ids (kn_…) ถูกอ้างตามที่ formalization layer ออกให้ — layer นี้ไม่ออก id ใหม่แทน
items.text_en: Upstream Refs — context_id, manifest id (mf_…), validation report id (vr_…) and knowledge ids (kn_…) are cited exactly as issued by the formalization layer — this layer never re-issues them

items.text_th: Contract Version Strings — schema_version รูปแบบ context_optimization_contract/vX.Y + concept, context_optimization_run/vX.Y, context_optimization_event/vX.Y; string ของ workshop คงเดิม, extension ของ template bump minor และระบุสิ่งที่เพิ่ม; หัวข้อ section ใช้รูปย่อ <concept>/vX.Y แทน contract เดียวกัน
items.text_en: Contract Version Strings — schema_version takes the form context_optimization_contract/vX.Y + concept, context_optimization_run/vX.Y, context_optimization_event/vX.Y; workshop strings stay verbatim, template extensions bump the minor version and state what they add; section headings use the shorthand <concept>/vX.Y for the same contract

description.th: index ของทุก enum → owner document; ค่าถูกนิยามที่ owner เท่านั้น
description.en: Index of every enum → owner document; values are defined at the owner only.

items.text_th: Foundation Enums — measurement_class → CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md; mathematical_scope → PROBLEM_FORMULATION.md; variable_type → DECISION_SPACE.md; direction, weight_source (application-defined) → OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md; constraint_kind, lifecycle_stage, on_violation → FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md
items.text_en: Foundation Enums — measurement_class → CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md; mathematical_scope → PROBLEM_FORMULATION.md; variable_type → DECISION_SPACE.md; direction, weight_source (application-defined) → OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md; constraint_kind, lifecycle_stage, on_violation → FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md

items.text_th: Measurement and Selection Enums — aggregation_method (application-defined) → EVALUATION_SPEC.md; final_choice_rule, scalarization_method (application-defined) → MULTI_OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md; evaluation_cost, evaluation_noise, method_id (application-defined names) → ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md
items.text_en: Measurement and Selection Enums — aggregation_method (application-defined) → EVALUATION_SPEC.md; final_choice_rule, scalarization_method (application-defined) → MULTI_OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md; evaluation_cost, evaluation_noise, method_id (application-defined names) → ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md

items.text_th: Method Enums — objective_structure, solver_family, optimization_class (application-defined) → DISCRETE_SEARCH_METHODS.md; acquisition_function (application-defined), trigger_type → SAMPLE_EFFICIENT_ADAPTIVE_METHODS.md
items.text_en: Method Enums — objective_structure, solver_family, optimization_class (application-defined) → DISCRETE_SEARCH_METHODS.md; acquisition_function (application-defined), trigger_type → SAMPLE_EFFICIENT_ADAPTIVE_METHODS.md

items.text_th: Operations Enums — deployment_status (application-defined) → DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md; owner_module (ใช้ verbatim จาก formalization layer) → HANDOFF.md
items.text_en: Operations Enums — deployment_status (application-defined) → DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md; owner_module (verbatim from the formalization layer) → HANDOFF.md

items.text_th: Registry Rule — เอกสารใดต้องใช้ enum ให้อ้าง owner ด้วยชื่อไฟล์ ไม่ copy ค่าซ้ำ; เพิ่มค่าใหม่ = แก้ที่ owner แล้ว bump contract version ของ owner
items.text_en: Registry Rule — any document needing an enum cites the owner by filename and never copies the values; adding a value = editing the owner and bumping the owner's contract version

description.th: กติกาเจ็ดข้อที่ใช้กับทุก Engineering Contract ในชุดนี้ + Contract Syntax Rule (type / allowed_values / nullable / required แยก field) — และเป็น owner ของ enum measurement_class ที่ทุก objective signal, evaluator และ event ต้องประกาศ
description.en: The seven rules applying to every Engineering Contract in this set plus the Contract Syntax Rule (type / allowed_values / nullable / required as separate fields) — and the owner of the measurement_class enum every objective signal, evaluator and event must declare.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md stating the seven Contract Governance Rules that apply to every Engineering Contract in this set (null means calibrate; measurement class everywhere; proxy named as proxy; hard constraints outside the score; record everything; tests from acceptance criteria; contract is an implementation spec), the Contract Syntax Rule (type / allowed_values / nullable / required as separate parseable keys, no pseudo-types, export to JSON Schema / Pydantic for strictness, version discipline for template extensions), the measurement_class enum with its five values defined here only and their recording obligations, and the prohibited claims / wording discipline (no universal weights, no false optimality, no proxy relabelling, no Bayes confusion). Map BriefDesk's objective signals to measurement classes as the worked example.
agent_hints.input_context: The seven rules and the syntax rule are quoted from the workshop's 'Contract Governance Rules for Claude Code / Codex' section. measurement_class values: DIRECT_METRIC, PROXY, MODEL_JUDGMENT, HUMAN_LABEL, PRODUCTION_OUTCOME — this document is the only place they are defined; OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md, EVALUATION_SPEC.md and EXPERIMENT_LOG.md reference them.
agent_hints.validation: All seven rules and the syntax rule must appear with their exact intent. measurement_class must be defined exactly once with five values and per-value recording obligations. The BriefDesk mapping must assign a class to every objective component. The four prohibited-claim families must each have at least one forbidden sentence and its allowed replacement.

description.th: กติกาที่ Claude Code / Codex และทีมต้องทำตามเมื่ออ่านหรือ implement contract
description.en: Rules Claude Code / Codex and the team must follow when reading or implementing a contract.

items.text_th: Rule 1 Null Means Calibrate — value: null หรือ threshold: null หมายถึงห้ามเดาค่ากลาง; ต้อง calibrate จาก task-specific validation หรือ business policy และบันทึกที่มาของค่า
items.text_en: Rule 1 Null Means Calibrate — value: null or threshold: null means never guess a middle value; calibrate from task-specific validation or business policy and record the source

items.text_th: Rule 2 Measurement Class Everywhere — ทุก objective signal ระบุ measurement_class (enum ที่นิยามในเอกสารนี้); Rule 3 Proxy Named as Proxy — ถ้าใช้ proxy ให้ตั้งชื่อ output ให้สะท้อนว่าเป็น proxy และห้ามเรียกว่า true task value โดยไม่มี validation
items.text_en: Rule 2 Measurement Class Everywhere — every objective signal declares a measurement_class (the enum defined in this document); Rule 3 Proxy Named as Proxy — a proxy's output is named as a proxy and never called true task value without validation

items.text_th: Rule 4 Hard Constraints Outside the Score — hard constraints ถูก enforce แยกจาก weighted score เพื่อไม่ให้ objective อื่นชดเชย violation ที่ยอมรับไม่ได้ (contract ใน FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md)
items.text_en: Rule 4 Hard Constraints Outside the Score — hard constraints are enforced separately from the weighted score so no other objective compensates an unacceptable violation (contract in FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md)

items.text_th: Rule 5 Record Everything — ทุก experiment เก็บ candidate configuration, raw sub-scores, feasibility, evaluator version, evaluation cost และ random seed เมื่อเกี่ยวข้อง; Rule 6 Tests From Acceptance Criteria — Claude Code / Codex สร้าง unit tests จาก acceptance_criteria และเก็บ provenance ตาม contract
items.text_en: Rule 5 Record Everything — every experiment records candidate configuration, raw sub-scores, feasibility, evaluator version, evaluation cost and random seed where applicable; Rule 6 Tests From Acceptance Criteria — Claude Code / Codex generates unit tests from acceptance_criteria and keeps provenance per contract

items.text_th: Rule 7 Contract Is an Implementation Spec — contract เป็น implementation specification ไม่ใช่ source of truth ของ weights / thresholds; ค่าจริงอยู่ใน validated configuration ที่มี version และ provenance (EVALUATION_SPEC.md, DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md)
items.text_en: Rule 7 Contract Is an Implementation Spec — the contract is an implementation specification, not the source of truth for weights / thresholds; real values live in the validated, versioned configuration with provenance (EVALUATION_SPEC.md, DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md)

description.th: รูปแบบ field ที่ parse ได้ — ห้าม pseudo-type
description.en: Parseable field form — no pseudo-types.

items.text_th: Explicit Keys — field ที่ทีมต้อง validate ต่อเขียน type, allowed_values, nullable, required แยกเป็น key ที่ parse ได้; ห้าม pseudo-type เช่น A | B, array[string], object | null
items.text_en: Explicit Keys — a field the team must validate is written with separate parseable keys type, allowed_values, nullable, required; pseudo-types e.g. A | B, array[string] or object | null are forbidden

items.text_th: Canonical Example — measurement_class: {type: string, allowed_values: [DIRECT_METRIC, PROXY, MODEL_JUDGMENT, HUMAN_LABEL, PRODUCTION_OUTCOME], required: true}; array ใช้ item_type หรือ item_allowed_values; nested ใช้ item_schema
items.text_en: Canonical Example — measurement_class: {type: string, allowed_values: [DIRECT_METRIC, PROXY, MODEL_JUDGMENT, HUMAN_LABEL, PRODUCTION_OUTCOME], required: true}; arrays use item_type or item_allowed_values; nested objects use item_schema

items.text_th: Machine-Parseable, Export for Strictness — contract เป็น machine-parseable implementation spec สำหรับส่งต่อ Claude Code / Codex; strict runtime validation ทำโดย export field definitions เป็น JSON Schema / Pydantic model ตาม SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md; contract block ของ workshop ถูก quote ด้วยรูปย่อเดิม (เช่น budget integer, surrogate_model required) — รูป parseable เต็มตาม syntax rule อยู่ใน SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md
items.text_en: Machine-Parseable, Export for Strictness — contracts are machine-parseable implementation specs handed to Claude Code / Codex; strict runtime validation is done by exporting field definitions to JSON Schema / Pydantic models per SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md; workshop contract blocks are quoted in their original shorthand (e.g. budget integer, surrogate_model required) — the fully parseable form per the syntax rule lives in SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md

items.text_th: Version Discipline — schema_version ของ workshop คงเดิม; template extension bump minor พร้อมประโยค 'extends workshop vX by adding …'; ค่า enum ที่ template คิดเพิ่มถูก label ว่า application-defined example values
items.text_en: Version Discipline — workshop schema_version strings stay verbatim; a template extension bumps the minor version with an 'extends workshop vX by adding …' sentence; enum values invented by the template are labelled application-defined example values

description.th: enum เดียวที่ทุก signal ต้องประกาศ — นิยามที่นี่ที่เดียว
description.en: The single enum every signal must declare — defined here only.

items.text_th: DIRECT_METRIC — คำนวณได้ตรงจาก candidate/output โดยไม่ต้องตีความ เช่น token_cost, distinct cluster count, source_authority จาก tier map; PROXY — signal ที่แทน task value โดยอ้อม เช่น semantic similarity, embedding-distance novelty
items.text_en: DIRECT_METRIC — computed directly from the candidate/output without interpretation, e.g. token_cost, distinct cluster count, source_authority from a tier map; PROXY — a signal standing in for task value indirectly, e.g. semantic similarity, embedding-distance novelty

items.text_th: MODEL_JUDGMENT — LLM-as-judge หรือ model scorer ต้องบันทึก model_name และ evaluator version; HUMAN_LABEL — expert หรือ reviewer label ต้องบันทึก sample_size และ rubric version; PRODUCTION_OUTCOME — ผลจริงจากการใช้งาน เช่น save / forward / follow-up action
items.text_en: MODEL_JUDGMENT — an LLM-as-judge or model scorer, must record model_name and evaluator version; HUMAN_LABEL — expert or reviewer labels, must record sample_size and rubric version; PRODUCTION_OUTCOME — real usage outcomes e.g. save / forward / follow-up action

items.text_th: Usage Sites — objective components (OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md), evaluator declaration (EVALUATION_SPEC.md) และทุก event (EXPERIMENT_LOG.md) ต้องมี field นี้ required: true; ค่านอก enum ถูก reject
items.text_en: Usage Sites — objective components (OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md), the evaluator declaration (EVALUATION_SPEC.md) and every event (EXPERIMENT_LOG.md) carry this field with required: true; values outside the enum are rejected

items.text_th: BriefDesk Mapping — strategic_relevance_proxy MODEL_JUDGMENT (briefdesk_judge/v2), novelty_proxy PROXY, source_authority DIRECT_METRIC, diversity DIRECT_METRIC, decision_usefulness_proxy MODEL_JUDGMENT (judge), decision_usefulness HUMAN_LABEL (reviewer), decision_usefulness_outcome PRODUCTION_OUTCOME (save/forward), token_cost DIRECT_METRIC — หนึ่ง component หนึ่ง class
items.text_en: BriefDesk Mapping — strategic_relevance_proxy MODEL_JUDGMENT (briefdesk_judge/v2), novelty_proxy PROXY, source_authority DIRECT_METRIC, diversity DIRECT_METRIC, decision_usefulness_proxy MODEL_JUDGMENT (judge), decision_usefulness HUMAN_LABEL (reviewer), decision_usefulness_outcome PRODUCTION_OUTCOME (save/forward), token_cost DIRECT_METRIC — one component, one class

description.th: ประโยคที่ห้ามปรากฏในเอกสาร, log หรือ report ของ optimization
description.en: Sentences that must not appear in optimization documents, logs or reports.

items.text_th: No Universal Weights — ห้าม invent weight สากล; weight ตัวอย่างใน workshop (เช่น 0.35·StrategicRelevance) เป็น illustrative และต้องเขียนกำกับว่า task-specific ที่ยัง calibrate ไม่เสร็จ
items.text_en: No Universal Weights — never invent universal weights; workshop example weights (e.g. 0.35·StrategicRelevance) are illustrative and must be marked task-specific and uncalibrated

items.text_th: No False Optimality — greedy เรียกว่า greedy heuristic; exact optimality อ้างได้เฉพาะ formulation + solver scope ที่ระบุ; gradient ascent ให้ local optimum; BO ภายใต้ budget จำกัดให้ best-found; Pareto choice เป็น business choice ไม่ใช่ mathematical universal optimum
items.text_en: No False Optimality — greedy is called a greedy heuristic; exact optimality is claimed only for the stated formulation + solver scope; gradient ascent yields local optima; BO under a limited budget yields best-found; a Pareto choice is a business choice, not a mathematical universal optimum

items.text_th: No Proxy Relabelling — 'weighted proxy score' ไม่ใช่ 'true quality'; 'semantic relevance ดีขึ้น' ไม่ใช่ 'product ดีขึ้น' จนกว่าจะมี holdout + production outcome
items.text_en: No Proxy Relabelling — a 'weighted proxy score' is not 'true quality'; 'semantic relevance improved' is not 'the product improved' until holdout + production outcome confirm it

items.text_th: No Bayes Confusion — ห้ามอ้างว่า Bayesian Optimization ใช้ Bayes theorem ให้คะแนน context relevance โดยตรง; คำว่า Bayesian ใน BO หมายถึง surrogate ที่จัดการ uncertainty ของ objective เท่านั้น
items.text_en: No Bayes Confusion — never claim Bayesian Optimization uses Bayes theorem to score context relevance directly; 'Bayesian' in BO refers only to the surrogate handling objective uncertainty

description.th: Contract context_optimization_contract/v1.0 concept problem_formulation — แปลง goal กว้าง ๆ ให้เป็น optimization problem ที่มี task_goal, decision_variables, objective_definition, hard_constraints, evaluation_method; mathematical scope discrete / continuous / mixed ต้องประกาศก่อนพูดถึง optimizer; BriefDesk สองโจทย์ถูก formulate ที่นี่
description.en: Contract context_optimization_contract/v1.0 concept problem_formulation — turning a vague goal into an optimization problem with task_goal, decision_variables, objective_definition, hard_constraints and evaluation_method; the mathematical scope discrete / continuous / mixed is declared before any optimizer is mentioned; BriefDesk's two problems are formulated here.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a PROBLEM_FORMULATION.md that explains why formulation precedes everything (vague goal → decision → objective → constraints → optimization problem), declares the mathematical scope (discrete / combinatorial, continuous, mixed) with the Engineering Rule that variable types are declared before any optimizer and that float storage is not differentiability, presents the standard form, and writes the contract context_optimization_contract/v1.0 concept problem_formulation with its required fields, four validation rules, three acceptance criteria and the OptimizationProblem dataclass sketch. Formulate BriefDesk's two problems — briefdesk_brief_selection (discrete) and briefdesk_retrieval_tuning (mixed) — in contract form, citing inherited hard-constraint ids from the handoff package, and close with the use-cases-and-impact table.
agent_hints.input_context: Contract fields and text are quoted from workshop section 5. The BriefDesk numbers are: 12 candidate knowledge ids, 8,000-token budget, top_k ∈ {8..30}, dedupe_threshold ∈ [0.75, 0.95], retrieval_strategy ∈ {dense, hybrid, authority_first}, four component weights. Objective weights are never given values here.
agent_hints.validation: The contract block must carry schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0 and concept problem_formulation. Both BriefDesk problems must name task_goal, decision variables with types, objective direction per component, hard constraints and evaluation method, and declare their mathematical scope. The Engineering Rule about float ≠ differentiable must appear. No algorithm may be selected in this document.

description.th: goal กว้าง ๆ ยังไม่ใช่ optimization problem ที่ implement ได้
description.en: A vague goal is not yet an implementable optimization problem.

items.text_th: Vague to Formal — 'ทำ RAG ให้ดีขึ้น' หรือ 'ให้ข่าวตรง persona มากขึ้น' ยังไม่ชัดว่าอะไรคือ decision, metric และ constraint; Problem Formulation คือการแปลง business/task goal ให้เป็น problem statement ที่วัดและค้นหา solution ได้
items.text_en: Vague to Formal — 'make RAG better' or 'make news match the persona more' does not say what the decision, metric and constraint are; Problem Formulation turns the business/task goal into a problem statement that can be measured and searched

items.text_th: GIST — ถ้าบอกไม่ได้ว่า 'เรากำลังเลือกอะไร เพื่อให้อะไรดีขึ้น ภายใต้ข้อจำกัดอะไร' ยัง optimize ไม่ได้
items.text_en: GIST — if one cannot say 'what we are choosing, to improve what, under which limits', optimization cannot start

items.text_th: Flow — Vague Goal → Decision (เช่น เลือก subset ของ chunks) → Objective (เช่น maximize answer quality) → Constraints (เช่น ≤ 8K tokens, citation required) → Optimization Problem
items.text_en: Flow — Vague Goal → Decision (e.g. choose a subset of chunks) → Objective (e.g. maximize answer quality) → Constraints (e.g. ≤ 8K tokens, citation required) → Optimization Problem

description.th: Discrete, Continuous และ Mixed ต้องแยกให้ชัดก่อนเลือก optimizer
description.en: Discrete, Continuous and Mixed must be separated before choosing an optimizer.

items.text_th: Discrete / Combinatorial — เลือก chunk ไหน, เลือกข่าวไหน, เลือก tool / strategy ใด; Continuous — ปรับ weight, temperature-like parameter, threshold/allocation ที่ model ไว้ต่อเนื่อง; Mixed — top_k (integer) + retrieval strategy (categorical) + relevance weight (continuous) + include/exclude (binary)
items.text_en: Discrete / Combinatorial — which chunk, which news item, which tool / strategy; Continuous — weights, temperature-like parameters, thresholds/allocations modelled continuously; Mixed — top_k (integer) + retrieval strategy (categorical) + relevance weight (continuous) + include/exclude (binary)

items.text_th: Engineering Rule — ต้อง declare variable type ก่อนเลือก optimizer เสมอ และห้ามใช้คำว่า differentiable / gradient-based เพียงเพราะค่าถูกเก็บเป็น float ใน code (รายละเอียด type ใน DECISION_SPACE.md, ผลต่อ algorithm ใน ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md)
items.text_en: Engineering Rule — always declare the variable type before choosing an optimizer, and never say differentiable / gradient-based merely because the value is stored as a float in code (types in DECISION_SPACE.md, effect on algorithms in ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md)

items.text_th: Standard Form — maximize f(x) subject to g_i(x) ≤ 0, h_j(x) = 0, x ∈ X; ไม่จำเป็นต้องใช้รูปนี้ใน code ทุกครั้ง แต่ mental model นี้แยกเป้าหมายกับข้อจำกัดออกจากกัน
items.text_en: Standard Form — maximize f(x) subject to g_i(x) ≤ 0, h_j(x) = 0, x ∈ X; the code need not use this form every time, but the mental model separates goal from limits

description.th: required fields, validation rules และ acceptance criteria ของ contract
description.en: The contract's required fields, validation rules and acceptance criteria.

items.text_th: Header — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0, concept problem_formulation, purpose 'Convert a context-engineering goal into an explicit optimization problem'
items.text_en: Header — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0, concept problem_formulation, purpose 'Convert a context-engineering goal into an explicit optimization problem'

items.text_th: Required Fields — task_goal (string), decision_variables (array, min_items 1), objective_definition (object), hard_constraints (array), evaluation_method (object) — รายละเอียดของแต่ละ object อยู่ใน DECISION_SPACE.md, OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md, FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md, EVALUATION_SPEC.md; mathematical_scope {type string, allowed_values [discrete, continuous, mixed], required true} — enum ที่ template เพิ่มและเป็น owner ที่นี่ (workshop ใช้เป็น prose)
items.text_en: Required Fields — task_goal (string), decision_variables (array, min_items 1), objective_definition (object), hard_constraints (array), evaluation_method (object) — each object is detailed in DECISION_SPACE.md, OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md, FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md, EVALUATION_SPEC.md; mathematical_scope {type string, allowed_values [discrete, continuous, mixed], required true} — an enum the template adds and owns here (the workshop states it in prose)

items.text_th: Validation Rules — ทุก decision variable มี type และ allowed domain; objective direction ชัด (maximize หรือ minimize); hard constraints ต้อง machine-checkable หรือ mark HUMAN_REVIEW อย่างชัดเจน; evaluation method ระบุว่าเป็น direct metric, proxy, model judgment หรือ human label (หนึ่งในห้าค่าของ measurement_class ตาม CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md)
items.text_en: Validation Rules — every decision variable has a type and allowed domain; the objective direction is explicit (maximize or minimize); hard constraints are machine-checkable or explicitly marked HUMAN_REVIEW; the evaluation method states whether it is a direct metric, proxy, model judgment or human label (one of the five measurement_class values per CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md)

items.text_th: Acceptance Criteria — candidate configuration represent ได้โดยไม่กำกวม; feasibility ตรวจได้ก่อน deployment; candidate สองตัวเปรียบเทียบได้ด้วย evaluation method ที่ประกาศ
items.text_en: Acceptance Criteria — a candidate configuration can be represented unambiguously; feasibility can be checked before deployment; two candidates can be compared using the declared evaluation method

items.text_th: Python Sketch — dataclass OptimizationProblem(name, decision_space, objective: Callable, hard_constraints: list[Callable], metadata) พร้อม is_feasible(candidate) = all(rule(candidate)); เป็น teaching sketch — typed model จริงอยู่ใน SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md
items.text_en: Python Sketch — dataclass OptimizationProblem(name, decision_space, objective: Callable, hard_constraints: list[Callable], metadata) with is_feasible(candidate) = all(rule(candidate)); a teaching sketch — the real typed model lives in SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md

description.th: BriefDesk สองโจทย์ในรูป contract
description.en: BriefDesk's two problems in contract form.

items.text_th: briefdesk_brief_selection — task_goal 'เลือก brief items ที่มี strategic value สูงสุดจาก 12 candidate knowledge ids ภายใต้ 8,000 tokens พร้อม citation ครบ'; decision include_item_i ∈ {0,1} × 12; objective maximize usefulness + relevance + novelty + authority + diversity, minimize token_cost; hard constraints Σ tokens_i x_i ≤ 8,000, ทุก item มี source_id, source ไม่อยู่ใน blocklist, citation trace ได้; evaluation judge + reviewer + production outcome; scope discrete
items.text_en: briefdesk_brief_selection — task_goal 'choose the brief items with the highest strategic value from 12 candidate knowledge ids under 8,000 tokens with complete citations'; decision include_item_i ∈ {0,1} × 12; objective maximize usefulness + relevance + novelty + authority + diversity, minimize token_cost; hard constraints Σ tokens_i x_i ≤ 8,000, every item has a source_id, no blocklisted source, citations traceable; evaluation judge + reviewer + production outcome; scope discrete

items.text_th: briefdesk_retrieval_tuning — task_goal 'ปรับ retrieval และ ranking parameters ให้ brief benchmark ได้ decision_usefulness_proxy สูงสุด (validate ด้วย reviewer labels) ภายใต้ budget'; decision top_k ∈ {8..30}, dedupe_threshold ∈ [0.75, 0.95], retrieval_strategy ∈ {dense, hybrid, authority_first}, component_weights ∈ [0,1]^4; objective maximize decision_usefulness_proxy + diversity, minimize token_cost; hard constraints เดิมทุกข้อ + evaluation budget; evaluation cost high; scope mixed
items.text_en: briefdesk_retrieval_tuning — task_goal 'tune retrieval and ranking parameters so benchmark briefs reach the highest decision_usefulness_proxy (validated against reviewer labels) under budget'; decision top_k ∈ {8..30}, dedupe_threshold ∈ [0.75, 0.95], retrieval_strategy ∈ {dense, hybrid, authority_first}, component_weights ∈ [0,1]^4; objective maximize decision_usefulness_proxy + diversity, minimize token_cost; same hard constraints + evaluation budget; evaluation cost high; scope mixed

items.text_th: Inherited Constraints — hard constraints citation_source_required และ no_fabricated_citation มาจาก handoff package (instr_citation_required_003, instr_no_fabricated_citation_004) — formulation อ้าง id เดิม ไม่เขียนกติกาใหม่ (HANDOFF.md)
items.text_en: Inherited Constraints — the hard constraints citation_source_required and no_fabricated_citation come from the handoff package (instr_citation_required_003, instr_no_fabricated_citation_004) — the formulation cites the original ids and never rewrites the rules (HANDOFF.md)

items.text_th: Use Cases and Impact — news briefing: 'เลือกข่าวดี ๆ' กว้างเกินไป → selection + utility + token constraint ลดการ tune แบบเดาสุ่ม; RAG tuning: ระบุ decision variables และ metric ทำให้ experiment ชัด; agent workflow: define objective + cost + dependency constraints ทำให้เลือก flow อย่างมีเหตุผล
items.text_en: Use Cases and Impact — news briefing: 'pick good news' is too vague → selection + utility + token constraint cuts guess-based tuning; RAG tuning: naming decision variables and metrics sharpens experiments; agent workflow: defining objective + cost + dependency constraints makes flow choices reasoned

description.th: โครงสร้างของ optimization loop — concept map, components (candidate generator, feasibility checker, evaluators, optimizer, experiment store, deployment gate, monitor), สาม paradigm Prompts / Programming / Protocols, ADR หลัก และ 12-step methodology ที่เป็นแกนของชุดเอกสาร
description.en: Structure of the optimization loop — concept map, components (candidate generator, feasibility checker, evaluators, optimizer, experiment store, deployment gate, monitor), the three paradigms Prompts / Programming / Protocols, key ADRs and the 12-step methodology that organizes the document set.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate an ARCHITECTURE.md (alias ADR.md) describing the optimization loop: the concept map (decision variables → search space → objective → constraints → evaluation → optimizer → near-optimal solution, the general form and the nine-point mental model), the loop components with owning documents (candidate generator, feasibility checker, evaluators, post-execution checker, optimizer, experiment store, deployment gate + monitor) and the data flow, the three paradigms Prompts / Programming / Protocols with what each is allowed to do, four architecture decisions (baseline first; hard constraints outside the score; vector scores retained; near-optimal wording with the local vs global optimum distinction) and the twelve-step methodology mapped to documents. Use BriefDesk only as a passing illustration — contracts live downstream.
agent_hints.input_context: The twelve steps are quoted from workshop section 19; the three paradigms from section 22; local vs global optimum from Appendix C. Every component must point to the document that owns its contract; this document owns no enum. The twelve steps and paradigm taxonomy trace back to PROBLEM_FORMULATION.md; contract-authoring rules this document must follow are CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md's.
agent_hints.validation: The concept map, the four ADRs and all twelve steps with their owning documents must appear. The three paradigms must each list what they do and PROMPTS must carry the 'never decide weight/threshold' restriction. The local vs global optimum distinction must end with best-found / near-optimal as the default wording.

description.th: ลำดับ concept จาก decision variables ถึง near-optimal solution
description.en: Concept order from decision variables to a near-optimal solution.

items.text_th: Chain — Decision Variables ('จะเลือก/ปรับอะไร?') → Search Space ('ค่าที่เป็นไปได้') → Objective Function ('อะไรคือดีกว่า') → Constraints ('ขอบเขตที่ยอมรับได้') → Evaluation ('วัด objective ได้จริงอย่างไร') → Optimizer ('ค้นหาอย่างไร') → Optimal / Near-Optimal Solution
items.text_en: Chain — Decision Variables ('what is chosen/tuned?') → Search Space ('possible values') → Objective Function ('what is better') → Constraints ('acceptable bounds') → Evaluation ('how the objective is actually measured') → Optimizer ('how to search') → Optimal / Near-Optimal Solution

items.text_th: General Form — x* = arg max_x f(x), x ∈ X_feasible; สำหรับ Context Engineering A* = arg max_A Utility(A; task, user, state) subject to Constraints(A) satisfied (สัญลักษณ์ใน GLOSSARY.md)
items.text_en: General Form — x* = arg max_x f(x), x ∈ X_feasible; for Context Engineering A* = arg max_A Utility(A; task, user, state) subject to Constraints(A) satisfied (symbols in GLOSSARY.md)

items.text_th: Nine-Point Mental Model — Problem, Decision Variables, Objective, Constraints, Evaluation, Search Space, Algorithm, Validation, Adaptation — แต่ละจุด map ไปเอกสารหนึ่งฉบับในชุดนี้
items.text_en: Nine-Point Mental Model — Problem, Decision Variables, Objective, Constraints, Evaluation, Search Space, Algorithm, Validation, Adaptation — each point maps to one document in this set

description.th: ส่วนประกอบของ optimization loop และสิ่งที่แต่ละส่วนรับผิดชอบ
description.en: Components of the optimization loop and what each owns.

items.text_th: Candidate Generator — สร้าง configuration จาก search space (grid, random sample, mutation, acquisition argmax) และ serialize แบบ deterministic (DECISION_SPACE.md); Feasibility Checker — ตรวจ pre-execution hard constraints ก่อน evaluate, reject หรือ repair + log (FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md)
items.text_en: Candidate Generator — produces configurations from the search space (grid, random sample, mutation, acquisition argmax) and serializes them deterministically (DECISION_SPACE.md); Feasibility Checker — checks pre-execution hard constraints before evaluation, rejects or repairs + logs (FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md)

items.text_th: Evaluators — deterministic metrics, labeled benchmark, LLM judge, human expert, production outcome → Score + Uncertainty + Provenance (EVALUATION_SPEC.md); Post-Execution Checker — ตรวจ constraint ที่เห็นได้หลัง run เช่น citation_traceability
items.text_en: Evaluators — deterministic metrics, labeled benchmark, LLM judge, human expert, production outcome → Score + Uncertainty + Provenance (EVALUATION_SPEC.md); Post-Execution Checker — checks constraints visible only after the run, e.g. citation_traceability

items.text_th: Optimizer — method ที่เลือกจาก problem characteristics; ผลิต next candidates และ best/Pareto set; Experiment Store — เก็บ event ต่อ candidate ตาม EXPERIMENT_LOG.md; Deployment Gate + Monitor — holdout, risk review, versioned deploy, canary, drift monitor, re-optimize trigger (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md)
items.text_en: Optimizer — the method chosen from problem characteristics; produces next candidates and the best/Pareto set; Experiment Store — keeps one event per candidate per EXPERIMENT_LOG.md; Deployment Gate + Monitor — holdout, risk review, versioned deploy, canary, drift monitor, re-optimize trigger (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md)

items.text_th: Data Flow — Handoff package + problem formulation → Candidate Generator → Feasibility Checker → Run System → Evaluators → Optimizer → Experiment Store ⟲; Best-found → Holdout → Deployment Gate → Production → Monitor → (trigger) → Optimizer
items.text_en: Data Flow — Handoff package + problem formulation → Candidate Generator → Feasibility Checker → Run System → Evaluators → Optimizer → Experiment Store ⟲; Best-found → Holdout → Deployment Gate → Production → Monitor → (trigger) → Optimizer

description.th: Prompts define & analyze, Programming executes deterministically, Protocols orchestrate the learning loop
description.en: Prompts define & analyze, Programming executes deterministically, Protocols orchestrate the learning loop.

items.text_th: PROMPTS — formulate optimization problem, analyze trade-offs, interpret Pareto alternatives, propose candidate variables, generate evaluation rubrics (PROMPT_SPEC.md) — ห้ามใช้ prompt ตัดสินค่า weight/threshold
items.text_en: PROMPTS — formulate the optimization problem, analyze trade-offs, interpret Pareto alternatives, propose candidate variables, generate evaluation rubrics (PROMPT_SPEC.md) — never let a prompt decide weight/threshold values

items.text_th: PROGRAMMING — validate constraints, generate candidate configurations, compute objective components, run search algorithms, store experiment history, reproduce results (SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md)
items.text_en: PROGRAMMING — validate constraints, generate candidate configurations, compute objective components, run search algorithms, store experiment history, reproduce results (SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md)

items.text_th: PROTOCOLS — decide when to optimize, select optimizer, run evaluation, approve deployment, rollback, trigger re-optimization (RUNBOOK.md); flow: PROMPT 'define problem' → PROGRAM 'generate + evaluate reproducibly' → PROTOCOL 'when to optimize, what to deploy, how to roll back'
items.text_en: PROTOCOLS — decide when to optimize, select the optimizer, run evaluation, approve deployment, roll back, trigger re-optimization (RUNBOOK.md); flow: PROMPT 'define the problem' → PROGRAM 'generate + evaluate reproducibly' → PROTOCOL 'when to optimize, what to deploy, how to roll back'

description.th: ADR ที่ล็อกท่าทางของทั้งชุดเอกสาร
description.en: ADRs locking the stance of the whole document set.

items.text_th: ADR-1 Baseline First — ทุก problem เริ่มด้วย method ที่ง่ายที่สุดที่ search space อนุญาต (exhaustive/grid/random หรือ greedy) และเก็บผลเป็น reference ก่อน escalate (ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md)
items.text_en: ADR-1 Baseline First — every problem starts with the simplest method the search space allows (exhaustive/grid/random or greedy) and keeps the result as a reference before escalating (ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md)

items.text_th: ADR-2 Hard Constraints Outside the Score — feasibility เป็น gate ก่อน scoring และก่อน deployment ไม่ใช่ penalty term; penalty method ใช้กับ soft constraint หรือ temporary violation ระหว่าง search เท่านั้น (FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md)
items.text_en: ADR-2 Hard Constraints Outside the Score — feasibility is a gate before scoring and before deployment, not a penalty term; penalty methods apply only to soft constraints or temporary violations during search (FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md)

items.text_th: ADR-3 Vector Scores Retained — เก็บ per-objective scores + directions และ raw sub-scores เสมอ; scalarization เป็น view ที่ประกาศ final_choice_rule ไม่ใช่การทิ้งข้อมูล (MULTI_OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md)
items.text_en: ADR-3 Vector Scores Retained — always keep per-objective scores + directions and raw sub-scores; scalarization is a view with a declared final_choice_rule, never a loss of data (MULTI_OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md)

items.text_th: ADR-4 Near-Optimal Wording — objective ใน Context Engineering มัก non-convex, discrete และ noisy; global optimum = ดีที่สุดใน search space ทั้งหมด, local optimum = ดีที่สุดใน neighborhood; เอกสารใช้คำว่า near-optimal / best-found เว้นแต่พิสูจน์ได้ (CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md)
items.text_en: ADR-4 Near-Optimal Wording — Context Engineering objectives are often non-convex, discrete and noisy; global optimum = best in the whole search space, local optimum = best in a neighborhood; documents say near-optimal / best-found unless proven (CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md)

description.th: ลำดับงานสิบสองขั้นและเอกสารที่รองรับแต่ละขั้น
description.en: The twelve-step work order and the document supporting each step.

items.text_th: Steps 1-6 — Define Task (OPTIMIZATION_DOMAIN.md) → Formalize Context Components C = A(c1..c6) (handoff จาก formalization) → Define Decision Variables (DECISION_SPACE.md) → Define Objective(s) (OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md) → Define Hard / Soft Constraints (FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md) → Define Evaluation (EVALUATION_SPEC.md)
items.text_en: Steps 1-6 — Define Task (OPTIMIZATION_DOMAIN.md) → Formalize Context Components C = A(c1..c6) (handoff from formalization) → Define Decision Variables (DECISION_SPACE.md) → Define Objective(s) (OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md) → Define Hard / Soft Constraints (FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md) → Define Evaluation (EVALUATION_SPEC.md)

items.text_th: Steps 7-9 — Characterize Search Space (discrete / continuous / mixed / expensive) → Select Baseline Algorithm (ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md, method docs) → Run Optimization และ log candidate + score + feasibility + cost (OPTIMIZATION_RUN.md, EXPERIMENT_LOG.md)
items.text_en: Steps 7-9 — Characterize Search Space (discrete / continuous / mixed / expensive) → Select Baseline Algorithm (ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md, method docs) → Run Optimization logging candidate + score + feasibility + cost (OPTIMIZATION_RUN.md, EXPERIMENT_LOG.md)

items.text_th: Steps 10-12 — Validate on Holdout / Expert Review → Deploy Versioned Configuration → Monitor and Re-optimize (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md, RUNBOOK.md); GIST: Optimization Engineering = Problem Formulation + Measurement + Search + Validation + Learning Loop; TASKS.md ใช้ลำดับนี้เป็น milestone chain
items.text_en: Steps 10-12 — Validate on Holdout / Expert Review → Deploy Versioned Configuration → Monitor and Re-optimize (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md, RUNBOOK.md); GIST: Optimization Engineering = Problem Formulation + Measurement + Search + Validation + Learning Loop; TASKS.md uses this order as its milestone chain
