description.th: Contract ต่อ concept — decision space, objective, feasibility, evaluation, multi-objective, algorithm selection — ตามด้วย method-family contracts, master run contract และ experiment log
description.en: One contract per concept — decision space, objective, feasibility, evaluation, multi-objective, algorithm selection — followed by the method-family contracts, the master run contract and the experiment log.

description.th: Contract context_optimization_contract/v1.0 concept decision_space — ตัวแปรที่ optimizer มีสิทธิ์เปลี่ยนและชุดค่าที่อนุญาตให้ลอง; owner ของ enum variable_type (binary, integer, categorical, continuous, structured); กฎ fixed vs optimizable, deterministic serialization และ reject ค่านอก domain ก่อน evaluate
description.en: Contract context_optimization_contract/v1.0 concept decision_space — the variables the optimizer may change and the set of values allowed to be tried; owner of the variable_type enum (binary, integer, categorical, continuous, structured); rules for fixed vs optimizable, deterministic serialization and rejecting out-of-domain values before evaluation.

suggested_headings: Search Space Size and Grid Growth

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a DECISION_SPACE.md specifying the contract context_optimization_contract/v1.0 concept decision_space. Define decision variable vs search space and why the variable kind drives the algorithm; own the variable_type enum (binary, integer, categorical, continuous, structured) with the no-implicit-relaxation rule; write the contract (variables with name / type / domain / values / mutable, three rules, three acceptance criteria) plus the deterministic serialization rule that yields candidate_id; explain how to count the search space and the grid-growth warning; and tabulate BriefDesk's variables for both problems, marking fixed variables and stating which came from the handoff package.
agent_hints.input_context: variable_type values are defined here only; ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md and the method documents reference them. BriefDesk domains: top_k [8, 30], dedupe_threshold [0.75, 0.95], retrieval_strategy {dense, hybrid, authority_first}, four component weights in [0,1]; search space of the selection problem 2^12 = 4,096 (792 with exactly five items).
agent_hints.validation: variable_type must be defined exactly once with five values. Every BriefDesk variable must have type, domain and mutable. The serialization rule must state that candidate_id is a hash of the sorted, precision-rounded mapping. The 2^12 / 792 counts must appear. No optimizer may be chosen here.

description.th: algorithm ที่เหมาะขึ้นกับชนิดของ decision variable — แยก discrete selection จาก continuous tuning
description.en: The right algorithm depends on the kind of decision variable — separate discrete selection from continuous tuning.

items.text_th: Decision Variable vs Search Space — Decision Variable คือค่าที่ optimizer มีสิทธิ์เปลี่ยน; Search Space X คือชุดค่าหรือ configuration ทั้งหมดที่อนุญาตให้ลอง
items.text_en: Decision Variable vs Search Space — a Decision Variable is a value the optimizer may change; the Search Space X is the set of all values or configurations allowed to be tried

items.text_th: GIST — optimization ไม่ได้ optimize 'ระบบทั้งหมด' แบบลอย ๆ — มัน optimize ตัวแปรที่เราอนุญาตให้เปลี่ยน; การเลือกข่าวเป็น discrete selection ส่วนการปรับ weight เป็น continuous tuning หากไม่แยก จะใช้ algorithm ผิดประเภท (ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md)
items.text_en: GIST — optimization never optimizes 'the whole system' loosely — it optimizes the variables we allow to change; choosing news items is discrete selection while tuning weights is continuous tuning, and mixing them picks the wrong algorithm (ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md)

items.text_th: What Can Change — Binary include/exclude, Integer top_k = 3..20, Categorical reranker = A/B/C, Continuous relevance_weight ∈ [0,1], Structured pipeline configuration → รวมเป็น Search Space X
items.text_en: What Can Change — Binary include/exclude, Integer top_k = 3..20, Categorical reranker = A/B/C, Continuous relevance_weight ∈ [0,1], Structured pipeline configuration → together the Search Space X

description.th: enum variable_type นิยามที่นี่ที่เดียว — ทุก contract อื่นอ้าง
description.en: The variable_type enum defined here only — every other contract references it.

items.text_th: binary — x_i ∈ {0,1} include/exclude; integer — k ∈ {1,...,20} มี lower/upper bound; categorical — ค่าไม่มีลำดับ เช่น retrieval_strategy ∈ {dense, hybrid, graph}; continuous — ช่วงจริง เช่น w_relevance ∈ [0,1]; structured — configuration ซ้อน เช่น pipeline layout ที่ต้องมี serialization rule ของตัวเอง
items.text_en: binary — x_i ∈ {0,1} include/exclude; integer — k ∈ {1,...,20} with lower/upper bounds; categorical — unordered values, e.g. retrieval_strategy ∈ {dense, hybrid, graph}; continuous — a real interval, e.g. w_relevance ∈ [0,1]; structured — nested configuration e.g. a pipeline layout with its own serialization rule

items.text_th: Type Drives Method — binary/integer/categorical เป็น discrete → search, greedy, combinatorial, evolutionary; continuous → gradient เมื่อ smooth, ไม่เช่นนั้น evolutionary/Bayesian; mixed → evolutionary หรือ Bayesian ที่รองรับ mixed space (ตาราง ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md)
items.text_en: Type Drives Method — binary/integer/categorical are discrete → search, greedy, combinatorial, evolutionary; continuous → gradient when smooth, otherwise evolutionary/Bayesian; mixed → evolutionary or Bayesian methods supporting mixed spaces (table in ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md)

items.text_th: No Implicit Relaxation — ห้าม treat discrete variable เป็น differentiable โดยไม่มี explicit relaxation; ถ้าใช้ relaxation ต้องประกาศ mapping กลับ (rounding rule) และยอมรับว่า objective อาจกลายเป็น staircase (CONTINUOUS_POPULATION_METHODS.md)
items.text_en: No Implicit Relaxation — never treat a discrete variable as differentiable without an explicit relaxation; if a relaxation is used, declare the mapping back (rounding rule) and accept that the objective may become a staircase (CONTINUOUS_POPULATION_METHODS.md)

description.th: โครง contract, rules และ acceptance criteria
description.en: Contract structure, rules and acceptance criteria.

items.text_th: Header and Variables — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0, concept decision_space; variables[]: {name (string, required), type (variable_type, required), domain (bounded range หรือ finite set, required เมื่อทำได้), values (สำหรับ categorical), mutable (boolean, required)}
items.text_en: Header and Variables — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0, concept decision_space; variables[]: {name (string, required), type (variable_type, required), domain (bounded range or finite set, required where possible), values (for categorical), mutable (boolean, required)}

items.text_th: Rules — ห้าม treat discrete variable เป็น differentiable โดยไม่มี explicit relaxation; บันทึก fixed variables (mutable false) แยกจาก optimizable variables; reject candidate ที่มีค่านอก domain ก่อน evaluation
items.text_en: Rules — never treat a discrete variable as differentiable without an explicit relaxation; record fixed variables (mutable false) separately from optimizable ones; reject candidates with out-of-domain values before evaluation

items.text_th: Acceptance Criteria — ทุก variable มี declared type; ทุก variable มี finite หรือ bounded domain เมื่อทำได้; candidate serialization เป็น deterministic (same configuration → same candidate_id)
items.text_en: Acceptance Criteria — every variable has a declared type; every variable has a finite or bounded domain where possible; candidate serialization is deterministic (same configuration → same candidate_id)

items.text_th: Serialization Rule — candidate เขียนเป็น mapping ที่ key เรียงตามชื่อ, continuous ปัดตาม declared precision, categorical เป็น string ตาม values; candidate_id = hash ของ serialization นี้ ใช้เป็น cache key (SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md) — template ระบุรูป serialization เพื่อทำให้ acceptance criterion 'candidate serialization is deterministic' ของ workshop ตัดสินได้ (ไม่เพิ่ม field ไม่ bump)
items.text_en: Serialization Rule — a candidate is written as a mapping with keys sorted by name, continuous values rounded to the declared precision, categorical values as strings from values; candidate_id = hash of this serialization, used as the cache key (SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md) — the template specifies the serialization form so the workshop's 'candidate serialization is deterministic' criterion becomes decidable (no field added, no bump)

sections.heading: Search Space Size and Grid Growth

description.th: ประมาณขนาด search space ก่อนเลือกวิธีค้นหา
description.en: Estimate the search space size before choosing how to search.

items.text_th: Count Before Choosing — discrete: จำนวน combination = ผลคูณของ |domain|; binary subset: 2^n หรือ C(n,k) เมื่อบังคับจำนวน; continuous: infinite → ต้อง sample หรือใช้ structure (gradient/surrogate)
items.text_en: Count Before Choosing — discrete: number of combinations = product of |domain|; binary subset: 2^n or C(n,k) when the count is fixed; continuous: infinite → must sample or exploit structure (gradient/surrogate)

items.text_th: Grid Growth Warning — สำหรับ continuous space อย่าสร้าง grid ละเอียดเกินจำเป็น เพราะจำนวน combination โตเร็วมาก; ตัวอย่าง Python search_space = {top_k: [5,10,15], reranker: [none, cross_encoder], relevance_weight: [0.4,0.6,0.8]} = 18 candidates
items.text_en: Grid Growth Warning — for continuous spaces do not build an unnecessarily fine grid, because the number of combinations grows fast; example Python search_space = {top_k: [5,10,15], reranker: [none, cross_encoder], relevance_weight: [0.4,0.6,0.8]} = 18 candidates

items.text_th: Size Feeds Selection — search_space_size เป็น field ใน ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md; เล็ก (≤ ~100) → exhaustive/grid; ใหญ่ discrete → random/heuristic; subset under budget → greedy/combinatorial (DISCRETE_SEARCH_METHODS.md)
items.text_en: Size Feeds Selection — search_space_size is a field in ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md; small (≤ ~100) → exhaustive/grid; large discrete → random/heuristic; subset under budget → greedy/combinatorial (DISCRETE_SEARCH_METHODS.md)

description.th: ตาราง decision variables ของ BriefDesk ทั้งสองโจทย์
description.en: BriefDesk's decision variable tables for both problems.

items.text_th: briefdesk_brief_selection — include_item_i (binary, {0,1}, mutable true) × 12 candidate ids จาก manifest; fixed: token_budget 8,000 (mutable false), policy_scope cold_chain, judge version; search space 2^12 = 4,096 subsets, 792 เมื่อบังคับ 5 ชิ้น
items.text_en: briefdesk_brief_selection — include_item_i (binary, {0,1}, mutable true) × 12 candidate ids from the manifest; fixed: token_budget 8,000 (mutable false), policy_scope cold_chain, judge version; search space 2^12 = 4,096 subsets, 792 when exactly 5 items are forced

items.text_th: briefdesk_retrieval_tuning — top_k (integer, [8, 30]); dedupe_threshold (continuous, [0.75, 0.95], precision 0.01); retrieval_strategy (categorical, {dense, hybrid, authority_first}); component_weights (structured: 4 continuous ∈ [0,1] ที่ normalize ให้รวมเป็น 1 — relevance, novelty, authority, diversity); ทุกตัว mutable true
items.text_en: briefdesk_retrieval_tuning — top_k (integer, [8, 30]); dedupe_threshold (continuous, [0.75, 0.95], precision 0.01); retrieval_strategy (categorical, {dense, hybrid, authority_first}); component_weights (structured: 4 continuous ∈ [0,1] normalized to sum 1 — relevance, novelty, authority, diversity); all mutable true

items.text_th: From Handoff, Not Invented — top_k, dedupe_threshold, component_weights, strategy_selection มาจาก configurable_fields ของ handoff package (domain null → layer นี้ประกาศ domain; value ยัง null จน optimization เสร็จ); information_value_metrics ไม่ใช่ decision variable ของ layer นี้ (HANDOFF.md)
items.text_en: From Handoff, Not Invented — top_k, dedupe_threshold, component_weights and strategy_selection come from the handoff package's configurable_fields (domain null → this layer declares the domain; value stays null until optimization completes); information_value_metrics is not a decision variable of this layer (HANDOFF.md)

items.text_th: Use Cases and Impact — context chunk selection: binary/combinatorial → เลือก subset ภายใต้ token budget; RAG top-k tuning: integer → หา breadth ที่เหมาะ; component weights: continuous → ปรับสัดส่วน contribution; pipeline strategy: categorical/structured → เปรียบเทียบ architecture alternatives
items.text_en: Use Cases and Impact — context chunk selection: binary/combinatorial → choose a subset under the token budget; RAG top-k tuning: integer → find the right breadth; component weights: continuous → adjust contribution shares; pipeline strategy: categorical/structured → compare architecture alternatives

description.th: Contract context_optimization_contract/v1.2 concept objective_function — 'ดีกว่า' แปลว่าอะไร: direction (owner ของ enum maximize / minimize), components ที่แต่ละตัวมี weight null, measurement_class, scale, provenance และ weight_source; governance normalize_before_weighting / threshold_source / allow_unlabeled_proxy; prohibited claims; BriefDesk objective ที่ weight ยังเป็น null
description.en: Contract context_optimization_contract/v1.2 concept objective_function — what 'better' means: direction (owner of the maximize / minimize enum), components each with weight null, measurement_class, scale, provenance and weight_source; governance normalize_before_weighting / threshold_source / allow_unlabeled_proxy; prohibited claims; the BriefDesk objective with weights still null.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate an OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md specifying the contract context_optimization_contract/v1.2 concept objective_function. Define the objective function and its failure mode (right optimizer, wrong metric), separate objective from evaluation, own the direction enum {maximize, minimize}, present the single-objective and weighted-utility forms with the normalize-first rule and the 'illustrative, not universal' caveat on workshop weights, and write the contract: direction, components (name, direction, weight null, measurement_class, scale, provenance, weight_source), governance (normalize_before_weighting, threshold_source, allow_unlabeled_proxy), three prohibited claims and three acceptance criteria. Give BriefDesk's objectives for both problems with every weight null and the novelty component named as a proxy.
agent_hints.input_context: measurement_class values come from CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md — reference, do not redefine. The workshop weights 0.35 / 0.20 / 0.20 / 0.15 / 0.10 may be quoted only as illustrative and uncalibrated. weight_source values validation_data / business_policy mirror the governance threshold_source.
agent_hints.validation: direction must be defined exactly once with two values. Every BriefDesk component must carry direction, measurement_class, scale and provenance with weight null. The three prohibited claims must appear verbatim in intent. The document must state that hard requirements belong in FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md, not in the weighted sum. No numeric weight may be presented as recommended.

description.th: objective ผิด → optimizer ทำงานถูกต้องเพื่อหาคำตอบที่ผิด
description.en: A wrong objective makes the optimizer work correctly toward the wrong answer.

items.text_th: Definition — Objective Function คือกติกาที่เปลี่ยน candidate configuration ให้เป็นค่าที่ใช้เปรียบเทียบว่า candidate ไหนดีกว่า; flow: Candidate → Run Pipeline / Evaluate → Quality Signals (Relevance / Accuracy / Coverage / Cost / Latency) → Objective Function → Utility Score
items.text_en: Definition — the Objective Function is the rule turning a candidate configuration into a value for comparing which candidate is better; flow: Candidate → Run Pipeline / Evaluate → Quality Signals (Relevance / Accuracy / Coverage / Cost / Latency) → Objective Function → Utility Score

items.text_th: GIST — optimizer เก่งแค่ไหนก็ช่วยไม่ได้ ถ้าเราให้มัน optimize metric ที่ไม่ตรงกับ task value; เช่น optimize semantic similarity อย่างเดียวได้ context ที่คล้าย query แต่ไม่มี authoritative evidence
items.text_en: GIST — no optimizer helps if it optimizes a metric that does not match task value; e.g. optimizing semantic similarity alone yields context that resembles the query but carries no authoritative evidence

items.text_th: Objective vs Evaluation — objective นิยามว่า 'ดีกว่า' คืออะไรและรวม signal อย่างไร; evaluation (EVALUATION_SPEC.md) นิยามว่าจะได้ signal เหล่านั้นมาจากไหนและเชื่อถือแค่ไหน — สองเอกสารแยกกันเพื่อไม่ให้ proxy กลายเป็น objective โดยไม่รู้ตัว
items.text_en: Objective vs Evaluation — the objective defines what 'better' is and how signals combine; evaluation (EVALUATION_SPEC.md) defines where those signals come from and how trustworthy they are — kept separate so a proxy never silently becomes the objective

description.th: enum direction นิยามที่นี่; รูป single-objective และ weighted utility
description.en: The direction enum defined here; single-objective and weighted-utility forms.

items.text_th: direction — enum {maximize, minimize} นิยามที่นี่ที่เดียว; ทุก objective และทุก component ประกาศ direction; MULTI_OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md ใช้ direction เดียวกันในการ normalize dominance
items.text_en: direction — enum {maximize, minimize} defined here only; every objective and every component declares a direction; MULTI_OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md uses the same direction to normalize dominance

items.text_th: Forms — single objective x* = arg max_x f(x); weighted utility U(x) = Σ_j w_j · q_j(x) − λ · Cost(x); normalize metric ก่อนรวมเมื่ออยู่คนละ scale
items.text_en: Forms — single objective x* = arg max_x f(x); weighted utility U(x) = Σ_j w_j · q_j(x) − λ · Cost(x); normalize metrics before combining when they live on different scales

items.text_th: Illustrative, Not Universal — ตัวอย่าง workshop U = 0.35·StrategicRelevance + 0.20·Novelty + 0.20·Authority + 0.15·Diversity + 0.10·Actionability − λ·TokenCost เป็น task-specific objective ไม่ใช่สูตรสากล ต้อง calibrate จาก evaluation data — ใน contract weight จึงเป็น null
items.text_en: Illustrative, Not Universal — the workshop example U = 0.35·StrategicRelevance + 0.20·Novelty + 0.20·Authority + 0.15·Diversity + 0.10·Actionability − λ·TokenCost is a task-specific objective, not a universal formula, and must be calibrated from evaluation data — hence weights are null in the contract

items.text_th: Hard Requirement Is Not a Term — requirement เช่น 'citation ต้องมี source จริง' เป็น hard constraint (FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md) ไม่ใช่ term ที่คะแนนด้านอื่นชดเชยได้
items.text_en: Hard Requirement Is Not a Term — a requirement e.g. 'citations must have a real source' is a hard constraint (FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md), not a term other scores can compensate

description.th: โครง contract พร้อม components, governance, prohibited claims, acceptance criteria
description.en: Contract structure with components, governance, prohibited claims and acceptance criteria.

items.text_th: Header and Direction — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.2, concept objective_function (extends workshop v1.1 by adding per-component direction, scale, provenance and weight_source); objective.direction {type string, allowed_values [maximize, minimize], required true, value maximize}
items.text_en: Header and Direction — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.2, concept objective_function (extends workshop v1.1 by adding per-component direction, scale, provenance and weight_source); objective.direction {type string, allowed_values [maximize, minimize], required true, value maximize}

items.text_th: Components — components[]: {name, direction, weight {type number, nullable true, value null}, measurement_class {type string, allowed_values ตาม CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md, required true}, scale (เช่น [0,1] หรือ tokens), provenance (evaluator id/version หรือ metric definition ref), weight_source {allowed_values [validation_data, business_policy], nullable true — enum application-defined ที่นิยามที่นี่}}; ตัวอย่าง workshop: task_quality (weight null, measurement_class null) และ cost (weight null, DIRECT_METRIC)
items.text_en: Components — components[]: {name, direction, weight {type number, nullable true, value null}, measurement_class {type string, allowed_values per CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md, required true}, scale (e.g. [0,1] or tokens), provenance (evaluator id/version or metric definition ref), weight_source {allowed_values [validation_data, business_policy], nullable true — application-defined enum defined here}}; workshop example: task_quality (weight null, measurement_class null) and cost (weight null, DIRECT_METRIC)

items.text_th: Governance — normalize_before_weighting true; threshold_source validation_data; allow_unlabeled_proxy false (proxy ทุกตัวต้องมี measurement_class PROXY และชื่อสะท้อนว่าเป็น proxy)
items.text_en: Governance — normalize_before_weighting true; threshold_source validation_data; allow_unlabeled_proxy false (every proxy carries measurement_class PROXY and a name reflecting that it is a proxy)

items.text_th: Prohibited Claims — ห้ามเรียก weighted proxy score ว่า 'true quality' โดยไม่มี validation; ห้าม invent universal weights; ห้ามซ่อน hard requirement ไว้ใน compensating weighted sum
items.text_en: Prohibited Claims — never call a weighted proxy score 'true quality' without validation; never invent universal weights; never hide a hard requirement inside a compensating weighted sum

items.text_th: Acceptance Criteria — objective direction ชัด; ทุก component มี provenance และ scale; weight source ถูกบันทึก (validation_data หรือ business_policy) เมื่อ weight ไม่ null
items.text_en: Acceptance Criteria — the objective direction is explicit; every component has provenance and scale; the weight source is recorded (validation_data or business_policy) whenever a weight is non-null

description.th: objective ของ BriefDesk ทั้งสองโจทย์ที่ weight เป็น null
description.en: BriefDesk's objectives for both problems with weights null.

items.text_th: Selection Components — strategic_relevance_proxy (maximize, MODEL_JUDGMENT, briefdesk_judge/v2 ต่อ item, scale [0,1]); novelty_proxy (maximize, PROXY — embedding distance ต่อ brief เจ็ดวันก่อน, scale [0,1]); source_authority (maximize, DIRECT_METRIC — tier map จาก evidence_authority_class, scale [0,1]); diversity (maximize, DIRECT_METRIC — จำนวน cluster_id ที่ต่างกัน / 5); decision_usefulness_proxy (maximize, MODEL_JUDGMENT — judge ต่อ brief); decision_usefulness (maximize, HUMAN_LABEL — reviewer rubric v3, ใช้ validate proxy); decision_usefulness_outcome (maximize, PRODUCTION_OUTCOME — save/forward, monitoring เท่านั้น); token_cost (minimize, DIRECT_METRIC, tokens) — ทุก weight null, weight_source null, หนึ่ง component หนึ่ง measurement_class
items.text_en: Selection Components — strategic_relevance_proxy (maximize, MODEL_JUDGMENT, briefdesk_judge/v2 per item, scale [0,1]); novelty_proxy (maximize, PROXY — embedding distance to the previous seven briefs, scale [0,1]); source_authority (maximize, DIRECT_METRIC — tier map from evidence_authority_class, scale [0,1]); diversity (maximize, DIRECT_METRIC — distinct cluster_id count / 5); decision_usefulness_proxy (maximize, MODEL_JUDGMENT — judge per brief); decision_usefulness (maximize, HUMAN_LABEL — reviewer rubric v3, validates the proxy); decision_usefulness_outcome (maximize, PRODUCTION_OUTCOME — save/forward, monitoring only); token_cost (minimize, DIRECT_METRIC, tokens) — all weights null, weight_source null, one component one measurement_class

items.text_th: Tuning Components — decision_usefulness_proxy (maximize, MODEL_JUDGMENT บน benchmark; validate ด้วย decision_usefulness HUMAN_LABEL sample), diversity (maximize, DIRECT_METRIC), token_cost (minimize, DIRECT_METRIC); เก็บเป็น vector สาม objective สำหรับ Pareto (MULTI_OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md) — ไม่ collapse เป็น weighted sum จนกว่า business จะประกาศ final_choice_rule
items.text_en: Tuning Components — decision_usefulness_proxy (maximize, MODEL_JUDGMENT on the benchmark; validated against the decision_usefulness HUMAN_LABEL sample), diversity (maximize, DIRECT_METRIC), token_cost (minimize, DIRECT_METRIC); kept as a three-objective vector for Pareto (MULTI_OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md) — not collapsed into a weighted sum until the business declares a final_choice_rule

items.text_th: Novelty Named as Proxy — ชื่อ component คือ novelty_proxy ไม่ใช่ novelty เพื่อไม่ให้ report อ้างว่า 'novelty ดีขึ้น' ทั้งที่วัดแค่ embedding distance (Rule 3 ใน CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md); เช่นเดียวกัน decision_usefulness_proxy (MODEL_JUDGMENT) แยกจาก decision_usefulness (HUMAN_LABEL) — component หนึ่งมี measurement_class ค่าเดียว
items.text_en: Novelty Named as Proxy — the component is named novelty_proxy, not novelty, so no report claims 'novelty improved' when only embedding distance was measured (Rule 3 in CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md); likewise decision_usefulness_proxy (MODEL_JUDGMENT) is split from decision_usefulness (HUMAN_LABEL) — one component carries exactly one measurement_class

items.text_th: Use Cases and Impact — news ranking: similarity only → relevance + novelty + authority + cost ลดข่าวคล้ายแต่ไม่ useful; legal RAG: answer fluency → correctness + citation + coverage ลด 'ตอบลื่นแต่หลักฐานไม่พอ'; context compression: shortest text → task-value preserved per token ลด information loss
items.text_en: Use Cases and Impact — news ranking: similarity only → relevance + novelty + authority + cost cuts similar-but-useless items; legal RAG: answer fluency → correctness + citation + coverage cuts 'fluent but under-evidenced' answers; context compression: shortest text → task-value preserved per token cuts information loss

description.th: Contract context_optimization_contract/v1.1 concept constraints — hard constraint บอกว่า solution ใด valid/invalid, soft constraint เป็น preference; owner ของ enum constraint_kind, lifecycle_stage (PRE_EXECUTION / POST_EXECUTION / DEPLOYMENT_GATE) และ on_violation (REJECT / REJECT_OR_REPAIR / BLOCK_DEPLOYMENT / PENALIZE); handling policy ที่ repaired candidate ต้อง re-evaluate; BriefDesk constraints ที่สืบทอดจาก handoff
description.en: Contract context_optimization_contract/v1.1 concept constraints — hard constraints say which solutions are valid/invalid, soft constraints are preferences; owner of the constraint_kind, lifecycle_stage (PRE_EXECUTION / POST_EXECUTION / DEPLOYMENT_GATE) and on_violation (REJECT / REJECT_OR_REPAIR / BLOCK_DEPLOYMENT / PENALIZE) enums; a handling policy under which repaired candidates are re-evaluated; BriefDesk constraints inherited from the handoff.

suggested_headings: Penalty Methods Are Not Hard Constraints

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md specifying the contract context_optimization_contract/v1.1 concept constraints (filed under this name to avoid confusion with the project-level CONSTRAINTS.md). Define hard vs soft constraints and the feasible region; own the enums constraint_kind {HARD, SOFT}, lifecycle_stage {PRE_EXECUTION, POST_EXECUTION, DEPLOYMENT_GATE} and on_violation {REJECT, REJECT_OR_REPAIR, BLOCK_DEPLOYMENT, PENALIZE} plus the HUMAN_REVIEW marker; write the contract (hard constraints per stage, soft constraints with nullable target, handling policy, four acceptance criteria, the Python sketch separating pre- and post-execution checks); explain why penalty / barrier / projection never replace a hard-constraint check; and tabulate BriefDesk's constraints by stage, inheriting the handoff ids.
agent_hints.input_context: Contract fields are quoted from workshop section 8; lifecycle_stage is the template's enum name for the workshop's pre_execution / post_execution / deployment_gates groups and must say so. Inherited ids: citation_source_required → instr_citation_required_003, no_fabricated_citation → instr_no_fabricated_citation_004. The penalty / barrier / projection material comes from Appendix B. The objective this feasibility layer filters candidates for is OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md's; the constraint-authoring rules it instantiates are CONSTRAINTS.md's.
agent_hints.validation: The three enums must be defined exactly once with the listed values and PENALIZE restricted to SOFT. Every BriefDesk constraint must carry id, check, lifecycle_stage and on_violation. The handling policy must include repaired_candidate_requires_re_evaluation. The 'fabricated citation is rejected, not penalized' example must appear.

description.th: objective บอกว่าอะไรดีกว่า — constraint บอกว่าอะไรใช้ไม่ได้ตั้งแต่แรก
description.en: The objective says what is better — the constraint says what is unusable from the start.

items.text_th: Why — คะแนนรวมสูงไม่ได้แปลว่า deploy ได้: candidate อาจคุณภาพสูงแต่เกิน token budget, ไม่มี citation, latency เกิน SLA หรือผิด governance rule
items.text_en: Why — a high total score does not mean deployable: a candidate may be high quality yet exceed the token budget, lack citations, breach the latency SLA or violate a governance rule

items.text_th: Hard vs Soft — Hard Constraint กำหนดว่า solution ใด valid / invalid; Soft Constraint เป็น preference ที่ยอม trade-off ได้; GIST: Objective บอกว่าอะไรดีกว่า — Constraint บอกว่าอะไรใช้ไม่ได้ตั้งแต่แรก
items.text_en: Hard vs Soft — a Hard Constraint decides which solutions are valid / invalid; a Soft Constraint is a preference open to trade-off; GIST: the Objective says what is better — the Constraint says what is unusable from the start

items.text_th: Feasible Region — maximize f(x) subject to g_i(x) ≤ 0, h_j(x) = 0; X_feasible = {x ∈ X : all hard constraints satisfied}; flow: All Candidates → Constraint Check → Feasible → Evaluate Objective | Infeasible → Reject / Repair
items.text_en: Feasible Region — maximize f(x) subject to g_i(x) ≤ 0, h_j(x) = 0; X_feasible = {x ∈ X : all hard constraints satisfied}; flow: All Candidates → Constraint Check → Feasible → Evaluate Objective | Infeasible → Reject / Repair

description.th: constraint_kind, lifecycle_stage และ on_violation นิยามที่นี่ที่เดียว
description.en: constraint_kind, lifecycle_stage and on_violation are defined here only.

items.text_th: constraint_kind — {HARD, SOFT}: HARD ตัดสิน validity และห้ามชดเชยด้วยคะแนน; SOFT ให้ penalty ใน objective หรือใช้เป็น tie-breaker; การ label soft เป็น hard (หรือกลับกัน) เป็น acceptance failure — template ตั้งชื่อ enum นี้ให้กลุ่ม hard / soft ของ workshop (ไม่เพิ่ม field ไม่ bump)
items.text_en: constraint_kind — {HARD, SOFT}: HARD decides validity and can never be compensated by score; SOFT adds a penalty to the objective or acts as a tie-breaker; labelling soft as hard (or the reverse) is an acceptance failure — the template names this enum for the workshop's hard / soft groups (no field added, no bump)

items.text_th: lifecycle_stage — {PRE_EXECUTION, POST_EXECUTION, DEPLOYMENT_GATE}: PRE_EXECUTION ตรวจได้ก่อน run (token_budget, source availability); POST_EXECUTION ตรวจได้หลังเห็น generated result (citation_traceability); DEPLOYMENT_GATE ตรวจก่อนปล่อย (all_hard_constraints_passed) — workshop จัดกลุ่มเป็น pre_execution / post_execution / deployment_gates; template ตั้งชื่อ enum นี้ให้ log และ report ใช้ร่วมกัน
items.text_en: lifecycle_stage — {PRE_EXECUTION, POST_EXECUTION, DEPLOYMENT_GATE}: PRE_EXECUTION is checkable before the run (token_budget, source availability); POST_EXECUTION only after the generated result exists (citation_traceability); DEPLOYMENT_GATE before release (all_hard_constraints_passed) — the workshop groups them as pre_execution / post_execution / deployment_gates; the template names this enum so logs and reports share it

items.text_th: on_violation — {REJECT, REJECT_OR_REPAIR, BLOCK_DEPLOYMENT, PENALIZE}: REJECT ทิ้ง candidate ก่อน scoring; REJECT_OR_REPAIR อนุญาต repair ที่ต้อง log และ re-evaluate; BLOCK_DEPLOYMENT หยุด release; PENALIZE ใช้กับ SOFT เท่านั้น — ค่าทั้งสี่มาจาก contract ของ workshop
items.text_en: on_violation — {REJECT, REJECT_OR_REPAIR, BLOCK_DEPLOYMENT, PENALIZE}: REJECT drops the candidate before scoring; REJECT_OR_REPAIR allows a logged repair followed by re-evaluation; BLOCK_DEPLOYMENT stops the release; PENALIZE applies to SOFT only — all four values come from the workshop contract

items.text_th: HUMAN_REVIEW Marker — hard constraint ที่ machine ตรวจไม่ได้ต้อง mark check: HUMAN_REVIEW อย่างชัดเจน และเป็น DEPLOYMENT_GATE ที่ต้องมี reviewer sign-off (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md) — ห้ามปล่อยให้ optimizer ถือว่าผ่านโดย default
items.text_en: HUMAN_REVIEW Marker — a hard constraint a machine cannot check is explicitly marked check: HUMAN_REVIEW and becomes a DEPLOYMENT_GATE requiring reviewer sign-off (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md) — the optimizer must never treat it as passed by default

description.th: โครง contract, handling policy และ acceptance criteria
description.en: Contract structure, handling policy and acceptance criteria.

items.text_th: Header and Hard Constraints Block — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.1, concept constraints; hard_constraints.pre_execution[] {id, check (machine-checkable expression หรือ HUMAN_REVIEW), on_violation}; post_execution[] เช่น citation_traceability check all_output_citations_resolve_to_available_source_ids on_violation REJECT_OR_REPAIR; deployment_gates[] เช่น all_hard_constraints_passed check pre_execution_passed AND post_execution_passed on_violation BLOCK_DEPLOYMENT
items.text_en: Header and Hard Constraints Block — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.1, concept constraints; hard_constraints.pre_execution[] {id, check (machine-checkable expression or HUMAN_REVIEW), on_violation}; post_execution[] e.g. citation_traceability check all_output_citations_resolve_to_available_source_ids on_violation REJECT_OR_REPAIR; deployment_gates[] e.g. all_hard_constraints_passed check pre_execution_passed AND post_execution_passed on_violation BLOCK_DEPLOYMENT

items.text_th: Soft Constraints Block — soft_constraints[] {id, target (nullable — เช่น preferred_latency target null จน calibrate), on_violation PENALIZE}; penalty weight เป็นของ OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md ไม่ใช่ที่นี่
items.text_en: Soft Constraints Block — soft_constraints[] {id, target (nullable — e.g. preferred_latency target null until calibrated), on_violation PENALIZE}; the penalty weight belongs to OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md, not here

items.text_th: Handling Policy — validate_pre_execution_before_run true; validate_post_execution_before_final_scoring_or_deployment true; repair_allowed true; repair_must_be_logged true; repaired_candidate_requires_re_evaluation true
items.text_en: Handling Policy — validate_pre_execution_before_run true; validate_post_execution_before_final_scoring_or_deployment true; repair_allowed true; repair_must_be_logged true; repaired_candidate_requires_re_evaluation true

items.text_th: Acceptance Criteria — hard-constraint violation ไม่มีทางถึง deployment; constraint outcome ถูก log ต่อ candidate ต่อ lifecycle stage (EXPERIMENT_LOG.md constraint_results); repaired candidate ถูก re-evaluate ก่อนเปรียบเทียบหรือ deploy; soft constraint ไม่ถูก mislabel เป็น hard
items.text_en: Acceptance Criteria — no hard-constraint violation ever reaches deployment; constraint outcomes are logged per candidate per lifecycle stage (EXPERIMENT_LOG.md constraint_results); a repaired candidate is re-evaluated before comparison or deployment; soft constraints are never mislabelled as hard

items.text_th: Python Sketch — token_budget_ok(candidate, budget), selected_evidence_has_source_ids(candidate), pre_execution_feasible = both; output_citations_traceable(result) เทียบ citations กับ available_source_ids — สองกลุ่มหลังคนละ stage เพราะ post-execution ต้องเห็น generated result ก่อน
items.text_en: Python Sketch — token_budget_ok(candidate, budget), selected_evidence_has_source_ids(candidate), pre_execution_feasible = both; output_citations_traceable(result) compares citations with available_source_ids — the two groups belong to different stages because post-execution needs the generated result first

sections.heading: Penalty Methods Are Not Hard Constraints

description.th: penalty / barrier / projection มีที่ใช้ แต่ไม่ทำให้ hard constraint ปลอดภัยเอง
description.en: Penalty / barrier / projection have their uses but never make a hard constraint safe by themselves.

items.text_th: Penalty Method — maximize f(x) − λ · Violation(x) เหมาะกับ soft constraint หรือ temporary violation ระหว่าง search แต่ไม่ทำให้ hard constraint ปลอดภัยโดยอัตโนมัติ — candidate สุดท้ายยังต้องผ่าน constraint check จริง
items.text_en: Penalty Method — maximize f(x) − λ · Violation(x) suits soft constraints or temporary violations during search but never makes a hard constraint safe automatically — the final candidate still passes the real constraint check

items.text_th: Barrier and Projection — barrier เพิ่ม cost เมื่อเข้าใกล้ boundary (continuous constrained optimization บางประเภท); projection ดัน candidate กลับเข้า feasible set หลัง update x_{t+1} = Proj_X(x_t + η∇f(x_t)) — รายละเอียดใน CONTINUOUS_POPULATION_METHODS.md
items.text_en: Barrier and Projection — a barrier adds cost near the boundary (some continuous constrained optimization); projection pushes the candidate back into the feasible set after an update x_{t+1} = Proj_X(x_t + η∇f(x_t)) — details in CONTINUOUS_POPULATION_METHODS.md

items.text_th: Mistake — 'ทุกอย่างใส่ weighted sum': fabricated citation ไม่ควร 'หักคะแนนนิดหน่อย' แต่ควร reject candidate; กติกา: Hard requirement → Constraint, Trade-off preference → Objective / Soft constraint (CONSTRAINTS.md)
items.text_en: Mistake — 'everything into a weighted sum': a fabricated citation must not 'lose a few points' but reject the candidate; rule: Hard requirement → Constraint, Trade-off preference → Objective / Soft constraint (CONSTRAINTS.md)

description.th: constraints ของ BriefDesk ตาม stage — สืบทอด id จาก handoff
description.en: BriefDesk's constraints by stage — inheriting ids from the handoff.

items.text_th: PRE_EXECUTION — token_budget: total_tokens <= 8000 → REJECT; selected_source_availability: all_selected_items_have_source_id → REJECT (สืบทอด citation_source_required / instr_citation_required_003); blocked_source: no_item_from_blocklist → REJECT
items.text_en: PRE_EXECUTION — token_budget: total_tokens <= 8000 → REJECT; selected_source_availability: all_selected_items_have_source_id → REJECT (inherits citation_source_required / instr_citation_required_003); blocked_source: no_item_from_blocklist → REJECT

items.text_th: POST_EXECUTION — citation_traceability: all_brief_citations_resolve_to_selected_item_ids → REJECT_OR_REPAIR (สืบทอด no_fabricated_citation / instr_no_fabricated_citation_004); repair = ตัดประโยคที่อ้าง source นอก set แล้ว log และ re-evaluate
items.text_en: POST_EXECUTION — citation_traceability: all_brief_citations_resolve_to_selected_item_ids → REJECT_OR_REPAIR (inherits no_fabricated_citation / instr_no_fabricated_citation_004); repair = drop sentences citing a source outside the set, then log and re-evaluate

items.text_th: DEPLOYMENT_GATE — all_hard_constraints_passed → BLOCK_DEPLOYMENT; high_risk_review_completed: HUMAN_REVIEW → BLOCK_DEPLOYMENT สำหรับ configuration ที่กระทบ compliance answers (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md)
items.text_en: DEPLOYMENT_GATE — all_hard_constraints_passed → BLOCK_DEPLOYMENT; high_risk_review_completed: HUMAN_REVIEW → BLOCK_DEPLOYMENT for configurations affecting compliance answers (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md)

items.text_th: SOFT — preferred_items: target 5 (illustrative), PENALIZE; preferred_latency: target null (calibrate จาก SLA), PENALIZE; ทั้งสองไม่มีสิทธิ์ reject candidate
items.text_en: SOFT — preferred_items: target 5 (illustrative), PENALIZE; preferred_latency: target null (calibrate from the SLA), PENALIZE; neither may reject a candidate

items.text_th: Use Cases and Impact — token budgeting: max context length ป้องกัน overflow / cost runaway; legal chatbot: citation traceability ลด unsupported answer; agent workflow: tool permission ลด invalid execution; production RAG: latency / cost ceiling รักษา SLA และ unit economics
items.text_en: Use Cases and Impact — token budgeting: max context length prevents overflow / cost runaway; legal chatbot: citation traceability cuts unsupported answers; agent workflow: tool permission cuts invalid execution; production RAG: latency / cost ceilings keep the SLA and unit economics

description.th: Contract context_optimization_contract/v1.1 concept evaluation_function (extends workshop v1.0 โดยเพิ่ม aggregation_method.allowed_values, evaluation_budget และ holdout) — optimizer รู้ได้อย่างไรว่าคำตอบไหนดี: Ū(x) = U(x) + ε, evaluator kinds, required metadata, repeat/aggregation, noisy evaluation, evaluation budget, holdout discipline และ raw sub-scores
description.en: Contract context_optimization_contract/v1.1 concept evaluation_function (extends workshop v1.0 by adding aggregation_method.allowed_values, evaluation_budget and holdout) — how the optimizer knows which answer is good: Ū(x) = U(x) + ε, evaluator kinds, required metadata, repeat/aggregation, noisy evaluation, evaluation budget, holdout discipline and raw sub-scores.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate an EVALUATION_SPEC.md specifying the contract context_optimization_contract/v1.1 concept evaluation_function, stating explicitly that v1.1 extends the workshop's v1.0 by adding aggregation_method.allowed_values (application-defined), an evaluation_budget block and a holdout block. Cover the estimator Ū(x) = U(x) + ε, evaluator kinds, the contract (measurement_class, repeat_evaluations, aggregation_method, required metadata, budget and holdout blocks — holdout including its holdout_access_policy {allowed_accessor_roles[], exposure_count, max_reuses, replacement_trigger}, and the aggregation block's confidence_level and interval_method fields, acceptance criteria), noisy/stochastic evaluation (what to report, minimum meaningful difference, aggregation choice, raw sub-scores), evaluation budget dimensions and holdout discipline with proxy validation and holdout access/reuse limits, and BriefDesk's setup (datasets, evaluators with measurement classes, repeat/aggregation/seed, budget).
agent_hints.input_context: Read references/noisy-evaluation-and-budget.md for repeated evaluation, confidence intervals, minimum meaningful difference and budget dimensions. measurement_class values come from CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md. BriefDesk values: bench_briefdesk_v3 (60) + holdout (15), briefdesk_judge/v2, repeat 3, MEAN_WITH_CI, seed 20260904, max_evaluations 40, max_human_reviews 20; judge stdev 0.03 (hence min_meaningful_difference 0.06) is illustrative only; spread is reported as stdev + n, never CI, until confidence_level is declared (value null in the template — this is a Rule 1 guard, not an omission). holdout_access_policy fields are null until policy sets them.
agent_hints.validation: The extension sentence naming the three added blocks must appear and aggregation_method values must be labelled application-defined. Ū(x) = U(x) + ε and the 0.901 vs 0.903 example must appear. The holdout block must state optimizer_may_see_holdout false and list holdout_access_policy field by field. confidence_level and interval_method must appear as nullable fields, with the stdev+n-until-declared rule stated as deliberate, not missing. All five budget dimensions must appear with BriefDesk values or null. Every BriefDesk evaluator must carry a measurement_class.

description.th: optimization quality ถูกจำกัดด้วย evaluation quality
description.en: Optimization quality is bounded by evaluation quality.

items.text_th: Why — objective จำนวนมากคำนวณตรงไม่ได้ เช่น 'COO พบ brief นี้ useful แค่ไหน' จึงต้องมี evaluation pipeline ที่อาจมี noise และ proxy bias; GIST: ถ้าวัดผิด เราจะ optimize ผิดอย่างเป็นระบบ
items.text_en: Why — many objectives cannot be computed directly, e.g. 'how useful the COO finds this brief', so an evaluation pipeline with possible noise and proxy bias is needed; GIST: if we measure wrongly, we optimize wrongly in a systematic way

items.text_th: Definition — Evaluation Function คือกลไกที่สร้าง evidence เพื่อประมาณ task value ของ candidate จาก deterministic metric, labeled dataset, human review, LLM-as-judge หรือ production outcome; flow: Candidate → Run System → Output → Evaluator(s) → Score + Uncertainty + Provenance
items.text_en: Definition — the Evaluation Function is the mechanism producing evidence to estimate a candidate's task value from deterministic metrics, labeled datasets, human review, LLM-as-judge or production outcomes; flow: Candidate → Run System → Output → Evaluator(s) → Score + Uncertainty + Provenance

items.text_th: Estimator — เราไม่เห็น true utility U(x) โดยตรง แต่เห็น Ū(x) = U(x) + ε โดย ε คือ measurement noise / evaluator disagreement / sampling variation; ทุก score ที่ report ต้องมี uncertainty กำกับ
items.text_en: Estimator — we never see the true utility U(x) directly, only Ū(x) = U(x) + ε where ε is measurement noise / evaluator disagreement / sampling variation; every reported score carries its uncertainty

description.th: evaluator block, required metadata, extension fields และ acceptance criteria
description.en: Evaluator block, required metadata, extension fields and acceptance criteria.

items.text_th: Header and Evaluator — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.1, concept evaluation_function; evaluator.measurement_class {type string, allowed_values ตาม CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md, required true}; repeat_evaluations {type integer, minimum 1, nullable true, value null}; aggregation_method {type string, allowed_values [MEAN, MEDIAN, MEAN_WITH_CI, LOWER_PERCENTILE, WORST_CASE], value null}; confidence_level {type number, nullable true, value null}; interval_method {type string, allowed_values application-defined e.g. [NORMAL_APPROX, BOOTSTRAP, T_INTERVAL], nullable true, value null} — ทั้งสอง field เกี่ยวข้องเมื่อ aggregation_method = MEAN_WITH_CI เท่านั้น
items.text_en: Header and Evaluator — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.1, concept evaluation_function; evaluator.measurement_class {type string, allowed_values per CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE.md, required true}; repeat_evaluations {type integer, minimum 1, nullable true, value null}; aggregation_method {type string, allowed_values [MEAN, MEDIAN, MEAN_WITH_CI, LOWER_PERCENTILE, WORST_CASE], value null}; confidence_level {type number, nullable true, value null}; interval_method {type string, allowed_values application-defined e.g. [NORMAL_APPROX, BOOTSTRAP, T_INTERVAL], nullable true, value null} — both fields are relevant only when aggregation_method = MEAN_WITH_CI

items.text_th: Extension Note — v1.1 extends workshop v1.0 โดยเพิ่ม aggregation_method.allowed_values (application-defined example values — workshop ปล่อยเป็น null ไม่ระบุชนิด), evaluation_budget block และ holdout block; field เดิม (measurement_class, repeat_evaluations, required_metadata) คงความหมาย โดย measurement_class ถูก re-type ตาม Contract Syntax Rule (workshop ใช้ key enum:) และ repeat_evaluations ได้ minimum 1
items.text_en: Extension Note — v1.1 extends workshop v1.0 by adding aggregation_method.allowed_values (application-defined example values — the workshop leaves it null and untyped), an evaluation_budget block and a holdout block; original fields (measurement_class, repeat_evaluations, required_metadata) keep their meaning, with measurement_class re-typed per the Contract Syntax Rule (the workshop uses an enum: key) and repeat_evaluations gaining minimum 1

items.text_th: Required Metadata — evaluator_version, dataset_version, sample_size, random_seed_if_applicable, model_name_if_model_judgment — ทุกตัวปรากฏใน event ตาม EXPERIMENT_LOG.md
items.text_en: Required Metadata — evaluator_version, dataset_version, sample_size, random_seed_if_applicable, model_name_if_model_judgment — each appears in the event per EXPERIMENT_LOG.md

items.text_th: Budget and Holdout Blocks — evaluation_budget {max_evaluations, max_total_tokens, max_api_cost, max_wall_clock_time, max_human_reviews — ทุกตัว integer/number nullable, value null จน policy กำหนด; budget scope = ต่อ run — ทุก experiment ใน run ใช้ร่วมกัน}; holdout {tune_dataset_version, holdout_dataset_version, optimizer_may_see_holdout false, holdout_access_policy {allowed_accessor_roles[], exposure_count, max_reuses, replacement_trigger} — ทุกตัว nullable, value null จน policy กำหนด}
items.text_en: Budget and Holdout Blocks — evaluation_budget {max_evaluations, max_total_tokens, max_api_cost, max_wall_clock_time, max_human_reviews — all integer/number nullable, value null until policy sets them; budget scope = per run — every experiment in the run shares it}; holdout {tune_dataset_version, holdout_dataset_version, optimizer_may_see_holdout false, holdout_access_policy {allowed_accessor_roles[], exposure_count, max_reuses, replacement_trigger} — all nullable, value null until policy sets them}

items.text_th: Acceptance Criteria — evaluation provenance reproducible; raw sub-scores ถูกเก็บ; ไม่มี proxy ถูก relabel เป็น ground-truth task value; high-risk task รองรับ expert validation; (extension) budget ถูก enforce และ holdout ไม่ถูกใช้ tune; exposure ของ holdout ถูกนับทุกครั้งที่เข้าถึง และ holdout ถูกแทนที่เมื่อ exposure_count ถึง max_reuses
items.text_en: Acceptance Criteria — evaluation provenance is reproducible; raw sub-scores are retained; no proxy is relabelled as ground-truth task value; high-risk tasks support expert validation; (extension) the budget is enforced and the holdout is never used for tuning; holdout exposure is counted on every access and the holdout is replaced once exposure_count reaches max_reuses

description.th: LLM output เปลี่ยนได้แม้ configuration เดิม — score ต้องมี variance
description.en: LLM output changes even for the same configuration — scores need variance.

items.text_th: What to Report — Mean Score, Variance / Confidence Interval, Failure Rate, Worst-case หรือ lower percentile; repeated_eval(candidate, evaluate_once, repeats) คืน {mean, stdev, n}
items.text_en: What to Report — Mean Score, Variance / Confidence Interval, Failure Rate, Worst-case or lower percentile; repeated_eval(candidate, evaluate_once, repeats) returns {mean, stdev, n}

items.text_th: Minimum Meaningful Difference — อย่า compare A = 0.901 กับ B = 0.903 แล้วสรุปว่า B ดีกว่า หาก evaluator noise ใหญ่กว่าความต่างนั้น; min_meaningful_difference derive จาก stdev ของ repeated evaluations (เช่น 2 × stdev) และเป็น input ของ adaptive trigger ใน SAMPLE_EFFICIENT_ADAPTIVE_METHODS.md
items.text_en: Minimum Meaningful Difference — never compare A = 0.901 with B = 0.903 and conclude B is better when evaluator noise exceeds that gap; min_meaningful_difference is derived from the stdev of repeated evaluations (e.g. 2 × stdev) and feeds the adaptive trigger in SAMPLE_EFFICIENT_ADAPTIVE_METHODS.md

items.text_th: Aggregation Choice — MEAN สำหรับ cheap deterministic-ish metrics; MEAN_WITH_CI เมื่อต้องเปรียบเทียบ candidate; LOWER_PERCENTILE / WORST_CASE สำหรับ high-risk objective ที่ tail สำคัญ; MEDIAN เมื่อ outlier มาก — เป็น application-defined ค่าต้องเลือกและบันทึกต่อ objective
items.text_en: Aggregation Choice — MEAN for cheap near-deterministic metrics; MEAN_WITH_CI when comparing candidates; LOWER_PERCENTILE / WORST_CASE for high-risk objectives where the tail matters; MEDIAN when outliers abound — application-defined, chosen and recorded per objective

items.text_th: Raw Sub-Scores — เก็บ raw sub-scores ไม่ใช่แค่ final score เพื่อ audit ว่า optimizer กำลัง exploit metric ใดหรือไม่; evaluate_candidate(candidate, evaluators) คืน dict ต่อ evaluator
items.text_en: Raw Sub-Scores — keep raw sub-scores, not only the final score, to audit whether the optimizer exploits any single metric; evaluate_candidate(candidate, evaluators) returns a dict per evaluator

description.th: optimization ต้องมี budget และ set ที่ optimizer ไม่เคยเห็น
description.en: Optimization needs a budget and a set the optimizer never sees.

items.text_th: Budget Dimensions — max_evaluations, max_total_tokens, max_api_cost, max_wall_clock_time, max_human_reviews; practical optimization = maximize best_found_quality subject to evaluation_cost ≤ budget — นี่คือเหตุที่ sample efficiency ของ Bayesian Optimization มี value เมื่อ objective แพง (ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md)
items.text_en: Budget Dimensions — max_evaluations, max_total_tokens, max_api_cost, max_wall_clock_time, max_human_reviews; practical optimization = maximize best_found_quality subject to evaluation_cost ≤ budget — which is why Bayesian Optimization's sample efficiency has value when the objective is expensive (ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md)

items.text_th: Holdout Discipline — optimizer overfit evaluator ได้เช่นเดียวกับ model; ลำดับ Train/Tune Set → Optimization → Holdout Validation → Production Monitoring; holdout ไม่ถูกใช้เลือก candidate และผลบน holdout เป็น gate ใน DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md
items.text_en: Holdout Discipline — an optimizer can overfit the evaluator just like a model; order Train/Tune Set → Optimization → Holdout Validation → Production Monitoring; the holdout is never used to pick a candidate and its result is a gate in DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md

items.text_th: Proxy Validation — proxy ดีขึ้น ≠ product ดีขึ้น; ต้องมี proxy validation + holdout evaluation + production outcome เมื่อมี; report ประกาศ measurement_class ของทุก number
items.text_en: Proxy Validation — a better proxy ≠ a better product; require proxy validation + holdout evaluation + production outcome when available; reports declare the measurement_class of every number

description.th: evaluation setup ของ BriefDesk
description.en: BriefDesk's evaluation setup.

items.text_th: Datasets — bench_briefdesk_v3 (60 brief-days, tune set) และ bench_briefdesk_v3_holdout (15 brief-days, optimizer ไม่เคยเห็น) — ขนาด illustrative; dataset hash b71e…0d2e บันทึกใน event
items.text_en: Datasets — bench_briefdesk_v3 (60 brief-days, tune set) and bench_briefdesk_v3_holdout (15 brief-days, never seen by the optimizer) — illustrative sizes; dataset hash b71e…0d2e recorded in the event

items.text_th: Evaluators — briefdesk_judge/v2 (MODEL_JUDGMENT, model_name บันทึก) ให้ strategic_relevance_proxy และ decision_usefulness_proxy บน benchmark; reviewer panel (HUMAN_LABEL, ≤ 20 labels ต่อ run, rubric v3) ให้ decision_usefulness ที่ใช้ validate proxy; decision_usefulness_outcome — production save/forward (PRODUCTION_OUTCOME) เก็บหลัง deploy; token_cost, diversity, source_authority (DIRECT_METRIC)
items.text_en: Evaluators — briefdesk_judge/v2 (MODEL_JUDGMENT, model_name recorded) gives strategic_relevance_proxy and decision_usefulness_proxy on the benchmark; the reviewer panel (HUMAN_LABEL, ≤ 20 labels per run, rubric v3) gives decision_usefulness, which validates the proxy; decision_usefulness_outcome — production save/forward (PRODUCTION_OUTCOME) collected after deployment; token_cost, diversity, source_authority (DIRECT_METRIC)

items.text_th: Repeat and Aggregation — repeat_count 3 สำหรับ judge, aggregation MEAN_WITH_CI, random_seed 20260904; judge stdev สังเกตได้ราว 0.03 (illustrative) → min_meaningful_difference = 2 × stdev = 0.06 (illustrative; value null จน validate) และรายงาน spread เป็น stdev + n ไม่ใช่ CI จนกว่าจะประกาศ confidence level
items.text_en: Repeat and Aggregation — repeat_count 3 for the judge, aggregation MEAN_WITH_CI, random_seed 20260904; observed judge stdev about 0.03 (illustrative) → min_meaningful_difference = 2 × stdev = 0.06 (illustrative; value null until validated), and spread is reported as stdev + n, not as a CI, until a confidence level is declared

items.text_th: Budget — run_briefdesk_2026_09_04_001 (tuning): max_evaluations 40, max_human_reviews 20 (illustrative), max_total_tokens null, max_api_cost null (policy), max_wall_clock_time null; run_briefdesk_2026_09_04_002 (selection): max_evaluations 20 brief-level judge calls, max_human_reviews 10 (illustrative) — item-level DIRECT_METRIC / PROXY scores ไม่นับ; budget ต่อ run ที่ทุก experiment ใช้ร่วมกัน และ log evaluation_cost ต่อ candidate
items.text_en: Budget — run_briefdesk_2026_09_04_001 (tuning): max_evaluations 40, max_human_reviews 20 (illustrative), max_total_tokens null, max_api_cost null (policy), max_wall_clock_time null; run_briefdesk_2026_09_04_002 (selection): max_evaluations 20 brief-level judge calls, max_human_reviews 10 (illustrative) — item-level DIRECT_METRIC / PROXY scores are not counted; the budget is per run, shared by its experiments, and evaluation_cost is logged per candidate

items.text_th: Use Cases and Impact — LLM prompt tuning: output stochastic → repeat eval + aggregate; legal QA: correctness ยาก automate → expert benchmark + citation checks; news personalization: proxy ≠ true usefulness → combine offline + production feedback
items.text_en: Use Cases and Impact — LLM prompt tuning: stochastic output → repeat eval + aggregate; legal QA: correctness hard to automate → expert benchmark + citation checks; news personalization: proxy ≠ true usefulness → combine offline + production feedback

description.th: Contract context_optimization_contract/v1.0 concept multi_objective_pareto — เมื่อ 'ดีที่สุด' มีหลายมิติ: direction-aware dominance, Pareto frontier, owner ของ enum final_choice_rule (BUSINESS_POLICY / WEIGHTED_UTILITY / EPSILON_CONSTRAINT / HUMAN_DECISION) และ scalarization_method (application-defined: WEIGHTED_SUM / EPSILON_CONSTRAINT / LEXICOGRAPHIC); quality floor pattern; BriefDesk front ของ usefulness / diversity / token_cost
description.en: Contract context_optimization_contract/v1.0 concept multi_objective_pareto — when 'best' has several dimensions: direction-aware dominance, the Pareto frontier, owner of the final_choice_rule enum (BUSINESS_POLICY / WEIGHTED_UTILITY / EPSILON_CONSTRAINT / HUMAN_DECISION) and scalarization_method (application-defined: WEIGHTED_SUM / EPSILON_CONSTRAINT / LEXICOGRAPHIC); the quality-floor pattern; BriefDesk's usefulness / diversity / token_cost front.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a MULTI_OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md specifying the contract context_optimization_contract/v1.0 concept multi_objective_pareto. Define multi-objective optimization, direction-aware dominance and the Pareto frontier with the A-vs-B illustration; write the contract (objectives min_items 2, output with front and dominance metadata, selection_policy.final_choice_rule enum owned here, four acceptance criteria, the dominates / pareto_front sketch); own the application-defined scalarization_method enum and explain weighted sum vs epsilon-constraint vs lexicographic, the quality-floor pattern as a real constraint and the 'don't force a weighted sum' rule; and give BriefDesk's decision_usefulness_proxy / diversity / token_cost front with an illustrative shape and a BUSINESS_POLICY final choice that selects cand_0024 by the stated rule.
agent_hints.input_context: Read references/pareto-dominance-and-scalarization.md for dominance, normalization and the three scalarization methods (workshop Appendix A). direction comes from OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md. Illustrative front values must be labelled illustrative and the quality floor must stay null.
agent_hints.validation: final_choice_rule must be defined exactly once with four values; scalarization_method must be labelled application-defined with three values. The dominance definition must be direction-aware. The quality-floor pattern must point to FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md. The BriefDesk final choice must be recorded as a business decision, not an optimum claim.

description.th: Pareto frontier = ชุดตัวเลือกที่ไม่มีตัวไหนชนะทุกด้าน
description.en: The Pareto frontier = the set of options none of which wins on every axis.

items.text_th: Why — Context Engineering แทบทุกระบบมี objectives ที่ conflict กัน เช่น relevance vs completeness, quality vs latency, authority vs diversity; Multi-objective Optimization หาคำตอบที่เหมาะเมื่อมีหลาย objective
items.text_en: Why — almost every Context Engineering system has conflicting objectives, e.g. relevance vs completeness, quality vs latency, authority vs diversity; Multi-objective Optimization finds fitting answers under several objectives

items.text_th: Dominance — สำหรับ objectives f_1..f_k ที่ maximize: x1 dominates x2 เมื่อ f_j(x1) ≥ f_j(x2) ทุก j และมีอย่างน้อยหนึ่ง j ที่ >; Pareto-optimal = ไม่ถูก dominate; ต้อง normalize direction ก่อน (minimize → negate) — _as_maximize(score, directions)
items.text_en: Dominance — for objectives f_1..f_k to maximize: x1 dominates x2 when f_j(x1) ≥ f_j(x2) for every j and > for at least one j; Pareto-optimal = not dominated; directions are normalized first (minimize → negate) — _as_maximize(score, directions)

items.text_th: GIST — Pareto Frontier คือชุดตัวเลือกที่ 'ไม่มีตัวไหนชนะทุกด้าน' จึงต้องตัดสิน trade-off ตาม business priority; A (Relevance 0.93, Diversity 0.55, Cost high) กับ B (0.88, 0.82, medium) ไม่มีคำตอบว่าใครดีที่สุดจนกว่าจะกำหนด preference
items.text_en: GIST — the Pareto Frontier is the set of options where 'none wins on every axis', so the trade-off is decided by business priority; A (Relevance 0.93, Diversity 0.55, Cost high) vs B (0.88, 0.82, medium) has no 'best' until a preference is set

description.th: objectives, output, selection policy และ acceptance criteria
description.en: Objectives, output, selection policy and acceptance criteria.

items.text_th: Header and Objectives — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0, concept multi_objective_pareto; objectives {type array, min_items 2, fields [name, direction, measurement_method]} โดย direction ใช้ enum จาก OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md และ measurement_method คือชื่อของ workshop สำหรับ evaluator declaration (EVALUATION_SPEC.md) ไม่ใช่ enum ใหม่
items.text_en: Header and Objectives — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0, concept multi_objective_pareto; objectives {type array, min_items 2, fields [name, direction, measurement_method]} with direction taken from OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md and measurement_method being the workshop's name for the evaluator declaration (EVALUATION_SPEC.md), not a new enum

items.text_th: Output — return_pareto_front true; return_dominance_metadata true (ต่อ candidate: dominated_by[], pareto_rank — รูปที่ template กำหนดเพื่อทำให้ flag ของ workshop เป็นจริง ไม่เพิ่ม field ระดับ contract ไม่ bump); per-objective scores และ directions ต้องคงอยู่ในผลลัพธ์
items.text_en: Output — return_pareto_front true; return_dominance_metadata true (per candidate: dominated_by[], pareto_rank — the shape the template specifies to realise the workshop flag; no contract-level field added, no bump); per-objective scores and directions must remain in the result

items.text_th: Selection Policy — selection_policy.final_choice_rule {type string, allowed_values [BUSINESS_POLICY, WEIGHTED_UTILITY, EPSILON_CONSTRAINT, HUMAN_DECISION], value null, required true} — นิยาม enum ที่นี่ที่เดียว
items.text_en: Selection Policy — selection_policy.final_choice_rule {type string, allowed_values [BUSINESS_POLICY, WEIGHTED_UTILITY, EPSILON_CONSTRAINT, HUMAN_DECISION], value null, required true} — the enum is defined here only

items.text_th: Acceptance Criteria — dominated candidates ระบุได้; Pareto-optimal candidates เก็บ per-objective scores และ directions; mixed maximize/minimize objectives ถูก normalize หรือเทียบด้วย direction-aware dominance; business choice สุดท้ายไม่ถูกนำเสนอเป็น mathematical universal optimum
items.text_en: Acceptance Criteria — dominated candidates are identifiable; Pareto-optimal candidates preserve per-objective scores and directions; mixed maximize/minimize objectives are normalized or compared with direction-aware dominance; the final business choice is never presented as a mathematical universal optimum

items.text_th: Python Sketch — dominates(a, b, directions) และ pareto_front(points, directions) ที่รับ directions=(maximize, minimize, minimize) สำหรับ (quality, latency, cost) โดยไม่ต้องกลับเครื่องหมายเอง (SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md ทำเป็น typed function)
items.text_en: Python Sketch — dominates(a, b, directions) and pareto_front(points, directions) accepting directions=(maximize, minimize, minimize) for (quality, latency, cost) without manual sign flipping (SCHEMA_IMPLEMENTATION.md makes it a typed function)

description.th: weighted sum, epsilon-constraint, lexicographic — เมื่อไรใช้อะไร
description.en: Weighted sum, epsilon-constraint, lexicographic — when to use which.

items.text_th: scalarization_method — enum application-defined {WEIGHTED_SUM, EPSILON_CONSTRAINT, LEXICOGRAPHIC} นิยามที่นี่; ใช้เมื่อ final_choice_rule เป็น WEIGHTED_UTILITY หรือ EPSILON_CONSTRAINT เพื่อบอกวิธี collapse; ผลลัพธ์ vector ยังถูกเก็บ (ADR-3)
items.text_en: scalarization_method — application-defined enum {WEIGHTED_SUM, EPSILON_CONSTRAINT, LEXICOGRAPHIC} defined here; used when final_choice_rule is WEIGHTED_UTILITY or EPSILON_CONSTRAINT to state how the collapse is done; the vector result is still retained (ADR-3)

items.text_th: WEIGHTED_SUM — maximize Σ w_i f_i(x) เหมาะเมื่อ relative importance ถูกกำหนดและ scale ถูก normalize (OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md); EPSILON_CONSTRAINT — maximize f_1 subject to f_2 ≥ ε_2, f_3 ≥ ε_3 เหมาะเมื่อ objective หนึ่งเป็น primary และที่เหลือเป็น minimum acceptable floor
items.text_en: WEIGHTED_SUM — maximize Σ w_i f_i(x), suited when relative importance is set and scales are normalized (OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md); EPSILON_CONSTRAINT — maximize f_1 subject to f_2 ≥ ε_2, f_3 ≥ ε_3, suited when one objective is primary and the rest are minimum acceptable floors

items.text_th: LEXICOGRAPHIC — optimize ตาม priority order (เช่น 1 Safety/Correctness, 2 Citation Support, 3 Coverage, 4 Latency, 5 Cost) เหมาะเมื่อ stakeholder มีลำดับความสำคัญชัดและไม่ยอม trade objective สำคัญกับ objective รอง
items.text_en: LEXICOGRAPHIC — optimize in priority order (e.g. 1 Safety/Correctness, 2 Citation Support, 3 Coverage, 4 Latency, 5 Cost), suited when stakeholders have a clear priority order and will not trade a major objective for a minor one

items.text_th: Quality Floor Pattern — epsilon บน high-risk objective (เช่น decision_usefulness ≥ floor, legal_correctness ≥ floor) ทำหน้าที่เป็น constraint จริงใน FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md — optimizer ห้าม trade quality ลงต่ำกว่า floor เพื่อให้ latency/cost ดีขึ้น; ค่า floor เป็น null จน policy กำหนด
items.text_en: Quality Floor Pattern — an epsilon on a high-risk objective (e.g. decision_usefulness ≥ floor, legal_correctness ≥ floor) acts as a real constraint in FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md — the optimizer never trades quality below the floor for better latency/cost; the floor value is null until policy sets it

items.text_th: Don't Force a Weighted Sum — อย่าบังคับ weighted sum ถ้ายังไม่รู้ preference; เริ่มด้วย Pareto analysis แล้ว escalate ไป evolutionary multi-objective เมื่อ space ซับซ้อน (ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md)
items.text_en: Don't Force a Weighted Sum — never force a weighted sum before the preference is known; start with Pareto analysis and escalate to evolutionary multi-objective search when the space is complex (ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md)

description.th: front ของ BriefDesk retrieval tuning
description.en: BriefDesk's retrieval tuning front.

items.text_th: Objectives — decision_usefulness_proxy (maximize, MODEL_JUDGMENT — validated against the HUMAN_LABEL sample), diversity (maximize, DIRECT_METRIC), token_cost (minimize, DIRECT_METRIC); directions=(maximize, maximize, minimize)
items.text_en: Objectives — decision_usefulness_proxy (maximize, MODEL_JUDGMENT — validated against the HUMAN_LABEL sample), diversity (maximize, DIRECT_METRIC), token_cost (minimize, DIRECT_METRIC); directions=(maximize, maximize, minimize)

items.text_th: Front Shape (illustrative) — cand_0024 (0.81, 0.62, 7,300) และ cand_0012 (0.77, 0.80, 6,100) ไม่ dominate กัน; cand_0003 (0.74, 0.60, 7,400) ถูก cand_0024 dominate; dominance metadata เก็บ dominated_by และ pareto_rank ต่อ candidate
items.text_en: Front Shape (illustrative) — cand_0024 (0.81, 0.62, 7,300) and cand_0012 (0.77, 0.80, 6,100) do not dominate each other; cand_0003 (0.74, 0.60, 7,400) is dominated by cand_0024; dominance metadata stores dominated_by and pareto_rank per candidate

items.text_th: Final Choice — final_choice_rule BUSINESS_POLICY: เลือก candidate ที่ decision_usefulness_proxy สูงสุดบน front (ทุก front member ผ่าน hard budget 8,000 อยู่แล้ว) โดย token_cost / diversity ใช้ตัดสินเฉพาะเมื่อต่างกันน้อยกว่า min_meaningful_difference; usefulness floor (value null) เป็น policy hook สำหรับอนาคต → เลือก cand_0024; บันทึกเป็น decision record ใน DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md ไม่อ้างว่าเป็น universal optimum
items.text_en: Final Choice — final_choice_rule BUSINESS_POLICY: pick the candidate with the highest decision_usefulness_proxy on the front (every front member already satisfies the 8,000-token hard budget), with token_cost / diversity deciding only when the gap is below min_meaningful_difference; a usefulness floor (value null) is the policy hook for later → cand_0024 is chosen; recorded as a decision record in DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md, never claimed as a universal optimum

items.text_th: Use Cases and Impact — news briefing: relevance vs diversity เห็น trade-off ชัด; legal RAG: coverage vs latency ตั้ง service tier ได้; agent workflow: quality vs cost เลือก model/tool chain ตาม economics; context compression: brevity vs fidelity กำหนด acceptable loss
items.text_en: Use Cases and Impact — news briefing: relevance vs diversity shows the trade-off; legal RAG: coverage vs latency lets service tiers be set; agent workflow: quality vs cost picks model/tool chains by economics; context compression: brevity vs fidelity fixes the acceptable loss
