description.th: algorithm = วิธีค้นหา ไม่ใช่ definition ของ optimization
description.en: An algorithm = a way to search, not the definition of optimization.

items.text_th: Why — ต้นฉบับ optimization มักพาไป gradient, evolutionary และ Bayesian อย่างรวดเร็ว แต่ในงาน Context Engineering ตัวแปรและ evaluation cost ต่างกันมาก จึงต้องเลือก algorithm จาก problem characteristics ก่อน
items.text_en: Why — optimization textbooks rush to gradient, evolutionary and Bayesian methods, but in Context Engineering variables and evaluation cost differ widely, so the algorithm is chosen from problem characteristics first

items.text_th: GIST — Algorithm = วิธีค้นหา ไม่ใช่ definition ของ optimization; ไม่มี algorithm เดียวที่ดีที่สุดสำหรับทุกโจทย์; Team Rule ใน OPTIMIZATION_DOMAIN.md บังคับให้ Decision + Objective + Constraints + Evaluation มาก่อน
items.text_en: GIST — an algorithm is a way to search, not the definition of optimization; no single algorithm is best for every problem; the Team Rule in OPTIMIZATION_DOMAIN.md forces Decision + Objective + Constraints + Evaluation first

items.text_th: Baseline First — เริ่มด้วย method ที่ง่ายที่สุดที่ search space อนุญาต (exhaustive/grid เมื่อเล็ก, random เมื่อใหญ่, greedy เมื่อ subset under budget) เก็บผลเป็น reference แล้ว escalate เมื่อ characteristic บังคับ (ADR-1)
items.text_en: Baseline First — start with the simplest method the search space allows (exhaustive/grid when small, random when large, greedy for subset under budget), keep the result as a reference and escalate only when a characteristic demands it (ADR-1)

description.th: field ที่ต้องรู้ก่อนเลือก และ enum ที่นิยามที่นี่
description.en: Fields to know before choosing and the enums defined here.

items.text_th: Required Characteristics — variable_types {type array, item_allowed_values ตาม DECISION_SPACE.md, required true}; search_space_size {integer, nullable, value null}; differentiable {boolean, nullable, value null}; evaluation_cost และ evaluation_noise {string, allowed_values [low, medium, high], value null, required true}; num_objectives {integer, minimum 1, value null, required true}; hard_constraints_count {integer, minimum 0, value null, required true}
items.text_en: Required Characteristics — variable_types {type array, item_allowed_values per DECISION_SPACE.md, required true}; search_space_size {integer, nullable, value null}; differentiable {boolean, nullable, value null}; evaluation_cost and evaluation_noise {string, allowed_values [low, medium, high], value null, required true}; num_objectives {integer, minimum 1, value null, required true}; hard_constraints_count {integer, minimum 0, value null, required true}

items.text_th: evaluation_cost / evaluation_noise — enum {low, medium, high} นิยามที่นี่ที่เดียว; cost ประเมินจาก evaluation budget ต่อ candidate (EVALUATION_SPEC.md), noise จาก stdev ของ repeated evaluations; ทั้งสองต้องประกาศพร้อมเหตุผลใน rationale
items.text_en: evaluation_cost / evaluation_noise — enum {low, medium, high} defined here only; cost is judged from the evaluation budget per candidate (EVALUATION_SPEC.md), noise from the stdev of repeated evaluations; both are declared with a reason in the rationale

items.text_th: method_id — enum {exhaustive_or_grid, random_search, greedy_baseline, exact_combinatorial, gradient_based, evolutionary_or_pareto, bayesian_or_sample_efficient, adaptive_selection} นิยามที่นี่ — ค่า application-defined ที่ template ตั้งชื่อใหม่จาก string ของ teaching selector ใน workshop (grid_or_exhaustive → exhaustive_or_grid, exact_or_combinatorial_if_additive_or_modelable → exact_combinatorial, bayesian_or_other_sample_efficient_search → bayesian_or_sample_efficient, random_search_baseline → random_search; greedy_baseline, gradient_based, evolutionary_or_pareto คงเดิม; adaptive_selection เพิ่มจาก decision guide); ทุกค่าใน baseline / recommended_methods / rejected_algorithms / escalation_path ต้องมาจาก enum นี้ และแต่ละค่ามี contract ใน method-family doc
items.text_en: method_id — enum {exhaustive_or_grid, random_search, greedy_baseline, exact_combinatorial, gradient_based, evolutionary_or_pareto, bayesian_or_sample_efficient, adaptive_selection} defined here — application-defined names the template assigns to the workshop teaching selector's strings (grid_or_exhaustive → exhaustive_or_grid, exact_or_combinatorial_if_additive_or_modelable → exact_combinatorial, bayesian_or_other_sample_efficient_search → bayesian_or_sample_efficient, random_search_baseline → random_search; greedy_baseline, gradient_based, evolutionary_or_pareto unchanged; adaptive_selection added from the decision guide); every value in baseline / recommended_methods / rejected_algorithms / escalation_path comes from this enum and each has a contract in a method-family document

items.text_th: Where Methods Live — exhaustive_or_grid, random_search, greedy_baseline, exact_combinatorial → DISCRETE_SEARCH_METHODS.md; gradient_based, evolutionary_or_pareto → CONTINUOUS_POPULATION_METHODS.md; bayesian_or_sample_efficient, adaptive_selection → SAMPLE_EFFICIENT_ADAPTIVE_METHODS.md
items.text_en: Where Methods Live — exhaustive_or_grid, random_search, greedy_baseline, exact_combinatorial → DISCRETE_SEARCH_METHODS.md; gradient_based, evolutionary_or_pareto → CONTINUOUS_POPULATION_METHODS.md; bayesian_or_sample_efficient, adaptive_selection → SAMPLE_EFFICIENT_ADAPTIVE_METHODS.md

description.th: แผนผังตัดสินใจ, selection matrix, quick guide และ reference table
description.en: Decision tree, selection matrix, quick guide and reference table.

items.text_th: Decision Tree — search space เล็กมาก? → Exhaustive / Grid; selection ภายใต้ budget? → Greedy / Knapsack-style / combinatorial; continuous + differentiable? → Gradient-based; multi-objective / mixed / non-smooth? → Evolutionary / Pareto; evaluation แพงมาก? → Bayesian Optimization; unknown / changing conditions → Adaptive selection + experiment history — หลาย branch เป็นจริงพร้อมกันได้
items.text_en: Decision Tree — tiny search space? → Exhaustive / Grid; selection under budget? → Greedy / Knapsack-style / combinatorial; continuous + differentiable? → Gradient-based; multi-objective / mixed / non-smooth? → Evolutionary / Pareto; very expensive evaluation? → Bayesian Optimization; unknown / changing conditions → Adaptive selection + experiment history — several branches may hold at once

items.text_th: Selection Matrix — few discrete options → Exhaustive/Grid (transparent, reproducible); large discrete config → Random/heuristic (broad exploration, low complexity); subset under token budget → Greedy/Knapsack-style (matches selection structure); smooth continuous → Gradient (uses local slope); multi-objective/mixed → Evolutionary/Pareto (non-smooth spaces); expensive black-box → Bayesian (sample efficient); dynamic environment → Adaptive/bandit-like (learn from outcomes)
items.text_en: Selection Matrix — few discrete options → Exhaustive/Grid (transparent, reproducible); large discrete config → Random/heuristic (broad exploration, low complexity); subset under token budget → Greedy/Knapsack-style (matches selection structure); smooth continuous → Gradient (uses local slope); multi-objective/mixed → Evolutionary/Pareto (non-smooth spaces); expensive black-box → Bayesian (sample efficient); dynamic environment → Adaptive/bandit-like (learn from outcomes)

items.text_th: Quick Guide (Start With → Escalate To) — ตัวเลือก < 100: Exhaustive/Grid → —; หลายมิติแต่ eval ถูก: Random → Evolutionary; subset + token budget: Greedy → Knapsack/ILP/CP-SAT (exactness ขึ้นกับ formulation, interaction effects ต้อง model); continuous + smooth: Gradient → constrained gradient; multiple objectives: Pareto analysis → Evolutionary multi-objective (อย่าบังคับ weighted sum); expensive LLM benchmark: Bayesian → hybrid; dynamic production: monitoring + trigger → adaptive re-optimization (version + rollback)
items.text_en: Quick Guide (Start With → Escalate To) — < 100 options: Exhaustive/Grid → —; many dimensions but cheap eval: Random → Evolutionary; subset + token budget: Greedy → Knapsack/ILP/CP-SAT (exactness depends on the formulation, interaction effects must be modelled); continuous + smooth: Gradient → constrained gradient; multiple objectives: Pareto analysis → Evolutionary multi-objective (never force a weighted sum); expensive LLM benchmark: Bayesian → hybrid; dynamic production: monitoring + trigger → adaptive re-optimization (version + rollback)

items.text_th: Reference Table (variable type / needs gradient / handles mixed / multi-objective / expensive eval / typical use) — Exhaustive/Grid: discrete small / no / limited / via enumeration / poor scaling / top-k threshold baseline; Random: mixed / no / yes / possible / medium / baseline exploration; Greedy: subset discrete / no / limited / via custom utility / good / context selection under budget; Knapsack/ILP/CP-SAT: discrete combinatorial / no / yes depending solver / possible via formulation / medium / exact constrained subset selection; Gradient: continuous / yes or numeric approx / no direct / weighted objective / good if eval cheap / continuous weight tuning; Evolutionary: mixed / no / yes / strong / evaluation-heavy / complex config + Pareto; Bayesian: bounded mixed or continuous / no direct / often / possible / strong / expensive LLM benchmark tuning; Adaptive selection: strategy-level / depends / yes / yes / depends / production strategy switching
items.text_en: Reference Table (variable type / needs gradient / handles mixed / multi-objective / expensive eval / typical use) — Exhaustive/Grid: discrete small / no / limited / via enumeration / poor scaling / top-k threshold baseline; Random: mixed / no / yes / possible / medium / baseline exploration; Greedy: subset discrete / no / limited / via custom utility / good / context selection under budget; Knapsack/ILP/CP-SAT: discrete combinatorial / no / yes depending solver / possible via formulation / medium / exact constrained subset selection; Gradient: continuous / yes or numeric approx / no direct / weighted objective / good if eval cheap / continuous weight tuning; Evolutionary: mixed / no / yes / strong / evaluation-heavy / complex config + Pareto; Bayesian: bounded mixed or continuous / no direct / often / possible / strong / expensive LLM benchmark tuning; Adaptive selection: strategy-level / depends / yes / yes / depends / production strategy switching

description.th: output block, teaching selector และ acceptance criteria
description.en: Output block, teaching selector and acceptance criteria.

items.text_th: Header and Output — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.1, concept algorithm_selection; output {baseline (string, required), recommended_methods (array of string, required), rationale (array of string, required), rejected_algorithms (array of object {algorithm, reason}, required), escalation_path (array of string, required)} — ทุก method string ∈ method_id
items.text_en: Header and Output — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.1, concept algorithm_selection; output {baseline (string, required), recommended_methods (array of string, required), rationale (array of string, required), rejected_algorithms (array of object {algorithm, reason}, required), escalation_path (array of string, required)} — every method string ∈ method_id

items.text_th: Teaching Selector — recommend_optimization_strategy(problem) เป็น rule-based heuristic: search_space_size ≤ 100 → grid; subset_under_budget → greedy + exact_or_combinatorial; continuous ∧ differentiable → gradient มิฉะนั้น reject gradient พร้อม reason; num_objectives > 1 ∨ mixed → evolutionary_or_pareto; evaluation_cost high → bayesian; ว่าง → random baseline; คืน strategy set + rationale ไม่ใช่ production auto-selector
items.text_en: Teaching Selector — recommend_optimization_strategy(problem) is a rule-based heuristic: search_space_size ≤ 100 → grid; subset_under_budget → greedy + exact_or_combinatorial; continuous ∧ differentiable → gradient, otherwise reject gradient with a reason; num_objectives > 1 ∨ mixed → evolutionary_or_pareto; evaluation_cost high → bayesian; nothing matched → random baseline; returns a strategy set + rationale, not a production auto-selector

items.text_th: Acceptance Criteria — recommendation อ้าง problem characteristics; อาจคืนหลาย compatible methods เมื่อ characteristics ทับกัน; discrete variables ไม่ถูก treat เป็น continuous เงียบ ๆ; expensive evaluation ถูกพิจารณาร่วมกับ variable type และ objective structure ไม่ใช่ unconditional override
items.text_en: Acceptance Criteria — the recommendation cites problem characteristics; several compatible methods may be returned when characteristics overlap; discrete variables are never silently treated as continuous; expensive evaluation is weighed together with variable type and objective structure, never as an unconditional override

items.text_th: Record in Log — selection record ถูกเก็บเป็น field algorithm ของ run และอ้างใน event (EXPERIMENT_LOG.md); เปลี่ยน method = experiment ใหม่ ไม่แก้ record เดิม
items.text_en: Record in Log — the selection record is stored as the run's algorithm field and referenced in events (EXPERIMENT_LOG.md); changing method = a new experiment, never editing the old record

description.th: selection record ของ BriefDesk ทั้งสองโจทย์
description.en: BriefDesk's selection records for both problems.

items.text_th: briefdesk_brief_selection — characteristics: variable_types [binary], search_space_size 4,096 (792 with exactly five), differentiable false, evaluation_cost low (item-level DIRECT_METRIC / PROXY scores + judge ต่อ item 12 ครั้ง; judge ระดับ brief เฉพาะ top-5 subsets), evaluation_noise medium, num_objectives 6 (vector; baseline scalar = ผลรวม strategic_relevance_proxy ตาม top-relevance-only baseline, scalarization_method null), hard_constraints_count 4 (นับ PRE_EXECUTION + POST_EXECUTION; gates ไม่นับ; evaluation budget นับแยก); output: baseline exhaustive_or_grid, recommended [exhaustive_or_grid, greedy_baseline, exact_combinatorial], rejected [{gradient_based, 'binary decision, no differentiable path'}, {bayesian_or_sample_efficient, 'evaluation cost low and space enumerable'}], escalation [greedy_baseline (เมื่อ daily pool โตถึง ~100 ในอนาคต), exact_combinatorial (เมื่อ additive assumption ยอมรับได้)]
items.text_en: briefdesk_brief_selection — characteristics: variable_types [binary], search_space_size 4,096 (792 with exactly five), differentiable false, evaluation_cost low (item-level DIRECT_METRIC / PROXY scores + 12 per-item judge calls; brief-level judge only for the top-5 subsets), evaluation_noise medium, num_objectives 6 (vector; baseline scalar = sum of strategic_relevance_proxy per the top-relevance-only baseline, scalarization_method null), hard_constraints_count 4 (counts PRE_EXECUTION + POST_EXECUTION; gates excluded; evaluation budget counted separately); output: baseline exhaustive_or_grid, recommended [exhaustive_or_grid, greedy_baseline, exact_combinatorial], rejected [{gradient_based, 'binary decision, no differentiable path'}, {bayesian_or_sample_efficient, 'evaluation cost low and space enumerable'}], escalation [greedy_baseline (when the daily pool grows to ~100 in future), exact_combinatorial (when the additive assumption is acceptable)]

items.text_th: briefdesk_retrieval_tuning — characteristics: variable_types [integer, continuous, categorical, structured], search_space_size null (mixed, continuous), differentiable false (judge score ไม่มี differentiable path), evaluation_cost high (60 briefs × 3 repeats + reviewer sample), evaluation_noise medium, num_objectives 3, hard_constraints_count 4 (same counting rule; evaluation budget separate); output: baseline exhaustive_or_grid (9 configs, strategy fixed), recommended [exhaustive_or_grid, bayesian_or_sample_efficient, evolutionary_or_pareto], rejected [{gradient_based, 'no differentiable computation graph through the judge'}], escalation [bayesian_or_sample_efficient, evolutionary_or_pareto, adaptive_selection]
items.text_en: briefdesk_retrieval_tuning — characteristics: variable_types [integer, continuous, categorical, structured], search_space_size null (mixed, continuous), differentiable false (judge score has no differentiable path), evaluation_cost high (60 briefs × 3 repeats + reviewer sample), evaluation_noise medium, num_objectives 3, hard_constraints_count 4 (same counting rule; evaluation budget separate); output: baseline exhaustive_or_grid (9 configs, strategy fixed), recommended [exhaustive_or_grid, bayesian_or_sample_efficient, evolutionary_or_pareto], rejected [{gradient_based, 'no differentiable computation graph through the judge'}], escalation [bayesian_or_sample_efficient, evolutionary_or_pareto, adaptive_selection]

items.text_th: Reframing Note — ถ้าโจทย์ selection ถูกมองเป็น 'tune top_k ∈ {10,20,30}, dedupe_threshold ∈ {0.80,0.90}' จะเริ่มด้วย grid; แต่เมื่อโจทย์คือ 'เลือก 5 จาก 100 ภายใต้ token budget' framing เป็น budgeted subset selection แล้วใช้ greedy/combinatorial ตรงโครงสร้างกว่า
items.text_en: Reframing Note — if the selection problem is seen as 'tune top_k ∈ {10,20,30}, dedupe_threshold ∈ {0.80,0.90}' it starts with grid; but when the problem is 'choose 5 of 100 under a token budget', framing it as budgeted subset selection and using greedy/combinatorial matches the structure better

items.text_th: Use Cases and Impact — 12 RAG configurations → Grid Search: baseline ครบ debug ง่าย; 100 candidate chunks / 8K tokens → Greedy/combinatorial: match subset structure; LLM benchmark แพง → Bayesian: ลด evaluation count; quality + latency + cost → Pareto/Evolutionary: เห็น trade-off หลายมิติ
items.text_en: Use Cases and Impact — 12 RAG configurations → Grid Search: complete, easy-to-debug baseline; 100 candidate chunks / 8K tokens → Greedy/combinatorial: matches subset structure; expensive LLM benchmark → Bayesian: fewer evaluations; quality + latency + cost → Pareto/Evolutionary: multi-dimensional trade-off visible

description.th: สาม contract สำหรับ discrete / selection problems — simple_search/v1.0 (exhaustive, grid, random), greedy_budgeted_selection/v1.0 (marginal value ต่อ token, heuristic ไม่อ้าง global optimum) และ exact_combinatorial_optimization/v1.1 (knapsack / ILP / CP-SAT ภายใต้ additive assumption); owner ของ enum objective_structure, solver_family และ optimization_class
description.en: Three contracts for discrete / selection problems — simple_search/v1.0 (exhaustive, grid, random), greedy_budgeted_selection/v1.0 (marginal value per token, a heuristic never claiming global optimum) and exact_combinatorial_optimization/v1.1 (knapsack / ILP / CP-SAT under an additive assumption); owner of the objective_structure, solver_family and optimization_class enums.

description.th: baseline ที่ไม่ควรมองข้าม — ถ้าลองทุกทางเลือกได้ในต้นทุนที่รับได้ อย่าเพิ่ม complexity
description.en: The baseline not to skip — if every option can be tried at acceptable cost, add no complexity.

items.text_th: Definitions — Exhaustive Search ลองทุก combination; Grid Search ลองค่าตาม grid ที่กำหนด; Random Search sample configuration จาก search space; x* = arg max_{x ∈ S} f(x) เมื่อ |S| เล็กพอ evaluate ทุกตัว
items.text_en: Definitions — Exhaustive Search tries every combination; Grid Search tries values on a declared grid; Random Search samples configurations from the search space; x* = arg max_{x ∈ S} f(x) when |S| is small enough to evaluate all

items.text_th: Why Baseline — search space เล็กหรือ parameter ไม่กี่ตัวมักแก้ได้ด้วย simple search ซึ่ง debug ง่ายและบอกว่าปัญหาจริงยากแค่ไหน; GIST: ถ้าลองทุกทางเลือกได้ในต้นทุนที่รับได้ — อย่าเพิ่ม complexity โดยไม่จำเป็น
items.text_en: Why Baseline — small spaces or few parameters are often solved by simple search, which is easy to debug and reveals how hard the real problem is; GIST: if every option can be tried at acceptable cost — add no unnecessary complexity

items.text_th: Python Sketch — grid_search(space, evaluate, is_feasible): product ของ values → candidate → is_feasible ไม่ผ่านไป rejected → evaluate → best; คืน {best, evaluated_candidates, rejected_candidates, evaluation_count}
items.text_en: Python Sketch — grid_search(space, evaluate, is_feasible): product of values → candidate → infeasible goes to rejected → evaluate → best; returns {best, evaluated_candidates, rejected_candidates, evaluation_count}

items.text_en: Contract simple_search/v1.0 — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0, concept simple_search, methods [exhaustive, grid, random]; use_when [search_space_is_small_or_sampleable, baseline_is_needed]; required_outputs [best_candidate, best_score, evaluated_candidates, evaluation_count]; acceptance: same seed → same random-search sequence when reproducibility is required, infeasible candidates rejected before scoring, evaluation count reported

items.text_th: Use Cases — top-k / threshold tuning → Grid (baseline เข้าใจง่าย); prompt variants → Exhaustive (เปรียบเทียบครบเมื่อจำนวนไม่มาก); large mixed space baseline → Random (สำรวจกว้างกว่า grid ทุกมิติ); BriefDesk: top_k {10,20,30} × dedupe_threshold {0.80,0.85,0.90} = 9 configurations → grid เหมาะ
items.text_en: Use Cases — top-k / threshold tuning → Grid (easy-to-understand baseline); prompt variants → Exhaustive (complete comparison when few); large mixed space baseline → Random (broader than gridding every axis); BriefDesk: top_k {10,20,30} × dedupe_threshold {0.80,0.85,0.90} = 9 configurations → grid fits

description.th: หยิบชิ้นที่เพิ่ม value ต่อ token มากที่สุดทีละชิ้น — heuristic ที่ตรงโครงสร้าง context assembly
description.en: Pick the item adding the most value per token one at a time — a heuristic matching the structure of context assembly.

items.text_th: Why — ข่าว, chunks, memories และ examples มาเป็นรายการ candidate หลายชิ้นแต่ context window จำกัด จึงต้องตัดสินว่า 'หยิบชิ้นไหนก่อน' มากกว่าปรับ continuous parameter; GIST: อย่าถามแค่ 'ชิ้นนี้ดีไหม' ให้ถาม 'หลังจากสิ่งที่เลือกไปแล้ว ชิ้นนี้เพิ่ม value ต่อ token อีกเท่าไร'
items.text_en: Why — news items, chunks, memories and examples arrive as many candidates while the context window is limited, so the decision is 'which piece first' rather than tuning a continuous parameter; GIST: do not ask 'is this piece good' but 'after what is already chosen, how much value per token does this piece add'

items.text_th: Mathematics — MarginalUtility(i | S) = Relevance(i) + Authority(i) + Novelty(i | S) − Redundancy(i, S); score(i | S) = MarginalUtility(i | S) / TokenCost(i) — the unit weights inside the marginal-value formula are part of the heuristic, not calibrated objective weights (which stay null in OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md); loop: S = [] → score marginal/cost → pick best feasible → update S → re-score → stop when budget full or marginal value ≤ 0 — เป็น heuristic ไม่เรียก globally optimal โดยอัตโนมัติ
items.text_en: Mathematics — MarginalUtility(i | S) = Relevance(i) + Authority(i) + Novelty(i | S) − Redundancy(i, S); score(i | S) = MarginalUtility(i | S) / TokenCost(i) — the unit weights inside the marginal-value formula are part of the heuristic, not calibrated objective weights (which stay null in OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md); loop: S = [] → score marginal/cost → pick best feasible → update S → re-score → stop when the budget is full or marginal value ≤ 0 — a heuristic, never automatically called globally optimal

items.text_th: Python Sketch — greedy_budget_select(items, budget, marginal_value): ตรวจ unique ids → loop feasible (used + tokens ≤ budget) → density = gain / max(tokens, 1) → pick max density, stop เมื่อ gain ≤ 0 → trace {selected_id, marginal_gain, value_per_token, used_tokens}; คืน {selected, used_tokens, trace}
items.text_en: Python Sketch — greedy_budget_select(items, budget, marginal_value): check unique ids → loop feasible (used + tokens ≤ budget) → density = gain / max(tokens, 1) → pick max density, stop when gain ≤ 0 → trace {selected_id, marginal_gain, value_per_token, used_tokens}; returns {selected, used_tokens, trace}

items.text_th: Contract greedy_budgeted_selection/v1.0 — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0, concept greedy_budgeted_selection; inputs {candidates array, budget integer, marginal_value_function callable_spec, cost_field tokens}; algorithm_properties {optimization_class heuristic, global_optimality_claim false}; required_behavior [recompute_marginal_value_after_each_selection, never_exceed_budget, stop_when_no_positive_feasible_gain]; acceptance: total selected cost ≤ budget, duplicate candidate ids ห้ามถูกเลือกซ้ำ, marginal-value trace ถูก log เพื่อ audit
items.text_en: Contract greedy_budgeted_selection/v1.0 — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0, concept greedy_budgeted_selection; inputs {candidates array, budget integer, marginal_value_function callable_spec, cost_field tokens}; algorithm_properties {optimization_class heuristic, global_optimality_claim false}; required_behavior [recompute_marginal_value_after_each_selection, never_exceed_budget, stop_when_no_positive_feasible_gain]; acceptance: total selected cost ≤ budget, duplicate candidate ids can never be selected twice, the marginal-value trace is logged for audit

items.text_th: Wording Rule (Mistake 26) — greedy เป็น heuristic ที่ดีในหลายโจทย์แต่ไม่รับประกัน optimality ทุก formulation; ใช้คำว่า 'greedy heuristic' เว้นแต่มี property ของ objective/problem ที่พิสูจน์ guarantee ได้ (เช่น monotone submodular ให้ approximation bound — ต้องอ้างเงื่อนไข ไม่ใช่สมมติ)
items.text_en: Wording Rule (Mistake 26) — greedy is a good heuristic in many problems but guarantees optimality in no general formulation; say 'greedy heuristic' unless a provable property of the objective/problem exists (e.g. monotone submodular gives an approximation bound — cite the condition, never assume it)

items.text_th: Use Cases — news selection: subset + token budget → relevance ต่อ token ดีขึ้น; RAG evidence: marginal coverage → ลด duplicate chunks; memory retrieval: select few memories → information density สูงขึ้น; few-shot examples: diversity under budget → ครอบ edge cases
items.text_en: Use Cases — news selection: subset + token budget → better relevance per token; RAG evidence: marginal coverage → fewer duplicate chunks; memory retrieval: few memories → higher information density; few-shot examples: diversity under budget → more edge cases covered

items.text_th: External Marginal-Value Terms — marginal_value_function_ref / redundancy_measure_ref / corpus_novelty_proxy_ref ที่มาจาก information-theory ใช้ได้ต่อเมื่อ package ของมันผ่าน Information Value Package Gate แล้วเท่านั้น (HANDOFF.md) และ trace ต้องบันทึก package_id กำกับ term นั้น; redundancy ที่คำนวณเองในระบบ (เช่น จาก cluster_id ใน worked run นี้) เป็นของ heuristic ตัวเอง ไม่ต้องผ่าน gate แต่ต้องแยกให้ออกใน trace ว่า term ไหนมาจากทางไหน — ห้ามผสมสองแหล่งใน term เดียวกันโดยไม่ระบุที่มา
items.text_en: External Marginal-Value Terms — a marginal_value_function_ref / redundancy_measure_ref / corpus_novelty_proxy_ref originating from information-theory may only be used once its package has cleared the Information Value Package Gate (HANDOFF.md), and the trace must record the package_id against that term; a redundancy computed locally by this system (as the cluster_id-based one in this worked run is) belongs to the heuristic itself, needs no gate, but must stay distinguishable in the trace — never blend the two sources into one term without stating which is which

description.th: เมื่อโจทย์เป็น 'เลือก subset' และต้องการคำตอบเป็นระบบกว่า greedy — knapsack, ILP, CP-SAT ภายใต้ formulation ที่ระบุ
description.en: When the problem is 'choose a subset' and needs a more systematic answer than greedy — knapsack, ILP, CP-SAT under a stated formulation.

items.text_th: Why and GIST — greedy เร็วและเหมาะกับ Context Engineering แต่ไม่รับประกัน global optimum ใน 0/1 subset selection ทั่วไป; หาก utility และ constraints formalize ได้ชัด ใช้ Knapsack, ILP หรือ CP-SAT ค้นหาอย่างเป็นระบบ; GIST: Greedy ถามว่า 'หยิบอะไรต่อดี'; Exact ถามว่า 'ในชุดที่เป็นไปได้ทั้งหมด ชุดไหนดีที่สุดภายใต้ formulation นี้'
items.text_en: Why and GIST — greedy is fast and fits Context Engineering but guarantees no global optimum in general 0/1 subset selection; when utility and constraints can be formalized cleanly, Knapsack, ILP or CP-SAT search systematically; GIST: Greedy asks 'what to pick next'; Exact asks 'among all feasible sets, which is best under this formulation'

items.text_th: Additive Knapsack — maximize Σ v_i x_i subject to Σ c_i x_i ≤ B, x_i ∈ {0,1} (v_i estimated value, c_i token cost, B budget); สำคัญ: formulation นี้สมมติ value additive — ถ้า value ของชิ้นหนึ่งขึ้นกับชิ้นที่เลือกแล้ว (redundancy / coverage interaction) ต้องเพิ่ม interaction terms, constraints หรือใช้ formulation/solver ที่รองรับ ไม่ควรอ้างว่า basic knapsack แทน Context Utility จริงทั้งหมด
items.text_en: Additive Knapsack — maximize Σ v_i x_i subject to Σ c_i x_i ≤ B, x_i ∈ {0,1} (v_i estimated value, c_i token cost, B budget); crucial: this formulation assumes additive value — if one item's value depends on items already chosen (redundancy / coverage interaction), add interaction terms, constraints or a formulation/solver that supports them; never claim basic knapsack represents the full Context Utility

items.text_th: Enums Owned Here — objective_structure {additive, linear, constraint_programming, custom}; solver_family {dynamic_programming, knapsack, ILP, CP_SAT, custom}; optimization_class {heuristic, exact} (application-defined — workshop ใช้ค่า heuristic ใน greedy contract; template เพิ่ม exact เพื่อให้ log ระบุ class ได้)
items.text_en: Enums Owned Here — objective_structure {additive, linear, constraint_programming, custom}; solver_family {dynamic_programming, knapsack, ILP, CP_SAT, custom}; optimization_class {heuristic, exact} (application-defined — the workshop uses heuristic in the greedy contract; the template adds exact so logs can state the class)

items.text_th: Python Sketch — knapsack_select(items, budget): DP dp[b] = (best_value, selected_ids) ไล่ b จาก budget ลง cost; ตรวจ unique ids และ budget ≥ 0; คืน {selected, total_value, used_tokens, optimality_scope 'exact_for_this_additive_0_1_knapsack_formulation'}
items.text_en: Python Sketch — knapsack_select(items, budget): DP dp[b] = (best_value, selected_ids) iterating b from budget down to cost; checks unique ids and budget ≥ 0; returns {selected, total_value, used_tokens, optimality_scope 'exact_for_this_additive_0_1_knapsack_formulation'}

items.text_th: Contract exact_combinatorial_optimization/v1.1 — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.1, concept exact_combinatorial_optimization; variable_domain {string, allowed_values [binary, integer, categorical], value binary, required}; formulation.objective_structure และ formulation.solver_family (allowed_values ตาม enum ข้างต้น, value null, required); governance {model_assumptions_must_be_documented true, global_optimality_claim_limited_to_formulated_problem true, hard_constraints_encoded_or_checked_explicitly true}; acceptance: subset ไม่เกิน budget, duplicate ids ถูกปฏิเสธ, ทุก claim ของ exact optimality ระบุ formulation และ solver scope, interaction effects เช่น redundancy ไม่ถูก treat เป็น additive เงียบ ๆ
items.text_en: Contract exact_combinatorial_optimization/v1.1 — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.1, concept exact_combinatorial_optimization; variable_domain {string, allowed_values [binary, integer, categorical], value binary, required}; formulation.objective_structure and formulation.solver_family (allowed_values per the enums above, value null, required); governance {model_assumptions_must_be_documented true, global_optimality_claim_limited_to_formulated_problem true, hard_constraints_encoded_or_checked_explicitly true}; acceptance: subset never exceeds the budget, duplicate ids rejected, every exact-optimality claim states the formulation and solver scope, interaction effects e.g. redundancy are never silently treated as additive

items.text_th: Business Constraints in ILP/CP-SAT — coverage เช่น 'อย่างน้อย 1 ข่าว Cybersecurity' หรือ 'primary source อย่างน้อย 1 ชิ้น, ห้าม source หมดอายุ' เขียนเป็น linear constraint ได้ตรงกว่า greedy; Use Cases: additive value under budget → 0/1 Knapsack; selection + category/source requirements → ILP/CP-SAT; complex assignment → CP-SAT/ILP (audit ได้); strong interaction value → richer model หรือ heuristic (ไม่หลอกตัวเองด้วย additive assumption)
items.text_en: Business Constraints in ILP/CP-SAT — coverage e.g. 'at least one Cybersecurity item' or 'at least one primary source, no expired source' is expressed as linear constraints more directly than in greedy; Use Cases: additive value under budget → 0/1 Knapsack; selection + category/source requirements → ILP/CP-SAT; complex assignment → CP-SAT/ILP (auditable); strong interaction value → richer model or heuristic (no self-deception via the additive assumption)

description.th: BriefDesk brief selection: exhaustive → greedy → knapsack caveat
description.en: BriefDesk brief selection: exhaustive → greedy → knapsack caveat.

items.text_th: Exhaustive Baseline — run_briefdesk_2026_09_04_002 / exp_briefdesk_2026_09_04_002: 792 exactly-five subsets จาก 12 candidate ids; pre-execution filter (token_budget, source availability, blocklist) เหลือ feasible subsets; คะแนนต่อ subset เป็น item-level (strategic_relevance_proxy judge ต่อ item 12 ครั้ง + source_authority, diversity, novelty_proxy, token_cost แบบ DIRECT_METRIC / PROXY) → evaluation_cost low และ exhaustive ทำได้; judge ระดับ brief เฉพาะ top-5 subsets ภายใต้ budget 20; best-found scalar (ผลรวม strategic_relevance_proxy) 3.66, used_tokens 7,120 (illustrative)
items.text_en: Exhaustive Baseline — run_briefdesk_2026_09_04_002 / exp_briefdesk_2026_09_04_002: 792 exactly-five subsets from 12 candidate ids; the pre-execution filter (token_budget, source availability, blocklist) leaves the feasible subsets; subset scores are item-level (strategic_relevance_proxy judged once per item, 12 calls, plus source_authority, diversity, novelty_proxy, token_cost as DIRECT_METRIC / PROXY) → evaluation_cost low and exhaustive is feasible; brief-level judging only for the top-5 subsets under a budget of 20; best-found scalar (sum of strategic_relevance_proxy) 3.66, used_tokens 7,120 (illustrative)

items.text_th: Greedy Trace — exp_briefdesk_2026_09_04_004 (experiment ใหม่ เพราะเปลี่ยน method): marginal_value ใช้ strategic_relevance_proxy + source_authority + novelty_proxy(i | S) − redundancy(i, S) จาก cluster_id; เลือก 5 ชิ้น scalar 3.61, used_tokens 6,880; trace บันทึก marginal_gain และ value_per_token ทุก step; ผลต่าง scalar 0.05 จาก exhaustive อยู่ในช่วง judge stdev (0.03 ต่อ item) → รายงานเป็น 'ไม่แยกได้ภายใต้ noise' ไม่ใช่ 'greedy เท่ากับ optimal'
items.text_en: Greedy Trace — exp_briefdesk_2026_09_04_004 (a new experiment because the method changed): marginal_value uses strategic_relevance_proxy + source_authority + novelty_proxy(i | S) − redundancy(i, S) from cluster_id; five items selected, scalar 3.61, used_tokens 6,880; the trace records marginal_gain and value_per_token at every step; the 0.05 scalar gap to exhaustive lies within the judge stdev (0.03 per item) → reported as 'indistinguishable under noise', never 'greedy equals optimal'

items.text_th: Knapsack Caveat — knapsack_select ใช้ได้เมื่อ v_i คงที่ต่อชิ้น; novelty_proxy และ diversity เป็น interaction terms → additive assumption ไม่ครบ; ทางเลือก: ILP/CP-SAT พร้อม constraint 'ไม่เกิน 2 ชิ้นต่อ cluster_id' และ 'kn_ctrl_nist_ac_2 หรือ kn_policy_cold_chain_v4 อย่างน้อยหนึ่ง' — บันทึก model_assumptions ใน run
items.text_en: Knapsack Caveat — knapsack_select applies when v_i is fixed per item; novelty_proxy and diversity are interaction terms → the additive assumption is incomplete; alternative: ILP/CP-SAT with constraints 'at most 2 items per cluster_id' and 'at least one of kn_ctrl_nist_ac_2 or kn_policy_cold_chain_v4' — model_assumptions recorded in the run

items.text_th: Baseline Comparison — baseline top-relevance-only (briefdesk_selection_config/v1.0) vs greedy selection (candidate สำหรับ briefdesk_selection_config/v1.1): brief-level decision_usefulness_proxy lift +0.07 (stdev 0.03, n 3 — เกิน min_meaningful_difference 0.06), diversity เพิ่ม, token efficiency ดีขึ้น, decision_usefulness (HUMAN_LABEL) ต้องรอ holdout — ตัวเลข illustrative และทุกตัวมี measurement_class ใน EXPERIMENT_LOG.md
items.text_en: Baseline Comparison — baseline top-relevance-only (briefdesk_selection_config/v1.0) vs greedy selection (candidate for briefdesk_selection_config/v1.1): brief-level decision_usefulness_proxy lift +0.07 (stdev 0.03, n 3 — above the 0.06 min_meaningful_difference), higher diversity, better token efficiency, decision_usefulness (HUMAN_LABEL) awaits holdout — figures are illustrative and each carries a measurement_class in EXPERIMENT_LOG.md

description.th: สอง contract — gradient_based_optimization/v1.0 (continuous + smooth objective, bounds/projection, local optimum, prohibited uses) และ evolutionary_optimization/v1.0 (population, mutation/crossover, seed, cache ตาม candidate_id, vector scores + Pareto status); penalty / barrier / projection / Lagrangian จาก Appendix B; local vs global optimum; Mistake 27 staircase objective
description.en: Two contracts — gradient_based_optimization/v1.0 (continuous + smooth objective, bounds/projection, local optimum, prohibited uses) and evolutionary_optimization/v1.0 (population, mutation/crossover, seed, cache by candidate_id, vector scores + Pareto status); penalty / barrier / projection / Lagrangian from Appendix B; local vs global optimum; Mistake 27 the staircase objective.

agent_hints.instruction: Generate a CONTINUOUS_POPULATION_METHODS.md holding two contracts. Gradient-based: definition and update rule, the engineering boundary (not for binary/categorical/cast integers/LLM scores without a differentiable path), the numerical_gradient / gradient_ascent sketch with bounds projection, contract gradient_based_optimization/v1.0 with parameters null and two prohibited uses, the Mistake 27 staircase and the fit table. Constrained techniques: penalty, barrier, projection, Lagrangian with their guarantee limits and the local vs global optimum stance. Evolutionary: definition and loop, why it fits mixed/non-smooth/multi-objective spaces, the evolutionary_search sketch with seed and score_cache, the cache caveat for stochastic evaluators, contract evolutionary_optimization/v1.0 with its five acceptance criteria and the vector-scores rule. Close with BriefDesk's tuning escalation (gradient rejected with reason, evolutionary setup with null sizes, why it follows Bayesian).
agent_hints.input_context: Contracts are quoted from workshop sections 15-16; penalty/barrier/projection/Lagrangian from Appendix B; local vs global from Appendix C. variable_type and serialization come from DECISION_SPACE.md; Pareto status from MULTI_OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md. All learning rates, population sizes and generation counts stay null.
agent_hints.validation: Both contracts must carry their exact schema_version and concept strings with parameters null. The two prohibited uses of gradient and the five acceptance criteria of evolutionary must appear. The Lagrangian must carry the 'no unconditional guarantee' caveat. The BriefDesk gradient rejection must cite the missing differentiable path. No population size or learning rate may be given a value.

description.th: ใช้เมื่อ space เป็น continuous และ objective มีโครงสร้างเหมาะสม — ให้ local optimum
description.en: Use when the space is continuous and the objective has suitable structure — yields a local optimum.

items.text_th: Definition — gradient-based method อัปเดต parameter ตาม slope ของ objective: θ_{t+1} = θ_t + η ∇f(θ_t) (θ continuous parameters, η learning rate, ∇f gradient); GIST: gradient คือลูกศรบอกว่าขยับ parameter ไปทางไหนแล้ว objective ดีขึ้นเร็วที่สุดในบริเวณนั้น
items.text_en: Definition — a gradient-based method updates parameters along the objective's slope: θ_{t+1} = θ_t + η ∇f(θ_t) (θ continuous parameters, η learning rate, ∇f gradient); GIST: the gradient is the arrow saying which way to move so the objective improves fastest nearby

items.text_th: Engineering Boundary — ไม่เหมาะโดยตรงกับ include/exclude binary, categorical strategy, integer ที่ถูก cast ไปมา และ LLM score ที่ไม่มี differentiable path; ถ้าจะใช้กับ discrete decision ต้องมี relaxation / differentiable surrogate ที่ define ชัด (DECISION_SPACE.md)
items.text_en: Engineering Boundary — not a direct fit for binary include/exclude, categorical strategies, integers cast back and forth, or LLM scores without a differentiable path; using it on discrete decisions requires a clearly defined relaxation / differentiable surrogate (DECISION_SPACE.md)

items.text_th: Python Sketch — numerical_gradient(f, x, eps) central difference; _project_bounds(x, bounds) clamp; gradient_ascent(f, x, bounds, learning_rate, max_steps, convergence_tolerance) คืน {x, score, converged, steps, history} — teaching code ไม่ใช่ production optimizer
items.text_en: Python Sketch — numerical_gradient(f, x, eps) central difference; _project_bounds(x, bounds) clamp; gradient_ascent(f, x, bounds, learning_rate, max_steps, convergence_tolerance) returns {x, score, converged, steps, history} — teaching code, not a production optimizer

items.text_th: Contract gradient_based_optimization/v1.0 — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0, concept gradient_based_optimization; preconditions {variable_domain continuous, differentiable_or_numerically_smooth true, discrete_relaxation_if_any explicit}; parameters {learning_rate null, max_steps null, convergence_tolerance null}; prohibited_uses [silently_casting_continuous_updates_to_discrete_decisions, claiming_global_optimum_from_local_gradient_ascent]; acceptance: objective ดีขึ้นบน controlled test function, bounds ถูก enforce อย่างชัดเจน, convergence metadata ถูกคืน
items.text_en: Contract gradient_based_optimization/v1.0 — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0, concept gradient_based_optimization; preconditions {variable_domain continuous, differentiable_or_numerically_smooth true, discrete_relaxation_if_any explicit}; parameters {learning_rate null, max_steps null, convergence_tolerance null}; prohibited_uses [silently_casting_continuous_updates_to_discrete_decisions, claiming_global_optimum_from_local_gradient_ascent]; acceptance: the objective improves on a controlled test function, bounds are enforced explicitly, convergence metadata is returned

items.text_th: Mistake 27 Staircase — ถ้า parameter update เป็น float แต่สุดท้าย int() ทุกครั้ง objective กลายเป็น staircase และ numerical gradient ใช้ไม่ได้ตามที่คาด; ต้องแยก continuous tuning ออกจาก discrete / combinatorial selection
items.text_en: Mistake 27 Staircase — when parameter updates are floats but int() is applied every time, the objective becomes a staircase and the numerical gradient fails; separate continuous tuning from discrete / combinatorial selection

items.text_th: Use Cases — continuous ranking weights: good fit (tuning เร็วเมื่อ landscape smooth); binary chunk selection: poor direct fit (ใช้ combinatorial); LLM API black-box score: usually poor (Bayesian / evolutionary เหมาะกว่า); BriefDesk component_weights ใช้ gradient ได้เฉพาะเมื่อมี differentiable surrogate ของ judge score — ในทางปฏิบัติถูก reject (ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md)
items.text_en: Use Cases — continuous ranking weights: good fit (fast tuning on a smooth landscape); binary chunk selection: poor direct fit (use combinatorial); LLM API black-box score: usually poor (Bayesian / evolutionary fit better); BriefDesk component_weights admit gradient only with a differentiable surrogate of the judge score — in practice rejected (ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md)

sections.heading: Constrained Techniques — Penalty, Barrier, Projection, Lagrangian

description.th: เครื่องมือ constrained optimization และข้อจำกัดของ guarantee
description.en: Constrained-optimization tools and the limits of their guarantees.

items.text_th: Penalty — maximize f(x) − λ · Violation(x): เหมาะกับ soft constraints หรือ temporary violation ระหว่าง search แต่ไม่ทำให้ hard constraint ปลอดภัยโดยอัตโนมัติ (FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md ยังตรวจจริง)
items.text_en: Penalty — maximize f(x) − λ · Violation(x): suits soft constraints or temporary violations during search but never makes a hard constraint safe automatically (FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md still checks for real)

items.text_th: Barrier and Projection — barrier เพิ่ม cost สูงเมื่อเข้าใกล้ boundary ของ infeasible region (continuous constrained optimization บางประเภท); projection: x_{t+1} = Proj_X(x_t + η∇f(x_t)) ดัน candidate กลับเข้า feasible set หลัง update — ใช้ใน _project_bounds
items.text_en: Barrier and Projection — a barrier adds high cost near the boundary of the infeasible region (some continuous constrained optimization); projection: x_{t+1} = Proj_X(x_t + η∇f(x_t)) pushes the candidate back into the feasible set after an update — used in _project_bounds

items.text_th: Lagrangian — L(x, λ) = f(x) − λ g(x) สำหรับ g(x) ≤ 0 เป็น framework สำคัญของ constrained optimization แต่ guarantee ขึ้นกับ assumptions ของ problem — ห้ามสอนว่า 'ใช้ Lagrange แล้วรับประกันคำตอบ' โดยไม่มีเงื่อนไข
items.text_en: Lagrangian — L(x, λ) = f(x) − λ g(x) for g(x) ≤ 0 is a key constrained-optimization framework, but its guarantees depend on problem assumptions — never teach 'Lagrange guarantees the answer' without conditions

items.text_th: Local vs Global — Global Optimum = ดีที่สุดใน search space ทั้งหมด; Local Optimum = ดีที่สุดใน neighborhood หนึ่ง; gradient method มักไปถึง local optimum / stationary point ตาม landscape และ initialization; สำหรับ objective ที่ non-convex, discrete และ noisy คำว่า near-optimal / best-found ซื่อสัตย์กว่า global optimum
items.text_en: Local vs Global — Global Optimum = best in the whole search space; Local Optimum = best in one neighborhood; gradient methods usually reach a local optimum / stationary point depending on landscape and initialization; for non-convex, discrete, noisy objectives near-optimal / best-found is more honest than global optimum

description.th: เมื่อ search space ซับซ้อน มี mixed variables และหลาย objective — population แข่งกันแล้วพัฒนารุ่นใหม่
description.en: When the search space is complex with mixed variables and several objectives — a population competes and evolves.

items.text_th: Definition — generate population → evaluate → select → mutate/crossover → repeat; P_{t+1} = Variation(Selection(Evaluate(P_t))); GIST: แทนที่จะเดินตาม slope จุดเดียว ปล่อย candidate หลายตัวแข่งขันกันแล้วค่อย ๆ พัฒนารุ่นใหม่
items.text_en: Definition — generate population → evaluate → select → mutate/crossover → repeat; P_{t+1} = Variation(Selection(Evaluate(P_t))); GIST: instead of following one slope, let many candidates compete and gradually evolve new generations

items.text_th: Why — mixed variables, non-smooth score, categorical strategy และหลาย objective ทำให้ gradient ใช้ยาก; candidate หนึ่งอาจเป็น (top_k, dedupe_threshold, relevance_weight, freshness_weight, diversity_mode) และ evaluate relevance, diversity, cost พร้อมกัน
items.text_en: Why — mixed variables, non-smooth scores, categorical strategies and several objectives make gradient hard; one candidate may be (top_k, dedupe_threshold, relevance_weight, freshness_weight, diversity_mode) evaluated on relevance, diversity and cost at once

items.text_th: Python Sketch — evolutionary_search(initial_population, evaluate, mutate, candidate_id, is_feasible, generations, elite_size, seed): rng = Random(seed); score_cache ตาม candidate_id; ทุก generation กรอง feasible → rank → elites → mutate จน children feasible ครบ; คืน {best_candidate, best_score, evaluation_count, history, random_seed}
items.text_en: Python Sketch — evolutionary_search(initial_population, evaluate, mutate, candidate_id, is_feasible, generations, elite_size, seed): rng = Random(seed); score_cache keyed by candidate_id; each generation filters feasible → ranks → keeps elites → mutates until enough feasible children; returns {best_candidate, best_score, evaluation_count, history, random_seed}

items.text_th: Cache Caveat — score_cache สมมติว่า candidate_id ระบุ configuration ได้ deterministic (DECISION_SPACE.md serialization); หาก evaluator มี randomness จริง ควร cache evaluation batch / repeated-evaluation result ที่ versioned แล้ว ไม่ซ่อน stochasticity ด้วย single sample (EVALUATION_SPEC.md)
items.text_en: Cache Caveat — score_cache assumes candidate_id identifies the configuration deterministically (DECISION_SPACE.md serialization); with a truly random evaluator, cache a versioned evaluation batch / repeated-evaluation result instead of hiding stochasticity behind a single sample (EVALUATION_SPEC.md)

items.text_th: Contract evolutionary_optimization/v1.0 — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0, concept evolutionary_optimization; inputs {population_size integer, generations integer, mutation_policy object, crossover_policy {object, nullable true, value null}, objectives array}; required_metadata [random_seed, evaluation_count, best_or_pareto_history]; acceptance: candidate validity preserved หรือ repaired หลัง mutation, hard constraints ตรวจก่อน scoring และ selection, deterministic evaluations cache/dedupe เพื่อไม่ evaluate แพงซ้ำ, stochastic evaluation policy ระบุ repeats/seeds/aggregation, multi-objective mode คืน objective vectors และ Pareto status
items.text_en: Contract evolutionary_optimization/v1.0 — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0, concept evolutionary_optimization; inputs {population_size integer, generations integer, mutation_policy object, crossover_policy {object, nullable true, value null}, objectives array}; required_metadata [random_seed, evaluation_count, best_or_pareto_history]; acceptance: candidate validity preserved or repaired after mutation, hard constraints checked before scoring and selection, deterministic evaluations cached/deduplicated to avoid repeated expensive evaluation, the stochastic evaluation policy states repeats/seeds/aggregation, multi-objective mode returns objective vectors and Pareto status

items.text_th: Vector Scores — สำหรับ true multi-objective production เก็บ vector scores และ Pareto dominance แทน collapse เป็น single score โดยไม่จำเป็น (MULTI_OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md); Use Cases: mixed RAG configuration → สำรวจ architecture space; multi-objective tuning → Pareto alternatives; non-smooth objective → ไม่อาศัย derivative
items.text_en: Vector Scores — for true multi-objective production keep vector scores and Pareto dominance instead of collapsing to a single score unnecessarily (MULTI_OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md); Use Cases: mixed RAG configuration → explore the architecture space; multi-objective tuning → Pareto alternatives; non-smooth objective → no derivative needed

description.th: BriefDesk retrieval tuning: gradient rejected, evolutionary เป็น escalation หลัง Bayesian
description.en: BriefDesk retrieval tuning: gradient rejected, evolutionary as the escalation after Bayesian.

items.text_th: Gradient Rejected — component_weights เป็น continuous แต่ objective ผ่าน briefdesk_judge/v2 ไม่มี differentiable computation graph; rejected_algorithms {gradient_based, 'no differentiable path through the judge'}; ถ้าทีมสร้าง surrogate model ที่ differentiable ในอนาคต ต้องประกาศ discrete_relaxation_if_any explicit สำหรับ top_k
items.text_en: Gradient Rejected — component_weights are continuous but the objective passes through briefdesk_judge/v2 with no differentiable computation graph; rejected_algorithms {gradient_based, 'no differentiable path through the judge'}; should a differentiable surrogate be built later, discrete_relaxation_if_any must be declared explicit for top_k

items.text_th: Evolutionary Setup (escalation) — population_size null (calibrate จาก budget 40 evaluations), generations null, mutation_policy {top_k ±2 within [8,30], dedupe_threshold ±0.02 within [0.75,0.95], retrieval_strategy resample, component_weights Dirichlet-like perturbation แล้ว normalize — step sizes illustrative}, crossover_policy null, objectives [decision_usefulness, diversity, token_cost], seed 20260904
items.text_en: Evolutionary Setup (escalation) — population_size null (calibrate from the 40-evaluation budget), generations null, mutation_policy {top_k ±2 within [8,30], dedupe_threshold ±0.02 within [0.75,0.95], retrieval_strategy resample, component_weights Dirichlet-like perturbation then normalize — step sizes illustrative}, crossover_policy null, objectives [decision_usefulness, diversity, token_cost], seed 20260904

items.text_th: Why After Bayesian — evaluation_cost high ทำให้ population-based search กิน budget เร็ว; ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md จึงวาง bayesian_or_sample_efficient ก่อน evolutionary_or_pareto ใน escalation_path และใช้ evolutionary เมื่อต้องการ Pareto front ที่กว้างกว่า BO ให้
items.text_en: Why After Bayesian — high evaluation_cost makes population search burn the budget fast; ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md therefore places bayesian_or_sample_efficient before evolutionary_or_pareto in the escalation_path and uses evolutionary when a wider Pareto front than BO provides is needed

description.th: สอง contract — bayesian_optimization/v1.0 (surrogate + acquisition เมื่อการทดลองแต่ละครั้งแพง; owner ของ enum acquisition_function แบบ application-defined; prohibited claims รวม 'BO ≠ Bayes scoring relevance') และ adaptive_optimization/v1.0 (monitoring quality/drift/window, owner ของ enum trigger_type, thresholds จาก validation, rollback + versioning, boundary Adaptive ≠ Online ≠ Algorithm Selection ≠ Meta-Optimization)
description.en: Two contracts — bayesian_optimization/v1.0 (surrogate + acquisition when each experiment is expensive; owner of the application-defined acquisition_function enum; prohibited claims including 'BO ≠ Bayes scoring relevance') and adaptive_optimization/v1.0 (monitoring quality/drift/window, owner of the trigger_type enum, thresholds from validation, rollback + versioning, the boundary Adaptive ≠ Online ≠ Algorithm Selection ≠ Meta-Optimization).

suggested_headings: Worked Expensive Tuning and Adaptive Policy

description.th: เมื่อการทดลองแต่ละครั้ง 'แพง' — เลือกจุดถัดไปที่คุ้มจะทดลอง
description.en: When each experiment is 'expensive' — pick the next point worth trying.

items.text_th: Why and Definition — ถ้าแต่ละ candidate ต้องเรียก LLM หลายครั้ง, run benchmark ใหญ่ หรือให้ expert review การลองหลายพันครั้งแพงมาก; BO สร้าง surrogate model p(f | D) ประมาณ objective จากจุดที่ evaluate แล้ว และใช้ acquisition function เลือก x_next = arg max_x Acquisition(x | D) เพื่อ balance exploration กับ exploitation
items.text_en: Why and Definition — when each candidate needs several LLM calls, a large benchmark or expert review, thousands of trials are too expensive; BO builds a surrogate model p(f | D) estimating the objective from evaluated points and uses an acquisition function to pick x_next = arg max_x Acquisition(x | D), balancing exploration and exploitation

items.text_th: GIST and Loop — เราไม่ได้ลองทุกจุด — สร้างแผนที่คร่าว ๆ จากผลที่เคยเห็นแล้วเลือกจุดที่น่าจะคุ้มที่สุด; loop: Observed Evaluations → Surrogate (mean + uncertainty) → Acquisition → Choose Next → Expensive Evaluation → Update Surrogate
items.text_en: GIST and Loop — we do not try every point — we draw a rough map from what we have seen and pick the point most likely to pay off; loop: Observed Evaluations → Surrogate (mean + uncertainty) → Acquisition → Choose Next → Expensive Evaluation → Update Surrogate

items.text_th: acquisition_function — enum application-defined {EXPECTED_IMPROVEMENT, PROBABILITY_OF_IMPROVEMENT, UPPER_CONFIDENCE_BOUND} นิยามที่นี่ (workshop ยกเป็นตัวอย่างแนวคิด ไม่ได้ type); acquisition parameters (เช่น UCB κ) เป็น null จน calibrate
items.text_en: acquisition_function — application-defined enum {EXPECTED_IMPROVEMENT, PROBABILITY_OF_IMPROVEMENT, UPPER_CONFIDENCE_BOUND} defined here (the workshop lists them as conceptual examples without typing them); acquisition parameters (e.g. UCB κ) stay null until calibrated

items.text_th: Python and Library Rule — ExpensiveEvaluator.evaluate(candidate, run_benchmark) เก็บ history ต่อ call เป็น interface-level example; production BO ใช้ library ที่ implement surrogate/acquisition ถูกต้อง แทนการเขียน Gaussian Process แบบย่อเองโดยไม่มี validation
items.text_en: Python and Library Rule — ExpensiveEvaluator.evaluate(candidate, run_benchmark) storing history per call is an interface-level example; production BO uses a library implementing surrogate/acquisition correctly instead of a home-made abbreviated Gaussian Process without validation

items.text_th: Contract bayesian_optimization/v1.0 — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0, concept bayesian_optimization; preconditions {objective_type expensive_black_box, search_space bounded, evaluation_budget required}; components {surrogate_model required, acquisition_function required, initial_design required}; required_outputs [best_observed_candidate, best_observed_score, evaluation_history, total_evaluations]; prohibited_claims [ห้ามอ้างว่า BO ใช้ Bayes theorem ให้คะแนน context relevance โดยตรง, ห้ามอ้าง global optimality จาก evaluation budget จำกัด]; acceptance: evaluation budget ไม่ถูกเกิน, duplicate evaluations ถูกหลีกเลี่ยงเว้นแต่ repeat measurement ตั้งใจ, search-space bounds ถูก enforce
items.text_en: Contract bayesian_optimization/v1.0 — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0, concept bayesian_optimization; preconditions {objective_type expensive_black_box, search_space bounded, evaluation_budget required}; components {surrogate_model required, acquisition_function required, initial_design required}; required_outputs [best_observed_candidate, best_observed_score, evaluation_history, total_evaluations]; prohibited_claims [never claim BO uses Bayes theorem to score context relevance directly, never claim global optimality from a limited evaluation budget]; acceptance: the evaluation budget is never exceeded, duplicate evaluations are avoided unless repeat measurement is intentional, search-space bounds are enforced

items.text_th: Use Cases — LLM pipeline tuning: eval แพง → ลดจำนวน runs; prompt/config optimization: black-box score → sample-efficient exploration; expert-reviewed QA: human eval แพง → ใช้ review budget คุ้มขึ้น; BO เชื่อมกับ Bayesian Inference เพียงว่า surrogate จัดการ belief/uncertainty ของ objective — ไม่ใช่สิ่งเดียวกับ Bayesian Inference module
items.text_en: Use Cases — LLM pipeline tuning: expensive eval → fewer runs; prompt/config optimization: black-box score → sample-efficient exploration; expert-reviewed QA: expensive human eval → better use of the review budget; BO relates to Bayesian Inference only in that the surrogate handles belief/uncertainty about the objective — it is not the Bayesian Inference module

description.th: เมื่อ strategy ที่ดีที่สุดเปลี่ยนตามเวลา — ติดตาม performance แล้ว trigger re-optimization ตาม evidence
description.en: When the best strategy changes over time — track performance and trigger re-optimization on evidence.

items.text_th: Why and Definition — production ไม่อยู่ใน distribution เดิมตลอด (ผู้ใช้, query mix, cost, models, data เปลี่ยน) การ optimize ครั้งเดียวแล้ว freeze จึงเสื่อม; Adaptive Optimization ติดตาม performance แล้วปรับ configuration / routing policy หรือ trigger re-optimization เมื่อ drift หรือ degradation เกิน threshold ที่ validate แล้ว
items.text_en: Why and Definition — production never stays in the same distribution (users, query mix, cost, models, data change), so optimize-once-and-freeze decays; Adaptive Optimization tracks performance and adjusts the configuration / routing policy or triggers re-optimization when drift or degradation exceeds a validated threshold

items.text_th: Boundary — Adaptive Optimization = ปรับ strategy/configuration เมื่อ environment เปลี่ยน; Online Optimization = update decision ระหว่าง operation อย่างต่อเนื่องหรือเป็นรอบสั้น; Algorithm Selection = เลือก optimizer จาก problem characteristics; Meta-Optimization = optimize ตัว optimizer / search policy เอง — เอกสารนี้เน้น Adaptive Re-optimization และไม่ใช้คำว่า Meta-Optimization แทนทุก adaptive behavior
items.text_en: Boundary — Adaptive Optimization = adjust strategy/configuration when the environment changes; Online Optimization = update decisions during operation continuously or in short cycles; Algorithm Selection = choose the optimizer from problem characteristics; Meta-Optimization = optimize the optimizer / search policy itself — this document focuses on Adaptive Re-optimization and never uses Meta-Optimization for every adaptive behavior

items.text_th: Loop and Update — Optimize → Deploy → Observe Metrics → Drift / Performance Gap? No → Continue | Yes → Re-evaluate / Re-optimize; Strategy_{t+1} = Update(Strategy_t, Evidence_t); GIST: รอบแรกหา 'best known strategy ตอนนี้'; adaptive layer ทำให้ระบบรู้ว่าเมื่อไรควรเรียนใหม่
items.text_en: Loop and Update — Optimize → Deploy → Observe Metrics → Drift / Performance Gap? No → Continue | Yes → Re-evaluate / Re-optimize; Strategy_{t+1} = Update(Strategy_t, Evidence_t); GIST: the first round finds the 'best known strategy now'; the adaptive layer tells the system when to learn again

items.text_th: trigger_type — enum {QUALITY_BELOW_THRESHOLD, DRIFT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD, PERFORMANCE_DROP_ABOVE_VALIDATED_DELTA, SCHEDULED_RECALIBRATION} นิยามที่นี่ — template ตั้งชื่อ enum นี้ให้ key ใน triggers block ของ workshop (ไม่เพิ่ม field ไม่ bump); ทุก threshold เป็น null จน validate
items.text_en: trigger_type — enum {QUALITY_BELOW_THRESHOLD, DRIFT_ABOVE_THRESHOLD, PERFORMANCE_DROP_ABOVE_VALIDATED_DELTA, SCHEDULED_RECALIBRATION} defined here — the template names this enum for the keys of the workshop's triggers block (no field added, no bump); every threshold is null until validated

items.text_th: Python Sketch — should_reoptimize(current_score, reference_score, drift_score, min_quality, max_drift, min_meaningful_drop) = quality_floor_breached ∨ drift_breached ∨ (reference − current ≥ min_meaningful_drop); min_meaningful_drop ต้องมาจาก evaluator noise / validation policy (EVALUATION_SPEC.md) — ไม่ trigger เพียงเพราะ score ลดลงเล็กน้อยหนึ่งครั้ง
items.text_en: Python Sketch — should_reoptimize(current_score, reference_score, drift_score, min_quality, max_drift, min_meaningful_drop) = quality_floor_breached ∨ drift_breached ∨ (reference − current ≥ min_meaningful_drop); min_meaningful_drop must come from evaluator noise / validation policy (EVALUATION_SPEC.md) — never trigger on one small score dip

items.text_th: Contract adaptive_optimization/v1.0 — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0, concept adaptive_optimization; monitoring {quality_metric required, drift_metric required, evaluation_window required}; triggers {quality_below_threshold null, drift_above_threshold null, performance_drop_above_validated_delta null, scheduled_recalibration null}; governance {thresholds_must_come_from_validation true, rollback_required true, experiment_versioning_required true}; acceptance: trigger decisions auditable, single noisy fluctuation ไม่ trigger เว้นแต่ policy อนุญาตชัดเจน, re-optimization ไม่เขียนทับ last known-good โดยไม่มี versioning, rollback ถูกทดสอบ (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md)
items.text_en: Contract adaptive_optimization/v1.0 — optimization_contract: schema_version context_optimization_contract/v1.0, concept adaptive_optimization; monitoring {quality_metric required, drift_metric required, evaluation_window required}; triggers {quality_below_threshold null, drift_above_threshold null, performance_drop_above_validated_delta null, scheduled_recalibration null}; governance {thresholds_must_come_from_validation true, rollback_required true, experiment_versioning_required true}; acceptance: trigger decisions are auditable, a single noisy fluctuation never triggers unless policy explicitly allows, re-optimization never overwrites the last known-good without versioning, rollback is tested (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md)

items.text_th: Use Cases — personalized news: preference drift → brief ยังตรง priority; RAG corpus: knowledge updates → retrieval policy ไม่ stale; model upgrade: behavior เปลี่ยน → retune context strategy; API pricing: cost เปลี่ยน → optimize quality/cost ใหม่; การจัดการ uncertainty แบบ probabilistic มากขึ้นเชื่อมกับ Bayesian Inference module ถัดไป
items.text_en: Use Cases — personalized news: preference drift → briefs stay on priority; RAG corpus: knowledge updates → retrieval policy not stale; model upgrade: behavior shifts → retune context strategy; API pricing: cost changes → re-optimize quality/cost; more probabilistic uncertainty handling connects to the Bayesian Inference module

sections.heading: Worked Expensive Tuning and Adaptive Policy

description.th: BriefDesk: BO บน retrieval tuning และ adaptive policy หลัง deploy
description.en: BriefDesk: BO on retrieval tuning and the adaptive policy after deployment.

items.text_th: BO Run — exp_briefdesk_2026_09_04_003: search space bounded (top_k [8,30], dedupe_threshold [0.75,0.95], retrieval_strategy 3 ค่า, component_weights simplex); initial_design 6 random (seed 20260904, illustrative size); acquisition EXPECTED_IMPROVEMENT; evaluation_budget 30 จาก 40 ทั้ง run; best_observed decision_usefulness_proxy 0.81 (mean of 3, stdev 0.03) vs baseline 0.74 (illustrative) — รายงานเป็น best_observed ไม่ใช่ optimum
items.text_en: BO Run — exp_briefdesk_2026_09_04_003: bounded search space (top_k [8,30], dedupe_threshold [0.75,0.95], retrieval_strategy 3 values, component_weights simplex); initial_design 6 random (seed 20260904, illustrative size); acquisition EXPECTED_IMPROVEMENT; evaluation_budget 30 of the run's 40; best_observed decision_usefulness_proxy 0.81 (mean of 3, stdev 0.03) vs baseline 0.74 (illustrative) — reported as best_observed, never optimum

items.text_th: Why BO Here — แต่ละ configuration ต้อง run 60 benchmark briefs × judge 3 repeats + reviewer sample ≤ 20 → evaluation_cost high; exhaustive/grid บน mixed space เป็นไปไม่ได้ในงบ 40 evaluations; duplicate evaluations ถูกหลีกเลี่ยงด้วย candidate_id cache ยกเว้น repeat ที่ตั้งใจ
items.text_en: Why BO Here — each configuration needs 60 benchmark briefs × 3 judge repeats + a reviewer sample ≤ 20 → evaluation_cost high; exhaustive/grid on the mixed space is impossible within 40 evaluations; duplicate evaluations are avoided via the candidate_id cache except intentional repeats

items.text_th: Adaptive Policy — monitoring {quality_metric decision_usefulness_outcome (weekly, PRODUCTION_OUTCOME) cross-checked against the decision_usefulness reviewer sample, drift_metric interest-tag distribution shift (JS divergence), evaluation_window 14 days}; triggers ทุกตัว null จน validate; scheduled_recalibration quarterly; min_meaningful_drop derive จาก 2 × judge stdev; ทุก trigger decision ถูก log เป็น event
items.text_en: Adaptive Policy — monitoring {quality_metric decision_usefulness_outcome (weekly, PRODUCTION_OUTCOME) cross-checked against the decision_usefulness reviewer sample, drift_metric interest-tag distribution shift (JS divergence), evaluation_window 14 days}; every trigger null until validated; scheduled_recalibration quarterly; min_meaningful_drop derived from 2 × judge stdev; every trigger decision is logged as an event

items.text_th: Rollback Pairing — re-optimization สร้าง briefdesk_retrieval_config/v1.2 ใหม่ ไม่เขียนทับ v1.1; rollback target v1.1 ถูกทดสอบก่อน canary ตาม DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md

description.th: run contract คือ implementation spec ของ optimization run หนึ่ง — ไม่ใช่ source of truth ของค่า
description.en: The run contract is the implementation spec of one optimization run — not the source of truth for values.

items.text_th: What a Run Is — หนึ่ง run = หนึ่ง problem formulation × หนึ่ง evaluation setup (evaluator version, dataset version) × หนึ่ง budget; experiments (exp_…) ภายใน run ใช้ method ต่างกันได้ตามลำดับ baseline → escalation โดยแต่ละ experiment มี method_id เดียว; เปลี่ยน evaluator version, dataset version หรือ formulation = run ใหม่
items.text_en: What a Run Is — one run = one problem formulation × one evaluation setup (evaluator version, dataset version) × one budget; experiments (exp_…) inside the run may use different methods in baseline → escalation order, each experiment carrying exactly one method_id; changing the evaluator version, dataset version or formulation = a new run

items.text_th: Composition — run contract ประกอบ block จากเอกสารต้นทาง: problem (PROBLEM_FORMULATION.md), decision_space (DECISION_SPACE.md), objectives (OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md), constraints (FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md), evaluation (EVALUATION_SPEC.md), algorithm (ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md + method contract), logging (EXPERIMENT_LOG.md), governance (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md) — ไม่นิยาม enum ใหม่
items.text_en: Composition — the run contract composes blocks from their source documents: problem (PROBLEM_FORMULATION.md), decision_space (DECISION_SPACE.md), objectives (OBJECTIVE_SPEC.md), constraints (FEASIBILITY_SPEC.md), evaluation (EVALUATION_SPEC.md), algorithm (ALGORITHM_SELECTION.md + method contract), logging (EXPERIMENT_LOG.md), governance (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md) — it defines no new enum

items.text_th: Rule 7 Applied — ค่าใน run contract (weights ที่ calibrate, hyperparameters, thresholds) เป็น record ของ run นั้น; source of truth ของ production คือ versioned configuration ที่ deploy (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md)
items.text_en: Rule 7 Applied — values in the run contract (calibrated weights, hyperparameters, thresholds) are that run's record; the production source of truth is the deployed versioned configuration (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md)

items.text_th: Trigger Revalidation — ก่อน run ที่มี triggered_by.source = BAYESIAN_REOPTIMIZATION_TRIGGER จะเริ่ม ต้องตรวจ evidence_freshness.snapshot_validity ของ trigger ต้องไม่เป็น INVALIDATED และ compatibility.policy_scope ต้องตรงกับ policy_scope ของ run นี้ — ไม่ตรงข้อใดข้อหนึ่งคือปฏิเสธ run ก่อนเริ่ม (fail closed) ไม่ใช่เปิดแล้วค่อยเตือน; เช่นเดียวกับการ revalidate upstream_snapshot จาก formalization layer ใน HANDOFF.md
items.text_en: Trigger Revalidation — before a run whose triggered_by.source is BAYESIAN_REOPTIMIZATION_TRIGGER may start, the trigger's evidence_freshness.snapshot_validity must not be INVALIDATED and its compatibility.policy_scope must match this run's policy_scope — either mismatch refuses the run before it starts (fail closed), never opens it with a warning; the same discipline as revalidating the formalization layer's upstream_snapshot in HANDOFF.md

items.text_en: Two Questions — 'why was this configuration chosen' (needs raw sub-scores, constraint outcomes and the losing candidates) and 'if we must reproduce it today, do we have enough' (evaluator version, dataset version, seed, config hash)

items.text_th: Event Kinds — event เดียวกันใช้กับ candidate evaluation, infeasible rejection (feasible false, raw_metrics {}), repair + re-evaluation (constraint_results.repaired true → event ใหม่), holdout validation (dataset_version holdout) และ deployment/trigger decision (notes + configuration ของ config ที่ deploy) — แยกด้วย experiment_id และ notes ไม่ใช่ schema คนละตัว — run ที่เปิดจาก reoptimization trigger บันทึก event แรกพร้อม trigger_ref (schema_version + decision_ref ของ context_bayesian_reoptimization_trigger/v1.1 ที่เปิด run นี้)

description.th: event → W3C PROV เพื่อให้ trace ได้โดยไม่ต้อง RDF
description.en: Event → W3C PROV so traceability works without RDF.

items.text_th: PROV Types — candidate configuration = prov:Entity; evaluation run = prov:Activity (used candidate + dataset version + evaluator version); evaluator service / optimizer process = prov:SoftwareAgent; judge prompt + config = prov:Plan; dataset version, deployed configuration version = prov:Entity
items.text_en: PROV Types — candidate configuration = prov:Entity; evaluation run = prov:Activity (used candidate + dataset version + evaluator version); evaluator service / optimizer process = prov:SoftwareAgent; judge prompt + config = prov:Plan; dataset version and deployed configuration version = prov:Entity

items.text_th: Model Is Not an Agent — judge model weights / version = Entity ที่ activity used; service ที่รัน judge = SoftwareAgent ที่ wasAssociatedWith — ทำให้บอกได้ว่า judge version ไหนถูกใช้โดย service ไหน
items.text_en: Model Is Not an Agent — judge model weights / version = an Entity the activity used; the service running the judge = the SoftwareAgent wasAssociatedWith — so it is clear which judge version was used by which service

items.text_th: Derivation Chain — deployed configuration wasDerivedFrom best_candidate event wasGeneratedBy optimization run wasAssociatedWith optimizer (SoftwareAgent) actedOnBehalfOf team; values ที่ส่งกลับ formalization layer อ้าง event id เป็น provenance (HANDOFF.md)
items.text_en: Derivation Chain — deployed configuration wasDerivedFrom best_candidate event wasGeneratedBy optimization run wasAssociatedWith optimizer (SoftwareAgent) actedOnBehalfOf team; values returned to the formalization layer cite event ids as provenance (HANDOFF.md)

items.text_th: Reproducibility Caveat — PROV บันทึกว่า activity used อะไร แต่ไม่รับประกัน replay ของ nondeterministic evaluation; จึงต้อง persist raw_metrics ต่อ repeat และ hash ของ dataset/config (EVALUATION_SPEC.md)
items.text_en: Reproducibility Caveat — PROV records what an activity used but never guarantees replay of a nondeterministic evaluation; hence raw_metrics per repeat and dataset/config hashes are persisted (EVALUATION_SPEC.md)

description.th: เก็บนานแค่ไหน และคำถามที่ต้อง query ได้
description.en: How long to keep and the questions that must be queryable.

items.text_th: Retention — event ของ candidate ที่ชนะและของ run ที่ deploy เก็บตลอดอายุ configuration + rollback window; event ของ candidate ที่แพ้เก็บอย่างน้อยจน holdout และ risk review เสร็จ (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md); ค่า retention จริงเป็น policy (null ใน template)
items.text_en: Retention — events of winning candidates and deployed runs are kept for the configuration's life + rollback window; events of losing candidates at least until holdout and risk review finish (DEPLOYMENT_GOVERNANCE.md); actual retention is policy (null in the template)

items.text_th: Required Queries — 'candidate ทั้งหมดของ experiment X เรียงตาม objective_score พร้อม CI', 'candidate ที่ infeasible และ constraint ที่ทำให้ตก', 'raw_metrics ของ best vs baseline', 'evaluation_cost รวมต่อ experiment เทียบ budget', 'event ที่ trigger re-optimization และ evidence' (RUNBOOK.md) — คำถามนี้ตอบได้ตรงจาก trigger_ref บน event แรกของ run เทียบกับ decision_ref ของ bayesian ไม่ต้องเดาจาก timestamp
items.text_en: Required Queries — 'all candidates of experiment X ordered by objective_score with CI', 'infeasible candidates and the failing constraint', 'raw_metrics of best vs baseline', 'total evaluation_cost per experiment vs budget', 'events that triggered re-optimization and their evidence' (RUNBOOK.md) — this query is answered directly from the trigger_ref on a run's first event matched against bayesian's decision_ref, never guessed from timestamps

items.text_th: Immutability — event ไม่ถูกแก้; correction = event ใหม่ที่ notes อ้าง event เดิม; hash ของ configuration และ dataset (เช่น 4f2a…91c3, b71e…0d2e) ทำให้ตรวจ tampering ได้
items.text_en: Immutability — events are never edited; a correction is a new event whose notes cite the old one; configuration and dataset hashes (e.g. 4f2a…91c3, b71e…0d2e) make tampering detectable

items.text_en: Infeasible Event — cand_0019 {top_k 30, dedupe_threshold 0.75, …}: feasible false, constraint_results {token_budget {PRE_EXECUTION, passed false, REJECT}}, raw_metrics {}, objective_score null, evaluation_cost {tokens 0} — rejected before the judge, so no budget spent
